0cdaee3e6321ce9c6310.title: Fiscal Coordinator
0cdaee3e6321ce9c6310.description:
**Summary**
-----------

The Fiscal Coordinator will perform a variety of financial and accounting technical tasks in support of the daily financial operations for the Department of Emergency Services through the provision of high-quality financial reports and analysis. Works with the Fiscal Supervisor to standardize the policies, procedures and analysis reporting within the Administrative Division and the Department of Emergency Services. Supports the mission of the Department of Emergency Services by promoting and assisting in providing safety and security to Chester County citizens so they can work, live and grow in a healthy and safe community.
  
  
**All Department of Emergency Services employees are essential personnel and may be required to work during non-business hours for extended periods of time. Essential employee duties may involve assignments within the Emergency Operations Center (EOC), deployment to a field location, or other duties as required during periods of emergencies or training/exercise. Emergency assignments may be performed under adverse conditions, continue for periods ranging from a few hours to several weeks, and may require travel.**

**Essential Duties**
--------------------

* Prepares purchase orders, vouchers, receivables, revenue, expenditures and accounts payable.
* Maintains vendor contracts with coordination through Procurement and General Services for compliance.
* Prepares and inputs journal entries for budget, accounts payable, cash receipts, expenditure, and revenue adjustments.

* Prepares inter-fund transfers, as needed.
* Distributes checks to vendors.
* Prepares deposits as needed, including proper account coding.
* Works with the Treasurer’s Office to reconcile transactions against monthly bank statement.
* Analyzes expenditure, revenue and balance sheet accounts for accuracy and makes appropriate adjustments.
* Tracks invoices and payments for contracted supplies & services.
* Assists with preparing employee reimbursement for travel, mileage, and related expenses.
* Maintains Employee Training/Travel Tracking system, as needed.
* Coordinates resources for independent audits to ensure compliance with program regulations.
* Performs analyses and reconciliation of financial data, as required.
* Prepares monthly detailed revenue and expenditure report.
* Prepares and maintains contract database for continuity of services and historical data.
* Maintains the department’s manual and electronic accounting records.

* Maintains the General Ledger, special funds, and grants.
* Prepares Financial Reports; as needed.
* Tower rental cost.
* Revenue.
* Grants Billing and Payments.
* Financial reports to PEMA on an as needed basis.
* Interacts with vendors and county personnel, as needed.
* Assists the Fiscal Supervisor with budget process.
* Communicates with county departments to resolve any issues pertaining to submitted vouchers.
* Assists with managingthe department’s Vehicle Fleet.
* Keeps inventory of any outdated equipment within each division and removes it in accordance with Procurement/Controller guidelines.
* Collaborates with the Controllers on Tower Site Expenditures and Revenue in accordance with each contract, including annual increases and amendments.
* Serves as a liaison with all funding sources and independent auditors to ensure compliance with funding source rules and regulations, compliance with applicable laws, and to maintain appropriate program cash flow.
* Coordinates workflow from others in the department and consolidates the data given by accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll to facilitate month-end and year-end closings.
* Assists with Emergency Operations Center (EOC) activations and drills.

Performs other duties, tasks, and projects as necessary or assigned.

**Qualifications/Preferred Skills, Knowledge & Experience**
-----------------------------------------------------------

**Required:**

* Associate’s degree from an accredited college or university, three years of job-related experience, or any equivalent combination of education and experience.
* General knowledge of the County Code (state law) and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
* Experience with automated accounting and recordkeeping systems.

**Preferred:**
  

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field.

Four or more years of job-related experience, with preference for nonprofit roles.
  
  
**Other Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge and abilities**
  
  
Strong demonstrated abilities required:
  

* Verbal and written skills
* Listening and Communication skills
* Interpersonal skills
* Customer Service skills
* Analytical/Problem Solving skills
* Organizational skills
* Time Management Skills
* Presentation skills
* Project Management skills
* Prioritization/Multi-tasking skills
* Motivated/Works Independently
* Detail Oriented/Accurate
* Sound Analysis/Judgement skills
* Confidentiality
* Honest, Integrity and Professionalism
* Strong work ethic and willingness to learn new tasks

  
Also required:
  

* Ability to analyze expenditure, revenue and balance sheet accounts for accuracy and make appropriate adjustments.
* Ability to audit accounts on a regular basis to ensure accuracy.
* Ability to generate financial statements.
* Ability to maintain the General Ledger, special funds, and grants.
* Strong working knowledge of budgets, spreadsheets and interpreting audits.
* Ability to make journal entries for payroll, accounts payable and cash receipts.
* Ability to prepare cash transfers for disbursement.
* Creating timely and accurate financial reporting is essential to this position.
* Ability to interface effectively with all levels of county management.
* Ability to establish priorities and remain focused on daily operations.
* Ability to prepare and review journal entries and inter-fund transfers.
* Knowledge of business office procedures.

* Ability to work individually or as part of a team and proceed with objectives.

* Ability to follow protocols to handle and resolve routine problems.
* Ability to use common sense understanding to carry out written and verbal instructions.
* Flexible, with an ability to carry multiple tasks to completion

* Ability to work a flexible schedule with extended hours during emergencies, as necessary.
* Ability to work extended hours, including nights, weekends and holidays, occasionally.
* Ability to attend meetings on and off site at various hours.
* Ability to work on-call time, which may require working remotely.
* Valid driver’s license is required.

Preferred:
  
General knowledge of the Chester County policies and procedures.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Computer/technical skills**

  

* Intermediate Office Suite skills, including Outlook, Word, Excel, Explorer and PowerPoint.
* Basic PeopleSoft skills, (HR & Financial) or the ability to quickly learn.
* Basic knowledge with Inova / Payroll or the ability to quickly learn.
* Knowledge of Concur A/P system or the ability to quickly learn.

**Physical Requirements**

  

* Ability to sit, stand and walk for extended periods.
* Frequent use of hands/fingers for typing and operating standard office equipment.
* Ability to hear and speak clearly and recognize and identify audible and visual signals.
* Visual acuity to read computer screens and written documents and distinguish colors.
* Limited physical exertion; occasional bending, twisting, or rotating at the waist, kneeling, stooping, crouching, squatting, climbing stairs, and pushing or carrying of items.

**work environment**

  

* Moderate to loud noise level.
* Rapidly changing work assignments.
* Occasionally exposure to outside weather and adverse weather conditions.
* Required to operate a motor vehicle, including in hazardous driving conditions.

**Other Duties**

  

* This job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities required for this job. Responsibilities may be assigned or changed at any time.

**Additional information**

  

* **Relevant background checks, clearance, physicals, drug tests and any other assessments or evaluations will be conducted after an offer of employment is given per County policy.**

8306e8064db8d8ae02e7.title: Regional Administrator – Behavioral Health Operations
8306e8064db8d8ae02e7.description:
Regional Administrator – Behavioral Health Operations

**Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide**

**Location:** Philadelphia, PA and Surrounding Areas  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Monday–Friday  
**Salary:** Starting at $85,000 Annually + Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities  
**Schedule:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM | No Weekends or Holidays  
**Work Setting:** Field-Based / On-Site at Partner Facilities

About Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide

Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide is a growing behavioral health organization dedicated to providing high-quality psychiatric and therapeutic services to patients in skilled nursing facilities, nursing homes, and assisted living communities.

Originally founded by Dr. Pari Deshmukh, a triple board-certified psychiatrist, Balanced Wellbeing has grown and evolved through its partnership with a larger healthcare organization. While we continue to expand our reach and resources nationwide, we remain committed to maintaining the collaborative, supportive, and close-knit culture that has always defined our team.

Our mission is to improve access to compassionate, patient-centered behavioral healthcare while providing our clinical teams with the leadership, resources, and support they need to succeed.

Position Overview

Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide is seeking a motivated, organized, and experienced **Regional Administrator** to oversee and support behavioral health operations throughout **Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and surrounding communities**.

This position serves as a key operational leader responsible for supporting our Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs), therapists, and partner facilities. The Regional Administrator ensures providers have the tools, resources, schedules, and operational support necessary to deliver exceptional patient care while meeting organizational expectations.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced healthcare environment, builds strong professional relationships, and can independently manage multiple priorities.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring regular travel between assigned facilities and direct engagement with clinical providers, facility leadership, and corporate operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Regional Operations & Leadership**

* Oversee daily behavioral health operations across assigned skilled nursing and assisted living facilities.
* Provide direct operational supervision, guidance, and support to PMHNPs and therapists throughout the region.
* Ensure providers maintain appropriate schedules, patient volumes, and productivity expectations.
* Monitor provider performance, documentation compliance, and adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Identify operational challenges and implement effective solutions to improve efficiency and patient care.
* Collaborate with clinical leadership and corporate operations to support regional growth and organizational objectives.

**Provider Support & Coordination**

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for providers within the assigned region.
* Assist with provider scheduling, patient assignments, and facility coverage to ensure continuity of care.
* Review and approve employee timecards, PTO requests, and scheduling adjustments in accordance with company policies.
* Ensure providers have access to necessary equipment, technology, and rounding materials.
* Support onboarding, training, and integration of new clinical team members.
* Address provider concerns and facilitate communication between clinical staff and leadership.

**Facility Relationships & Communication**

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with facility administrators, directors of nursing, and other healthcare professionals.
* Serve as a liaison between Balanced Wellbeing, clinical providers, and partner facilities.
* Address facility concerns promptly and professionally while maintaining a high standard of customer service.
* Coordinate with facility leadership to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and patient access.
* Represent Balanced Wellbeing at facility meetings, regional events, and other professional engagements as needed.

**Quality Assurance & Administrative Oversight**

* Monitor timely and accurate completion of clinical documentation and required operational reporting.
* Review productivity reports, provider schedules, and regional performance metrics.
* Ensure compliance with company protocols, facility requirements, and applicable healthcare regulations.
* Work collaboratively with credentialing, human resources, scheduling, and clinical leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
* Participate in regular leadership meetings and provide updates regarding regional performance, staffing, and operational needs.

Qualifications & Requirements

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous experience in healthcare operations, administration, team leadership, or a related field.
* Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

c86e07ad1c6fe4f69cfd.title: Senior Manager, Digital Clinical Operations
c86e07ad1c6fe4f69cfd.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

**General Description:**

The **Senior Manager, Digital Clinical Operations** is responsible to enhance Global Clinical Operations productivity and reduce clinical trial inefficiencies, by setting the strategy, as well as shaping, defining, and delivering business critical digital capabilities. This role will provide digital leadership across investigator fee management, study and site budgeting, site contracting, payment and invoice management, reconciliation, forecasting and variance analytics. The Senior Manager will lead cross-functional digital initiatives from opportunity identification and business case development through implementation, adoption, and value realization, partnering across GCO, technical and data teams, and external technology providers.

The technology ecosystem includes a combination of anchor applications, both homegrown and SaaS, exploratory innovations, as well as analytics capabilities.

This role will specifically focus on following activities:

* Define and detail enhancements for digital solutions used by the budgeting, site contracting, payment and data hub teams.
* Engage with clinical stakeholders across geographies and functions, to create a clear voice of the clinical teams for the purpose of the delivery of enhancements.
* Lead the execution and delivery of digital solution pilots and explorations by defining scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, milestones, and success criteria; mobilizing cross-functional teams; coordinating vendor onboarding; monitoring dependencies, actions, risks, issues, and costs; providing transparent status reporting; and escalating decisions or barriers to ensure timely, high-quality delivery
* Lead the translation of business strategy, operational needs, and stakeholder requirements into digital capability requirements and roadmaps, ensuring organizational, regional, and process alignment.
* Facilitate the prioritization of demand, managing competing interests with objective assessment of value. Ensure that priorities are aligned to organizational priorities. Create transparency into priorities with clear communication to stakeholders. Translate priorities into plans in collaboration with the development team. Manage expectations with stakeholders.
* Provide business leadership for the development of business requirements, as well as hands-on authoring, ensuring requirements appropriately address business outcomes, process needs, compliance considerations, data requirements, and intended value.
* Participate with the implementation team in sprint planning, sprint testing, and SDLC testing.
* Oversee and direct UAT and business testing, partnering with the business lead on the testing strategy and approach, establishing a UAT plan, mobilizing the UAT team, overseeing scripting, and coordinating UAT activities within the framework of the implementation plan.
* Ensure that all digital capabilities have a defined business process, partnering with the GCO business lead.
* As part of requirement gathering, ensure that related business processes are well defined and probe into process optimization or process solutions where appropriate, to complement digital solutioning. In cases where process or process ownership is not defined, create process flows aligned with proper functions and leadership.
* Define and articulate the value proposition of all requests, in both quantifiable and qualitative categories.
* Define, track and share business outcome value measures for digital projects.
* Represent GCO business interests as a key member of the implementation team.
* Review proposed designs to ensure that solutions are architected to meet the actual need and expected value. Ensure data are fit for intended decision-making.
* Drive business demand prioritization within assigned capability areas, balancing business value, risk, strategic alignment, dependencies, and resource constraints in partnership with product and technology teams. Own curation of backlog.
* Partner with business lead to ensure appropriate change management and business adoption plans are in place.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry solutions, and vendor capabilities and provide recommendations to GCO leadership regarding adoption, investment, experimentation, and scale-up.

The incumbent will work directly with GCO clinical stakeholders, Development and IT organizations and support implementing novel technology solutions.

**Essential Functions of the job:**

General expectations of a **Digital Clinical Operations** employee

* Forge relationships with users to understand their requirements and processes, identify automation opportunities, collaborate with development/vendor team to create the necessary fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Project Management: ensure forward progress, timelines are managed, accountabilities are clear, and project risks and costs are managed.
* Drive the analysis of the technology and industry trends to identify specific opportunities that ensure BeOne clinical trials and operations are conducted with fit-for-purpose, cost-effective and innovative solutions that are cohesive, efficient, reliable, and compliant with all applicable regulatory expectations.
* Implement the GCO technology roadmap to increase Global Clinical Operations’ productivity, reduce rising costs of clinical trials, and reduce clinical trial inefficiencies
* Monitor, evaluate, and optimize the performance and quality of the technology solutions, as well as troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise
* Promote a culture that exemplifies agility, compliance, process-orientation, data-driven decision-making, and thoughtful use of technology and innovation
* Partner with internal BeOne departments, including Development Data Science, QA and IT, to support the development of documentation associated with computerized systems, including lifecycle management for existing systems, and the implementation of innovative new systems
* Develop solution requirements and standards in alignment with stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Data Management, Supply Chain, etc.).
* Identify pain points and manual workflows, and develop technological solutions that address these challenges, leveraging existing and innovative approaches.
* Take accountability for business value realization of technology solutions. Ensure that appropriate change tactics are planned and effectively delivered (communications, training, user communities, adoption drives) for both internal and external users. May directly involve development and delivery of these tactics.
* Focus on user expectation and satisfaction and decreasing user burden. Proactively ensure system usability and user needs remain a high priority.

**Supervisory** **Responsibilities:**

* Be an individual contributor
* Provide functional leadership to analysts, consultants, vendors, and matrixed project resources supporting assigned digital initiatives. Provide coaching, direction, and subject-matter guidance while establishing clear accountability for deliverables and outcomes.

**Technical Skills:**

* Requirement gathering and documentation
* Technical solution project management
* Process modeling
* Familiarity with clinical operations applications in the financial space

**Soft skills:**

* **Stakeholder management**: Ability to work collaboratively with functional leadership and external partners, to forge partnerships and collaborations arrangements. Ability to manage expectations, to communicate to broad groups of end-users.
* **Project management leadership**: Ability to build alignment, influence without direct authority, foster accountability, navigate competing priorities, adapt to change, and maintain constructive collaboration and forward momentum across cross-functional teams.
* **Communication**: Exhibits strong cross-cultural awareness, and strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey complex insights to non-technical stakeholders
* **Cross-functional oversight:** Ability to collaborate with cross-functional clinical teams to understand their business needs and deliver outcome-aligned solutions. Partner with internal BeiGene departments, including Development Data Science, QA and IT, to develop standards, policies, and procedures associated with computerized systems, including lifecycle management for existing systems, and the implementation of innovative new systems.
* **Problem-Solving**: Excellent conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving skills to identify trends and make data-driven decisions. Troubleshooting skills.

* **Able to drive forward progress**
* **Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment**, and able to adapt to changes in responsibilities and workloads

**Required experience:**

* Clinical Operations domain experience – working in Biotech, life sciences or IT consulting industry
* Bachelor’s degree Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business or related degree required
* Minimum 7+ years in translating business needs into technology solutions with a proven record
* Minimum 2 years in driving execution and delivery of solutions
* Investigator fee management systems (CMS, ERP, budgeting systems, payment systems, financial analytics, forecasting, accruals)
* Budgeting, contracting, payment expertise in the context of clinical trials
* Core clinical systems (CTMS, eDC, IRT)
* SDLC
* Validated systems
* Project management experience is a plus
* Business analysis experience is a plus
* Familiarity with data processing / engineering is a plus

**Travel:** As needed

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

* Fosters Teamwork
* Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
* Self-Awareness
* Acts Inclusively
* Demonstrates Initiative
* Entrepreneurial Mindset
* Continuous Learning
* Embraces Change
* Results-Oriented
* Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
* Financial Excellence
* Communicates with Clarity

Salary Range: $136,400.00 - $181,400.00 annually

890c4066a2925e0d944c.title: Senior Manager, Specialty Operations (Remote)
890c4066a2925e0d944c.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Manager of Specialty Operations to support the operational execution of our new specialty product launch. This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

66ac279aa32028d9ab85.title: Enablement Operations Manager
66ac279aa32028d9ab85.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

#### **An overview of this role**

As an Enablement Operations Manager at GitLab, you will run the operational engine behind global Enablement programs, events, and systems. You will turn program plans into clear timelines, logistics, communications, and repeatable processes so the field gets a consistent, well-run experience.

This role is hands-on with GitLab's largest Enablement-led events, including Revenue Kick-Off (RKO), GitLab Academy Bootcamps, President's Club (P-Club), and in-person workshops. You will also own Field Communications and the Enablement PMO and track how programs perform.

You will work closely with Enablement leaders and program owners, Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Workplace, and travel partners. This is a strong fit for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, calm under deadline pressure, and energized by making complex global programs run smoothly in an all-remote environment.

**What You'll Do**

* Own Field Communications for Enablement, including the communications calendar, field newsletters, Slack and email announcements, and launch messaging, so the field gets clear, timely, and consistent updates.
* Own the Enablement PMO, including program intake, the Enablement roadmap and calendar, prioritization inputs, project status tracking, and regular reporting to Enablement leadership.
* Manage end-to-end operational planning and execution for Enablement-led events such as RKO, Academy Bootcamps, P-Club, and in-person workshops, from timelines and project plans through day-of execution and post-event follow-up.
* Coordinate event logistics, including venue and virtual setup, hotel and travel coordination, registration workflows, attendee communications, session scheduling, run-of-show, and materials.
* Work with vendors, Procurement, and Finance on quotes, contracts, purchase requests, invoices, and budget tracking for Enablement programs and events.
* Run the day-to-day operating rhythm for Field Enablement programs, including program calendars, intake requests, cohort and enrollment operations, reminders, and status updates.
* Use and improve templates, playbooks, and checklists so recurring events and programs are delivered consistently across regions.
* Track participation, attendance, completion, and event feedback, and prepare clear readouts for Enablement leadership and program owners.
* Keep standard operating procedures, planning documents, and handbook pages current so work is transparent and easy to hand off.
* Spot operational risks and friction early, escalate when needed, and recommend practical fixes that improve quality and speed.
* Use AI tools to streamline repeatable operational work such as communications, tracking, and reporting, and share what works with the team.
* Partner with Enablement program owners, Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Workplace, and travel partners to keep deliverables on track.

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience in enablement operations, sales or revenue operations, program management, event operations, or a related function, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* A track record of planning and executing in-person, virtual, or hybrid events with many moving parts and firm deadlines.
* Strong project management skills: building plans, tracking dependencies, and driving follow-through with distributed stakeholders.
* Experience writing and editing communications for a broad internal audience, such as sales or field teams.
* Clear written communication, with the ability to produce attendee communications, process documentation, and stakeholder updates.
* Close attention to detail and sound judgment when managing budgets, vendors, and high-visibility logistics.
* Ability to bring structure to loosely defined requests and prioritize across competing deadlines.
* Experience running internal or field communications, or a program management office (PMO), including intake, prioritization, and status reporting across multiple workstreams.

a88f83850cc817129d2e.title: Supervisor, Hospital Pre-Billing Operations - Remote
a88f83850cc817129d2e.description:
**Optum Insight** is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Supervisor, Medical Clinical Operations - Pre-Billing will lead a newly established hospital pre-billing team supporting Dignity Health hospitals across California, Arizona, and Nevada. This remote position will oversee six Pre-Billing Specialists responsible for identifying and resolving account deficiencies before accounts are released to billing and claims are submitted to payers.

The supervisor will help establish and maintain pre-billing workflows and work queues, monitor productivity and quality, support denial prevention and Discharge Not Final Billed (DNFB) reduction, and identify opportunities to resolve recurring billing issues upstream. This role will collaborate with Coding, Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI), Patient Access, Case Management, Billing, Financial Clearance, Financial Counseling, Scheduling, and other operational and clinical teams to support accurate and timely billing.

This role is focused on payer-facing hospital revenue-cycle operations rather than traditional patient registration. The successful candidate will bring strong knowledge of hospital revenue-cycle processes, payer requirements, account work queues, pre-billing operations, and people leadership.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee daily operations of the Pre-Billing Specialist team
* Supervise, coach, mentor, train, and develop a team of six Pre-Billing Specialists
* Help establish and implement workflows, work queues, standard operating procedures, job aids, and best practices for a newly created pre-billing operation
* Maintain the accuracy and integrity of pre-billing work queues and ensure appropriate patient accounts are routed for review
* Monitor productivity, quality, accuracy, aging, and service expectations; conduct quality reviews and performance monitoring against established standards
* Coordinate onboarding, training, and ongoing team education, including education related to payer, regulatory, and operational requirements
* Prioritize high-dollar, high-risk, aged, and escalated patient accounts requiring additional review or resolution
* Ensure account deficiencies are identified and resolved before accounts are released to billing and claims are submitted to payers
* Identify recurring billing edits, claim holds, account deficiencies, and denial drivers; implement upstream workflow changes to prevent downstream issues
* Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action planning for recurring claim defects, denial patterns, and billing delays
* Support reduction of DNFB inventory and avoidable claim delays
* Collaborate with Coding, CDI, Patient Access, Case Management, Billing, Financial Clearance, Financial Counseling, Scheduling, and clinical teams to resolve account discrepancies
* Partner with facility and operational leaders to clarify ownership, resolve escalations, and improve end-to-end pre-billing processes
* Maintain knowledge of applicable payer requirements, coverage guidelines, and regulatory standards and translate that knowledge into team education and workflow guidance
* Use operational reporting and Microsoft Excel to monitor work queues, productivity, trends, risks, and improvement opportunities
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence
* Use enterprise-approved AI tools, as appropriate, to support documentation, operational analysis, workflow improvement, training, and team efficiency while maintaining human oversight, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements
* Perform other duties as assigned

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hospital revenue-cycle experience
* 4+ years of experience in one or more of the following: Financial Clearance, Insurance Verification, Authorization Management, Hospital Billing, Claims Editing, Denials Prevention, or Coding/Clinical Documentation Integrity collaboration
* 4+ years of experience working with hospital patient-accounting and/or electronic health-record systems, including claim editing and work-queue management
* 2+ years of leadership, supervisory, team-lead, training, or workflow-leadership experience in hospital revenue-cycle operations
* Knowledge of Discharge Not Final Billed (DNFB) management and the operational factors that delay final billing
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel
* Ability to work remo

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting acute-care hospital pre-billing operations
* Experience reviewing and resolving authorization-related billing edits, claim holds, and account discrepancies before claim submission for acute-care hospital services
* Working knowledge of commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid managed-care authorization requirements and payer-specific guidelines
* Experience using payer portals, authorization-tracking tools, claim-editing systems, and hospital work queues
* Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) or another relevant healthcare revenue-cycle certification
* Solid knowledge of payer-specific authorization requirements, coverage policies, and denial-prevention practices
* Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, filtering, data analysis, and pivot tables
* Experience leading denial-prevention, root-cause analysis, workflow-improvement, or DNFB-reduction initiatives

* All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $60,200 - $107,400 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

**Application Deadline:** This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

9e258f47cb15dc30fe7a.title: Workforce Development Coordinator
9e258f47cb15dc30fe7a.description:
**Workforce Development Coordinator**

**Addison County, VT**

**Make a difference in the lives of adult learners while helping build pathways to education, training, and employment!** Vermont Adult Learning is looking for an organized, motivated, and people-focused Workforce Development Coordinator to support workforce training programs across Vermont. This role offers the opportunity to connect with students, build community partnerships, coordinate training opportunities, and help individuals take the next step toward their career goals. If you enjoy working with people, building relationships, and keeping things running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you!

**Vermont Adult Learning Job Title:** Workforce Development (WFD) Coordinator

**Employment Classification:** Full Time Benefitted (40 hours per week)

**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt/Hourly

**Pay Rate:**  $25.00/hr

**Reports To:** Director of Workforce Training

**Primary Work Site:** Remote, with regular attendance at VAL learning centers and workforce training sites throughout Vermont.

**Location Requirements:** This is a remote position. There will be opportunities to work from any of our VAL centers in Franklin, Grand Isle, Chittenden, Addison, Rutland, Windsor, and Windham counties, and a requirement to be on-site for portions of workforce training programs.

**Application Requirement:** A current resume and cover letter are required for consideration. Applications submitted without a cover letter will not be reviewed.

Vermont Adult Learning (VAL) is a private nonprofit and a member of Vermont’s Adult Education and Literacy System. Working closely with other nonprofits, state agencies, and schools, we serve seven of Vermont’s 14 counties. We provide instruction in basic academic skills, work readiness, and English language skills; high school completion and GED prep; workforce training; and transition to college and career services. Our programs are free to Vermont residents, age 16 and older who want to obtain a high school diploma or the equivalent skills, learn English, and/or participate in workforce training and credentialing opportunities.

**Overview:**

The WFD Coordinator supports the workforce staff to maintain the continuity of high-quality workforce programs and services for adult learners and facilitates staff communication and deployment of resources. In addition, the Workforce Coordinator supports student outreach and recruitment as well as readiness for VAL services. The Workforce Coordinator serves as the initial point of contact for new students interested in VAL workforce trainings, listens to and develops a relationship with the student to understand their workforce readiness needs, and provides enrollment and onboarding services. The Workforce Coordinator develops and maintains community partnerships as part of a fabric of coordinated services and referral networks and supports students in accessing programs and services to meet their needs and goals.

The Workforce Coordinator works closely with and reports to the Director of Workforce Training, and collaboratively with the Director of Employment and Transitional Services, regional directors, advisors and teachers in the Regional Learning Centers and the greater VAL community.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities:**

* Workforce Coordination
* Work closely with the Director of Workforce Training to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of workforce trainings.
* Work with VAL Administrative Support personnel to order and approve the purchase of supplies for students, including training materials and manuals, and other office or instructional materials needed for the Workforce Center.
* Work with the Director of Workforce Training and Director of Employment and Transitional Services to develop new and manage existing relationships with partner organizations.
* Attend Data Specialist training and meetings through both VT AOE and VAL.
* Support the workforce team by occasionally providing onsite facilitation during trainings.
* Enrollment and onboarding support.
* Explain VAL programs and offerings clearly to new students and guide them to the proper program based on their goals.
* Guide students through the enrollment, intake and onboarding process.
* Assess students to determine readiness and learning needs, including eligibility, income verification, and intake requirements for participation in VAL workforce trainings.
* Refer students to other organizations & agencies as appropriate.
* Develop a culture of student engagement with workforce training, employment and transitional service staff.
* Outreach and recruitment support
* Work with VAL’s Marketing and Communications Manager to inform workforce staff of specific outreach efforts and build an inclusive process for outreach.
* Assist with the development and implementation of communication, outreach, and recruitment strategies.
* Maintenance of student data and records
* Collect and enter all student data into VAL’s Student Information System (SIS) and ensure student records are complete, accurate, and maintained regularly.
* Run pertinent reports in VAL’s student database to support operations.
* Participate in Data Specialist training and all required data-related professional development offered by VAL and the VT AOE.
* Maintain students’ educational files, both electronic and hard copies, according to legal requirements and best practices.
* Administrative
* Process paperwork for student supports, stipends, and purchase approval forms.
* Coordinate meals and refreshments for participants and instructors on training days.
* Maintain annual workforce training calendar.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail for WFD programming.
* Provide content for grant and Board reports, such as program outcomes and student data.
* Complete registrations and checklists for IET programming and VDOL pre-apprenticeships.
* Draft MOUs, employer agreements, and contracts for new partners and vendors.
* Secure certificates of insurance when hosting trainings via community and employer partner locations.
* Support students with accessing VSAC, HireAbility and WIOA funds as needed.
* Manage and update workforce training related files in VAL’s Google Drive.
* General
* Provide basic, frontline customer service by responding to inquiries about VAL programs.
* Maintain professional standards of confidentiality.
* Participate in personal & professional development.
* Participate in monthly VAL statewide Center Coordinator Team meetings and regular workforce team meetings.
* Assist with training new staff.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications, Knowledge & Skills:**

Bachelor's degree plus three years experience or similar combination of education and experience preferred. Experience preferred with at-promise students, alternative educational systems, and adult educational practice. Must possess strong interpersonal, oral, and written English communication skills to engage & listen to students. Requires competency in using office computer applications and databases to perform various administrative and communication tasks. Requires a creative thinker who is knowledgeable of and able to coordinate available community resources. Also requires the ability to work well independently and as part of a team. Strong organizational skills are necessary to complete administrative tasks. This position requires a commitment to racial equity, as well as other forms of educational equity around class, ability, language, gender and sexuality. Candidates should be excited to work with diverse students, especially BIPOC students, English Language Learners, and LGBTQIA+ students.

**Working Conditions & Environment:**

This position requires both remote and in-person services at VAL’s regional learning centers, meeting with students in the community, and the ability to work remotely effectively and professionally. Some evening or weekend hours may also be required. Requires internet connectivity conducive to video conferencing; a valid driver's license, reliable, personal transportation and/or access to public transportation. Mileage will be reimbursed for work related travel.

Long periods of sitting may be needed.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

**Criminal Background Check and Mandated Reporting:** Vermont Adult Learning is committed to the safety of our students and staff. A confidential, national criminal records check as well as a check against the Vermont Child Abuse and Neglect Registry will be performed on all applicants offered employment. Continued employment is subject to the final determination reached based upon the results of these checks.

**All Vermont Adult Learning staff are required to be familiar with Vermont’s Mandated Reporter law.**

**Benefits**: In addition to a competitive salary, Vermont Adult Learning offers the following excellent benefits – premiums are based upon employee’s work schedule:

* Medical insurance, including family plans and employer contributions to a health reimbursement account (HRA)
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, and AD&D Insurance at no cost to employee. Voluntary Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance also available.
* Health Care Flexible Spending Account (Employee contributions only)
* Retirement plan with immediate vesting and employer discretionary match after 6 continuous months of service for employees with at least 500 hours of service during that period
* Employee Assistance Program
* Generous paid time off includes:
* Combined Time Off (vacation, personal, and sick time) that increases with years of service
* Two paid organizational closure weeks each year
* 12 paid holidays each year.
* Parental Leave

**TO APPLY:** Candidates should send a cover letter and resume to: jhanley@vtadultlearning.org

**Application Deadline:** Open until position is filled

**Vermont Adult Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

Pay: Up to $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

f21c84314e50067721c3.title: Referral & Scheduling Care Coordinator
f21c84314e50067721c3.description:
**About Frontier Psychiatry**

Frontier Psychiatry is a physician-led, tech-enabled telehealth organization on a mission to

improve the mental well-being of people in rural communities nationwide.

We provide timely, scalable, evidence-based psychiatry and addiction care to individuals who

might otherwise face long wait times or significant travel barriers to receiving treatment.

Our work is guided by the Quintuple Aim:

* Excellent patient care
* Team well-being
* Lower total cost of care
* Improved population health
* Health equity

We believe everyone deserves access to high-quality mental health care, regardless of where

they live. Join us in making that possible.

**The Short Version**

The Referral & Scheduling Care Coordinator plays an essential role in connecting patients to

the care they need. This position manages incoming referrals, coordinates patient scheduling, supports provider schedule utilization, and maintains strong communication with patients and referring partners.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to ensure patients experience a smooth, timely transition from referral to their first appointment while supporting the operational efficiency of our growing clinical team.

**Why This Role Exists**

Frontier Psychiatry was founded to improve access to mental health and addiction care in rural communities where patients often wait months—or travel hours—for services. Access starts long before the first appointment.

The Referral & Scheduling Care Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring patients move efficiently from referral to care. This position directly impacts how quickly patients are scheduled, how well providers' schedules are utilized, and how effectively we serve referring partners.

We are hiring a Referral & Scheduling Care Coordinator to help deliver timely, organized, and patient-centered access to care as we continue to grow across multiple states. This is an important role that supports the daily coordination of patient access and provides opportunities for direct collaboration with our team.

**Schedule & Commitment**

* Full-time schedule.
* Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining timely communication and accurate documentation.
* Flexibility to adapt to changing operational needs and priorities.

**What You'll Do**

**Referral Management**

* Process incoming referrals within established timelines.
* Conduct outreach to patients and referring providers to ensure timely scheduling and closure of the referral loop.
* Communicate referral expectations clearly with patients.
* Enter and maintain accurate patient demographics, insurance, and referral information in the EHR.
* Verify insurance eligibility, including telehealth coverage.
* Maintain consistent communication with referring providers throughout the referral process.
* Identify and escalate new referring partners to leadership as appropriate.

**Patient Scheduling**

* Schedule new patient appointments, follow-ups, reschedules, and transfers of care.
* Manage provider schedules to ensure full utilization and timely access to care.
* Respond to inbound calls, voicemails, and patient portal messages in a professional and timely manner.
* Process cancellations, no-shows, and rescheduling workflows in alignment with organizational policies.
* Support pre-visit scheduling and coordination as needed.
* Assist providers with scheduling needs and follow-up coordination.
* Provide patients with cost estimates and collect copayments when applicable.

**Care Coordination & Operations Support**

* Serve as a key point of contact for patients navigating access to care.
* Collaborate with clinical, operational, and billing teams to support efficient patient workflows.
* Correct registration errors and maintain accurate patient records.
* Manage scheduling and coordination for contracted clinics, if assigned.
* Escalate scheduling or access issues to leadership when needed.
* Support daily team operations and contribute to a collaborative in-office work environment.

**Documentation & Administrative Support**

* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in the EHR.
* Name and index documents according to organizational standards.
* Complete assigned tasks and reporting requirements efficiently.
* Participate in team meetings, training, and process improvement initiatives.
* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to organizational policies and procedures.

**What Success Looks Like**

In this role, success means:

* Referrals are processed quickly and efficiently with minimal delays.
* Patients are scheduled promptly and accurately.
* Provider schedules are optimized and fully utilized.
* Communication with patients and referring providers is consistent, professional, and effective.
* Documentation is accurate and compliant, with minimal registration errors.
* Patients experience an organized and positive transition from referral to care.
* Team members communicate effectively and work collaboratively to support daily operations.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Experience working in a medical or healthcare setting required.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work on-site at our Billings, Montana office.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with insurance verification and eligibility.
* Familiarity with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Previous experience in medical scheduling, referral coordination, or patient registration.

**Additional Strengths**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional, patient-centered approach to communication.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Professionalism, accountability, and consistent follow-through.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn, adapt, and contribute to a team environment.

**What We Offer**

We believe access to care starts with a strong operations team. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees both professionally and personally.

* 120 hours of paid vacation.
* 40 hours of paid sick time.
* Your birthday off with pay.
* 9.5 paid holidays.
* 401(k) with company match.
* 100% employer-paid employee-only premiums for medical, dental, vision, and accidental insurance.
* HSA plan option.
* Stock options.
* Company-provided equipment.

**Our Commitment**

Frontier Psychiatry is committed to improving access to high-quality mental health and addiction care while supporting a collaborative, accountable, and mission-driven team.

We value individuals who bring professionalism, empathy, and attention to detail to their work every day. We believe in supporting one another, embracing change, and doing meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve.

**Compensation**

The pay range for this role is:

$18.13 – $22.07 per hour (Remote)

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
18.13 - 22.07 USD per hour(Remote)

3b72c3c51b6818dca99d.description:
Partner Relations & Operations Coordinator

**MammoLink | Mobile 3D Mammography & Breast Imaging Services**

**Salary:** $55,000–$63,000 per year  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Salaried  
**Work Location:** Remote  
**Reports To:** Director of Partner Relations & Business Development

Are You the Person Who Makes Things Happen?

Are you exceptionally organized, naturally engaging, full of great ideas, and someone who genuinely enjoys connecting with people?

Are you the type of person who sees what needs to be done and takes action before anyone has to ask?

**If you're driven, creative, highly organized, and love working with people, we want to meet you!**

MammoLink is growing, and we're looking for an outstanding **Partner Relations & Operations Coordinator** who brings energy, initiative, professionalism, and an ownership mentality to everything they do.

**This is not your typical administrative position.**

We're seeking a confident, detail-oriented professional who can support leadership, build meaningful relationships with healthcare partners, contribute fresh ideas, and help keep our growing organization running smoothly.

The ideal candidate is equal parts organizer, communicator, problem-solver, and relationship builder.

Who We Are

MammoLink is a growing healthcare organization dedicated to expanding access to high-quality breast imaging through mobile 3D mammography and breast imaging services.

We collaborate with physician practices, healthcare organizations, employers, and community partners to make essential breast screening services more accessible and convenient.

We believe exceptional service starts with exceptional people.

What You'll Do

**Build Relationships That Matter**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with physician offices, healthcare partners, employers, and community organizations.
* Serve as a knowledgeable, engaging, and dependable point of contact.
* Proactively follow up with partners, anticipate their needs, and ensure an outstanding experience.
* Help onboard new partners and strengthen existing relationships.
* Identify creative opportunities to improve communication and partner engagement.

**Support Leadership & Keep Operations Moving**

* Provide high-level administrative and organizational support to leadership.
* Coordinate calendars, meetings, deadlines, and important communications.
* Help coordinate mobile mammography events and partner activities.
* Prepare professional reports, presentations, correspondence, and business documents.
* Assist with operational reporting, HR documentation, and special projects.
* Anticipate challenges and proactively identify solutions.

**Bring Ideas & Take Initiative**

* Contribute fresh ideas to strengthen partner relationships and improve processes.
* Recommend creative outreach and engagement strategies.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, organization, and communication.
* Take ownership of assignments and follow through from start to finish.

**Stay Organized & Accountable**

* Maintain accurate partner records, CRM information, and operational documentation.
* Track important follow-ups, deadlines, and outstanding requests.
* Manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
* Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

The Personality We're Looking For

We love motivated, Type A personalities who combine ambition, organization, emotional intelligence, and exceptional communication skills.

Our ideal candidate is:

* **Proactive:** You anticipate needs instead of waiting for instructions.
* **Exceptionally organized:** You thrive on structure, details, and keeping things moving.
* **Naturally engaging:** You know how to connect with people and build genuine relationships.
* **An outstanding communicator:** You're confident, articulate, warm, and professional.
* **Creative:** You bring new ideas and thoughtful solutions to the table.
* **Accountable:** You take ownership and follow through on your commitments.
* **Resourceful:** You can work independently, solve problems, and adapt quickly.
* **Positive and driven:** You bring energy, enthusiasm, and a genuine desire to contribute.

**You should enjoy getting things done just as much as you enjoy building relationships.**

Qualifications

**Required**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in administrative support, operations coordination, account management, partner relations, or a similar professional role.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to build professional relationships.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities in a remote environment.
* Excellent follow-through, professionalism, and attention to detail.

**Preferred**

* Healthcare, medical office, or physician relations experience.
* Experience working with healthcare providers or community organizations.
* Familiarity with HubSpot or other CRM platforms.
* Experience coordinating events, outreach programs, or partner communications.
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree.

Why Join MammoLink?

At MammoLink, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your work makes a difference.

You'll have the opportunity to build professional relationships, collaborate with leadership, contribute to a growing healthcare organization, and help expand access to essential breast imaging services.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary of $55,000–$63,000 annually
* Full-time, salaried position
* Remote work environment
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Paid time off
* Employee discount
* Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven healthcare organization

Think You're the Right Fit?

We're not looking for someone who simply wants a remote administrative job.

**We're looking for someone who wants to make an impact.**

Someone who brings great ideas, understands people, communicates exceptionally well, takes initiative, and genuinely enjoys making things happen.

If you're the person others rely on to stay organized, solve problems, build relationships, and get results, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and tell us what makes you an exceptional fit for MammoLink!**

*MammoLink LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and are committed to a professional, inclusive workplace.*

Pay: $55,000.00 - $63,000.00 per year

Benefits:

660cd4a976783168d397.title: Healthcare Billing Recovery Outreach Specialist I (SCA)
660cd4a976783168d397.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We're constantly reimagining what's possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

As a **Healthcare Billing Recovery Outreach Specialist I (SCA)**, you are assigned health insurance carrier, auto/home/worker's comp insurance carrier, or legal representatives ("stakeholders") of Group Healthcare (GHP) and/or Non-Group Healthcare Provider (NGHP) cases under the CMS Medicare Secondary Recovery Program. The Outreach team works with the Medicare Secondary Payer ("MSP") Debtor stakeholder community for Performant's assigned cases to address their high-priority questions and concerns regarding MSP case demands and related MSP correspondence. In addition, the Outreach team provides education and feedback to this MSP stakeholder community to help them understand the full scope of Performant's responsibilities and operating processes, as well as the stakeholder's corresponding responsibilities to ensure that MSP debts are paid timely and accurately.

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Leverage your knowledge and expertise in TPL/COB/MSP to review case documentation and any previous case work and activities completed by caseworkers to validate liability, responses to defenses regarding payment liability, status the account and letter correspondence, etc. in preparation to respond to and/or reach out to stakeholders.
* Answer questions (on the phone and/or in writing as appropriate) and/or provide information and education to the stakeholder(s) that will bring to successful payment or other appropriate account action.
* Responsible for monthly Outreach calls for assigned stakeholders which includes creating agendas, taking meeting minutes and responding to all phone calls or email inquiries.
* Initiate correct action with applicable party and documentation based upon payment option, actions required if review of case and/or new information is identified that may change the obligation to pay, or escalation in the event of refusal to pay.
* Updates client and/or company systems with clear and accurate information such as involved party(ies) contacting the CRC, notes from contact dialog, as well as account status updates as applicable.
* Initiates applicable claim activities; follows-up and follows through accordingly to ensure documentation and activity is on-time and accurate in accordance with policies and procedures.
* Support internal groups or functions with interpretation of EOB (explanation of benefits), as well as development of knowledge base and understanding of key concepts and terminology in healthcare billing and claims.
* Arrives to work on-time, works assigned schedule, and maintains regular good attendance.
* Follows and complies with company, departmental and client program policies, processes and procedures.
* Responsible for utilizing resources to ensure compliance with client requirements, HIPAA, as well as applicable federal or state regulations.
* Successfully completes, retains, applies and adheres to content in required training as assigned

(note: client/government clearance requirements are not determined or decisioned by Performant.)

* Correct areas of deficiency and oversight received from quality reviews and/or management.
* Work overtime as may be required.
* May be required to work some Performant holidays due to client requirement.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You Bring:**

* Knowledge and experience with medical claim billing procedures, medical terminology and medical coding (including information in forms UB04 and CMS 1500), preferably in a role generating, auditing, recovery and/or researching the same including Medicare and Medicaid claims.
* Experience with Coordination of Benefits (COB), Third Party Liability (TPL), Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) with proven expertise in gather and interpret Explanation of Benefits (EOB) to answer questions and resolve medical billing issues, including Medicare and Medicaid claims.
* Demonstrated ability to successfully complete high-quality MSP GHP and NGHP casework in accordance with company, client (CMS) and regulatory requirements.
* Proven ability to gather and interpret Explanation of Benefits (EOB) to answer questions and resolve medical billing issues;
* Remarkable interpersonal and communication skills; ability to listen, be succinct and demonstrate positive customer service attitude and approach.
* Demonstrated professional verbal and written communication skills to communicate professionally and effectively with internal audiences at all levels as well as externally with providers, carriers, beneficiaries and other audiences regarding claims and billing payment.
* Protected patients' privacy, understands and adheres to HIPAA standards and regulations.
* Remarkable interpersonal and communication skills; ability to listen, be succinct and demonstrate positive customer service attitude.
* Self-motivated and thrives in a fast-paced business operations department performing multiple tasks cohesively, with keen attention to detail.
* Proficiency using standard office technology; computer, various applications and navigation of on-line tools and resources, keyboard, mouse, phone, headset.
* Ability to apply knowledge learned in training from various forms (memos, classroom training, on-line training, meetings, discussions, individual coaching, etc.).

* Ability to effectively perform work independently, and work cooperatively with others to promote a positive team environment.
