2ce589ef563a130b00bb.title: Customer Success Manager - Remote
2ce589ef563a130b00bb.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

Steer is looking for a Customer Success Manager to build strong relationships with automotive shop owners and managers and help them get measurable value from our products. You will own an assigned portfolio, guide customers after onboarding, address risks early, and identify opportunities to support their growth. This role combines proactive account management with responsive, dependable customer communication.  
  
**Compensation: $80,000 - $90,000 base + 15% bonus.**

**You Are**

* **A Relationship Builder:** You are a proactive account owner who builds deep trust with shop owners, managers, and day-to-day operational contacts.
* **Comfortable Managing a Portfolio:** You thrive when balancing customer needs, competing priorities, and proactive outreach across a varied book of business.
* **A Structure Builder:** You are energized by the "grey area" and enjoy creating order. You want to help improve the customer success playbook while consistently executing on customer commitments.
* **Commercially Minded & Composed:** You are highly organized, focused on driving business value, and able to remain calm under pressure while balancing customer advocacy with internal capacity.

**You Will**

* **Own the Customer Lifecycle:** Manage ongoing customer relationships after onboarding, including proactive check-ins, business reviews, renewal readiness, and expansion identification.
* **Strengthen the CS Playbook:** Help improve how Steer proactively supports customers through consistent touchpoints, clear follow-up, and repeatable account management practices.
* **Champion Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Support, Onboarding, Product, Sales, and RevOps to resolve customer issues and translate feedback into clear internal next steps.
* **Mitigate Risk & Drive Growth:** Maintain visibility into account health, identify revenue risks early, and take action to improve retention and uncover relevant expansion opportunities.
* **Ensure Consistent Execution:** Lead smooth onboarding transitions, help customers connect product capabilities to their goals, and keep account records and commitments current. Respond promptly and keep customers informed through resolution.

**You Have**

***Must Have***

* **Customer Relationship Experience:** 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, with ownership of ongoing customer relationships.
* **Commercial Acumen:** A track record of supporting customer retention and identifying growth opportunities. You can connect product value to customer business goals and navigate conversations about risk, renewals, and expansion.
* **Clear Communication & Follow-Through:** Strong presentation, organization, and relationship skills, with the ability to lead productive customer conversations, set clear expectations, and consistently deliver on commitments.
* **Lifecycle Ownership:** Experience managing post-sale customer needs, including adoption, account health, issue resolution, and coordination across internal teams.

***Nice to Have***

* **Industry Experience:** Familiarity with automotive, franchise, or Multi-Shop Operator (MSO) business models.
* **CS Ecosystem Tech:** Experience using HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, or dedicated Customer Success platforms.
* **Process Improvement:** Experience supporting SMB or mid-market SaaS customers, improving customer onboarding or engagement processes, or working with marketing SaaS, integrations, or business phone products.

  

#### 

**Interview Process:**

1. Recruiting screen - 20 min  
2. Hiring manager interview - 45 min  
3. Assignment/Case Study - 1hr  
4. Problem Solving Exercise - 1hr  
5. Reference check

  

**We Offer**

* 100% remote work environment
* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance within 30 days
* 100% employer-paid medical insurance
* Equity package
* Flexible PTO with 15 days minimum
* Generous Parental Leave
* FSA and HSA options
* 401(k)
* Growth & Wellness Stipend
* WFH Equipment
* Chance to work with the latest technology
* A collaborative, high ownership culture
* Opportunities for development and career growth

**Why Join Steer?**  
  
At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.  
  
  
  
  
We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

acc45d7758a98213928b.title: Project Coordinator - Power Delivery
acc45d7758a98213928b.description:
WSP is seeking a Project Coordinator for our Power Delivery Project Management Team. Be involved in projects with our Project Management Team and join WSP’s growing Power & Energy organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.

This position is based out of Chicago, IL or remotely from any mutually acceptable location in IL, IN, KY or OH.

**This Opportunity**

Provides world-class administrative and logistical support to WSP Power Delivery project teams by executing project coordination tasks to deliver operational efficiency and excellence. Oversees complex assignments requiring the ability to interpret project plans, manage information workflows, and ensure timely execution of critical tasks. Works independently with minimal supervision to resolve issues, implement process improvements, and contribute to successful project delivery. Serves as a key liaison between Project Managers and engineering, finance, and procurement teams to facilitate seamless project coordination and reporting.

**Your Impact**

* Master WSP’s enterprise resource planning, document control, and other systems, as well as WSP project management policies and procedures, and client-specific systems, policies, and procedures.
* Lead or assist the Project Manager with project setup, including data entry and quality control to ensure all information is entered correctly, and that required workflows are initiated and completed in a timely manner.

* Coordinate the creation, formatting, and finalization of client deliverables, ensuring consistency and adherence to established standards.
* Lead the creation, administration and distribution of critical documentation including contracts, change orders, financial reports, submittals, and RFIs.
* Track project milestones and proactively follow up with team members to ensure completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Manage internal documentation systems and repositories, applying version control and audit protocols and ensuring logical and complete filing of documents; maintain a document register for each project as required.
* Serve as a point of contact for project-related inquiries, supporting internal and external communication flows.

* Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.

* High school diploma or equivalent.

1d52548c5d46b096c432.title: Project Coordinators
1d52548c5d46b096c432.description:
Arcfield Overview: Arcfield was purpose-built to relentlessly protect the nation and its allies from today’s national security threats. We have nearly 70 years of proven expertise and excel in space superiority, hypersonic defense and nuclear deterrence, digital transformation, and surface and undersea warfare domains. Our solution areas include space mission engineering, atmospheric science, digital engineering, mission assurance, and advances in modeling and simulation that together with our enterprise-wide adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning, lead to better systems and timely, reliable decision-making. Headquartered in Chantilly, VA with 18 North American offices, Arcfield employs 2,200 engineers, scientists, analysts, IT specialists and other professionals who challenge the status quo to deliver an efficient technological advantage to our national security and defense partners. Responsibilities:

**Position Description**

**Project Operations & Configuration Management Specialist**

The Project Operations & Configuration Management Specialist provides project coordination, task management, documentation control, configuration management, inventory accountability, and administrative support for multiple engineering programs within a DoD environment.

The individual serves as a primary coordination point between engineering teams, government personnel, contractor organizations, and external customers at Headquarters and NUWC locations. Responsibilities include maintaining project tracking systems, coordinating meetings, monitoring deliverables and action items, supporting configuration management processes, and maintaining accurate project and inventory records.

The successful candidate must be highly organized, proactive, personable, and adaptable, with strong communication skills and the ability to independently manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment. Flexibility in adjusting workload in response to changing program requirements and customer needs is essential.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Project Task Management & Customer Coordination**

* Administer and maintain Microsoft Planner task management systems and master trackers within Government Teams.
* Create, assign, update, monitor, and close tasks; track deadlines, deliverables, and outstanding action items.
* Coordinate and support recurring engineering tasking meetings, including meeting preparation, documentation, action-item assignments, and follow-up.
* Serve as a coordination interface between engineering teams, government customers, contractors, and NUWC representatives.
* Coordinate schedules, deliverables, customer requests, and project activities across multiple organizations.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and communicate status, delays, and emerging issues.

* **Documentation & Configuration Management Support**

* Maintain and update DDR (Document/Design Data Records) and associated tracking records.
* Provide administrative support for Configuration Review Board (CRB) activities, including preparing forms, assembling documentation packages, and verifying completeness and accuracy.
* Coordinate resolution of missing or incomplete documentation and track outstanding CRB actions.
* Release internal drawing numbers in accordance with established procedures and authorization requirements.
* Support Product Data Management (PDM) vault administration, including document organization, configuration records, revision tracking, and discrepancy identification.

* **Reporting, Process Improvement & Inventory Management**

* Develop and maintain tracking spreadsheets, status reports, dashboards, and other project reporting tools.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve administrative and operational workflows, including automated processes.

Qualifications:  

* HS 5-6 Years
* Must possess and be able to maintain an active Secret Clearance.
* Experience supporting DoD programs, government engineering organizations, or defense contractors.
* Familiarity with configuration management, engineering documentation control, CRB processes, and technical data management.
* Experience with Product Data Management (PDM) systems and engineering data vaults.
* Experience with inventory management and equipment accountability.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Automate and automated workflow development.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Office Suite and supplemental tools.

  
Equal Pay Act: This is the projected compensation range for this position. c5a72bc95f6041265194.title: Services Project Coordinator (Remote) CST/MST/PST
c5a72bc95f6041265194.description:
**Innovate Remotely**

This position is fully remote, allowing you to enjoy the flexibility of working from home while collaborating with skilled team members and contributing to groundbreaking solutions.

**Your Impact**  
  
The primary purpose of the Services Project Coordinator is to facilitate end-to-end oversight and support to customers who purchase installation job(s). The Services Project Coordinator is responsible for tracking progress, documenting all interactions, addressing issues and communicating with customers, service providers, stores and vendors in a timely manner to keep the job going. To accomplish this, the Services Project Coordinator must have excellent customer service and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to change. The Services Project Coordinator will collaborate directly with customers, service providers, stores and peers to deliver the desired customer experience. The Serivices Project Coordinator will receive regular feedback and coaching from his/her leader and must be receptive and able to incorporate the feedback to improve skills and enhance performance on a continual basis. This position is in a fast-paced environment and schedules may include night and/or weekend hours.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Answer inbound calls from customers, service providers and stores to provide installation job support.
* Manage outbound tasks and make outbound calls to customers, providers, stores and vendors in order to provide updates or gather job information.
* Conduct initial contact with customer and service providers to provide centralized contact information and job expectations in order to verify project scope and ensure alignment.
* Ensure projects are scheduled within the SLA by the service provider and provide confirmation to the customer.
* In coordination with stores and customers, arrange product delivery to ensure work can begin on time.
* Ensure all required compliance documents related to permits and Lead Safe Practices are uploaded in the appropriate system.
* Manage and resolve Work Order issues (post project completion) including assessment of related costs and the potential of service provider and/or vendor charge backs.
* Submit accurate and thorough documentation of all interactions related to the project in appropriate technology tools (i.e., Installation Management System, myRedVest and Salesforce).
* Practice active listening skills with customers, service providers, stores and vendors in order to deliver an excellent customer experience and promote team collaboration.
* Deliver consistent service by referring to and executing defined processes and providing feedback that will enhance current processes.
* Drive for results by consistently achieving goals and completing tasks/activities on time.
* Build effective relationships with others by organizing information, sharing information with coworkers and leaders and seeking performance feedback.
* Adapt to a fast-paced environment with evolving process enhancements.
* Complete assigned training courses, participate in team meetings, town halls, developmental meetings, etc.

  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable
* 1- 3 years' experience in a customer facing role

  
**Preferred Skills/Education**

* Bachelor’s degree Related field
* 1 year Experience in project coordination OR experience in remodeling or construction industry
* 1 year Experience working in a Project Management function
* Experience in contact center environment

Pay Range: $17.73 - $29.61 per hour

*Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit our* *benefits page**.*

6a9ee754ab561a5334fb.title: Project Manager
6a9ee754ab561a5334fb.description:
**Job Description****:** NORESCO is seeking a Project Manager for its Federal and Energy Services teams. We are seeking an individual that has construction experience with a variety of construction tasks associated with managing campus mechanical and electrical distribution systems and other energy infrastructure. This individual will be responsible for working with a construction team, supporting project development, estimating, scheduling, contract/subcontract development, safety oversight, project financial performance, quality control/quality assurance and contract compliance.

**About the role**

The Project Manager will be a team member supporting project needs from development through construction completion. They will support project teams as needed to meet overall Company objectives. We will rely on this individual to participate in internal and external meetings providing their expertise to assist the teams as we develop successful projects to address client needs. Project Management skills and effective communication are required for this role.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Project Documentation**

* Management and documentation of the bid process, including pre-qualifying subcontractors, developing bid packages, and evaluating subcontractor bids.
* Negotiate best pricing and terms with subcontractors and vendors,
* Developing subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Prepare daily construction reports as well as monitor the status of the project to ensure NORESCO meets all contract related issues.
* Work with subcontractors and vendors to ensure that their closeout and O&M documents meet all NORESCO requirements.
* Generate and produce meeting minutes and appropriate correspondences required for contract compliance.

**Project Management**

* Development and management of project schedules including organizing on-site construction activities.
* Interface with customers and supervise contractors on a daily basis and coordinate subcontractor access at owner’s facilities.
* Manage NORESCO purchased material and equipment by coordination, delivery, receive and inspection
* Witness and inspect subcontractor work for quality control, cost control, schedule, and completeness.
* Coordinating, conducting, and documenting inspections of work with the Owner’s representative to achieve a projects substantial and final completion.
* Must maintain high level of customer satisfaction. Responsible for onsite commissioning and close-out activities.
* Must be able to manage all aspects of the project with minor management supervision.
* Development of future projects by conducting the following: scope review, constructability, pricings, and subcontractor site walks.
* Risk analysis and decision making when it impacts constructability, budgets, and or savings.

**Safety**

* Development of project and subcontractor safety plans.
* Daily monitor and document subcontractor activities ensuring safety compliance.
* Read and comply with all NORESCO safety requirements and maintain a safe work environment at both the office and in the field.

**Financial**

* Preparation of project budgets and manage projects to within project budgeted amount.
* Track and approve subcontractor monthly invoices. Check and ensure that they are accurate and comply with all NORESCO required information.
* Preparation of accurate monthly project financial projections for subcontractor monthly cost.

**Preferred Experience, Education & Licensure:**

Order of Precedence: (first to last) Experience, Education, Licensure

* 3+ years of experience related or relevant work experience or;
* Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Chemical or Civil Engineering, Navy Nuclear Power graduate or;

* Contractors licenses

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience with the installation and commissioning of steam distribution and other mechanical, electrical or building/balance of plant control systems.
* Must have proven track record of success in dealing with customers and having oversight of subcontractors and/or project managers.
* Proficient level of communications, sense of ownership, and project management
* Proficient in Microsoft Project, Word, and Excel.
* Willing to travel a minimum of 50% during work week.
* Mental alertness and ability to concentrate with distractions nearby
* Ability to stand, stoop, reach, bend, climb and crawl
* This position requires working in diverse locations and conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms where there can be potential exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and proximity to electricity including high voltage. Detailed safety review must be completed and reviewed prior to any work. Adherence to all Safety Procedures will be required.
* This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, standing, stooping, reaching, kneeling bending climbing, and crawling
* Potential exists for requirement of employee to regularly lift and or move up to 10 lbs., frequently lift and or move up to 50 lbs. and occasionally lift and or move more than 50 lbs.
* Desire to build and maintain respectful and inclusive working relationships with individual project team members to foster an environment of cooperation and productivity.
* Robust combination of business acumen, risk management, and strategic thinking skills.
* Keen attention to detail and ability to identify errors, concerns, or ambiguities in contract documents (contracts, design, specifications).
* Eligible to obtain federal security clearance, if required

**Salary Range:** $110,000 – $125,000 per year, depending on experience

**Benefits:**

* HSA Medical insurance, with a choice of 2 buy-up options
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* 100% Safe Harbor 401(k) match
* 100% company paid Life insurance
* 100% company paid Long-term Disability insurance
* Short-term Disability insurance
* Flexible Spending Account
* Commuter Benefits
* Legal and Identity Protection
* Pet Insurance Coverage
* Fertility and Reproductive Health
* Generous Paid Time Off, including Holiday, Vacation, and Sick Pay

**About the Construction Management team**

NORESCO’s in-house construction management team works in partnership with customers to develop innovative and proven energy infrastructure solutions that enhance operating efficiency, reduce operating costs, and achieve environmental and regulatory compliance. Our customized solutions focus on customers’ unique needs and are technology driven.

Our construction management team provides the specialized skills and experience associated with a wide variety of projects from simple Lighting and HVAC systems to complicated power plant cogeneration and water wastewater facilities. NORESCO is product, technology, and fuel agnostic - our diverse portfolio ranges from reciprocating engines, combustion gas turbines, steam turbines, diesel generators, heat recovery chillers, compressed air, high purity water, and absorbers to controls, automation, microgrids, energy storage, and renewable and alternative power technologies.

**About the Company**

NORESCO develops customized solutions to meet each customer’s individual financial, technical, operational, and sustainability objectives through a variety of project delivery methods and contract structures. In many cases these design-build projects are funded through a combination of reduced energy, utility, or maintenance costs and required capital expenditures. It takes a unique combination of curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and technical ability to identify and develop these types of solutions. We are looking for talented construction/project managers that enjoy participating and contributing in a team environment and have several types of positions available throughout the United States.

NORESCO designs, constructs and operates central utility plants under a variety of contracting structures, including energy savings performance contracts, traditional design/build, public-private partnership (P3), and design-build-own-operate-maintain (DBOOM) contracts. We offer turnkey asset management, ownership, and monetization solutions. By moving the operating risk and burden of heating, cooling, and power supply to NORESCO, our customers can enjoy worry-free plant operation services and focus entirely on their core mission.

**What Makes Us Unique**

Our employees depend on each other and the diversity of perspectives, skills, and experience we have together to support our customers and our company. We strive to hire the best people and to provide an environment where those people can do their best work while having a tangible impact on energy conservation and slowing climate change. That is why NORESCO is a leader in the energy industry.

**Core Values**

Our culture is rooted in the core values of Opterra Company. These values define the way we do business and are your assurance of engineering and construction reliability, equipment performance, energy and operating cost savings and complete satisfaction:

* Quality
* Performance
* Responsibility
* Innovation
* Customer Care
* Employee Opportunity

91c01551da9ab7bdcf8c.title: Project Manager - Proposals
91c01551da9ab7bdcf8c.description:
**Project Manager – Proposals**

Spark Power Corp USA is seeking an organized and detail-oriented **Project Manager – Proposals** who will be responsible for coordinating the preparation, development, and timely submission of customer proposals in support of our Major Projects division. This role will work closely with internal estimating teams, operational leadership, and customers to ensure proposals are accurate, complete, and aligned with customer requirements and submission deadlines.

Our ideal **Project Manager – Proposals** candidate will be a highly organized, motivated individual with excellent communication and interpersonal skills who is comfortable managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. This position combines proposal coordination, customer relationship management, and administrative project support. The successful candidate will serve as a key point of contact between customers and internal teams, helping ensure proposals move efficiently from the estimating stage through final submission.

**What will you do in this position?**

**Proposal Development & Coordination**

* Coordinate the preparation, review, and submission of proposals for electrical construction and infrastructure projects within the Major Projects division.
* Work closely with the estimating team to gather project estimates, supporting documentation, and other information required to develop customer proposals.
* Utilize established company proposal templates to prepare professional, accurate, and complete proposal packages.
* Review estimates, proposal documents, and customer requirements to ensure all requested information, scope details, and deliverables are properly addressed.
* Coordinate revisions and updates to proposals based on feedback from customers, estimating teams, and internal leadership.
* Help ensure proposals are completed accurately and submitted within established customer deadlines.

**Customer Relations & Communication**

* Serve as a point of contact for customers regarding proposal status, submission timelines, and general project inquiries.
* Maintain regular communication with customers to provide updates, address questions, and coordinate changes to proposal requirements or deadlines.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers through professional, responsive, and effective communication.
* Coordinate customer requests and feedback with internal estimating and operational teams to ensure expectations are understood and addressed.
* Assist leadership with customer follow-ups and ongoing communication related to active proposals and potential projects.

**Proposal Scheduling & Deadline Management**

* Track and manage multiple active proposals, bid deadlines, and customer submission requirements.
* Maintain organized records of proposal statuses, due dates, revisions, and outstanding action items.
* Coordinate with estimators and internal stakeholders to ensure required information is received and incorporated into proposals on schedule.
* Identify potential delays or challenges that could impact proposal deadlines and communicate concerns proactively.
* Prioritize competing deadlines and assist with adjusting schedules or coordinating customer extensions when necessary.

**Internal Coordination & Project Support**

* Work directly with Major Projects leadership to support proposal activities and overall business development efforts.
* Act as a liaison between estimating teams, customers, and internal stakeholders throughout the proposal process.
* Provide administrative and coordination support related to proposal development, document management, scheduling, and customer communications.
* Assist with maintaining accurate proposal documentation and organizing project-related information.
* Support improvements to existing proposal processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and overall responsiveness to customer needs.

**Do you have the Spark? Here's what we're looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration, Construction Management, Project Management, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
* Entry-level candidates and recent college graduates with strong communication and organizational skills are encouraged to apply.
* Previous experience in project coordination, proposal preparation, administrative support, customer service, or a related position is considered an asset but is not required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with customers and internal teams.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-focused approach to problem-solving and communication.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Ability and willingness to learn company proposal processes, estimating documentation, and industry-specific terminology.
* Familiarity with electrical construction, engineering, estimating, or commercial project environments is an asset but not required.
* Ability to remain flexible, organized, and responsive in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and customer deadlines.

**Working Conditions:**

* This position offers the opportunity to work remotely on a full-time basis.
* Regular communication and collaboration with Major Projects leadership, estimating teams, and customers will be required.
* Must be available and responsive during established working hours to support proposal coordination and customer communication.
* Occasional evening or weekend availability may be necessary to meet critical customer proposal deadlines. These instances are expected to be infrequent and based on business needs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a deadline-driven environment.

**Here are some of the perks Spark employees enjoy:**

* Diverse and exciting industrial, commercial, and institutional projects and customer base
* Growing company with consistent work
* Continuous training and skills improvement
* Career advancement opportunities
* Competitive wages
* Remote work opportunity
* Excellent benefit package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Extended Health, Disability)
* 401k with percentage company match
* Great company culture!
* ...and much more

**Who is Spark Power?**

Spark Power is the leading independent provider of end-to-end electrical services and operations and maintenance services to the industrial, utility, and renewable asset markets in North America. We work to earn the right to be our customers' Trusted Partner in Power™. Our highly skilled and dedicated people, located in the communities we serve, combined with our knowledge of the power industry, technology expertise, and commitment to safety, ensures we deliver the right solutions that keep our customers' operations up and running today and better equipped for tomorrow.

*Spark Power welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.*

2270d0f8104b5629d656.title: Quality & Compliance Operations Coordinator
2270d0f8104b5629d656.description:
**Change Lives With Recovery Innovations!** Our **Mission** is to empower people on their journey to recovery, helping them achieve their goals, rediscover meaning and purpose in life, and reconnect with themselves and their communities. Our **Vision** is to revolutionize healthcare by pioneering innovative solutions that go beyond behavioral health, empowering people to thrive in the communities where they live, work, and play. Join a groundbreaking team at the forefront of **Peer-Powered Support**, empowering individuals on their journey through mental health and substance use challenges! Be part of something bigger—together, we can change lives and create lasting hope!

**Position: Quality & Compliance Operations Coordinator**

**Job Type:** Full-Time; Exempt

**Shift Details:** Monday- Friday 8:00 AM-5:00 PM

**Work Location:** Remote - Travel required based on business needs

**Salary/Hourly Wage:** $55,000.00 - $65,000.00/annually

**Specialties / Licenses or Certifications:**

**Summary of Job:** The Quality & Compliance Operations Coordinator provides high-reliability administrative, data and workflow infrastructure for the Quality & Compliance department in a multi-state behavioral health organization. The position maintains safety and compliance trackers, performs and quality-checks Project and work management system(s) and related data entry, administers policy and QC support-ticket workflows, maintains CAP/POC and audit trackers, monitors approved automations and recurring tasks, supports regulation-monitoring workflows, prepares reports and meeting materials, maintains audit trails and escalates exceptions. The role is designed for a systems-minded professional who can improve reliability, reduce administrative friction and help qualified reviewers focus on risk and improvement. The position does not independently interpret regulations, make clinical determinations, approve CAPs/POCs, own incident/RCA processes or accept compliance risk.  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**1. Quality & Compliance Administrative Support:**

* Maintains approved safety, facility, licensing-support, audit, CAP/POC, policy, QC support-ticket, and recurring compliance trackers with accurate owners, due dates, evidence status, and escalation fields.
* Builds accountability into approved systems through named owners, due dates, required evidence, automated reminders, aging, escalation thresholds, dashboards, and visible exception reporting.
* Does not assume responsibility for repeatedly chasing departments or completing work owned by other functions. Maintains visibility, sends system-driven reminders as designed, and escalates overdue or high-risk exceptions to the accountable leader and QC leadership.
* Performs completeness checks, follows up on missing administrative information, and prepares exception lists for qualified QC review.
* Prepares agendas, current trackers, status reports, meeting packets, action logs, and approved QC newsletter materials.

**2. Data, Work Management Platform & Automation Administration:**

* Creates, updates and quality-checks authorized Project and work management system(s) records for policies, QC support tickets, audits, CAPs/POCs, action items, evidence, aging and status.
* Maintains standardized fields, naming conventions, templates, recurring tasks, permissions requests and dashboard source data.
* Maps current-state and future-state QC workflows and identifies non-value added steps, duplicate entry, avoidable handoffs, waiting, rework, and control gaps.
* Partners with Information Technology and the Project Management Office to document requirements, prioritize workflow improvements, test changes, validate automations, support user acceptance testing, and maintain change-control evidence.
* Supports Lean Six Sigma/DMAIC improvement work through process maps, baseline data, cycle-time and defect tracking, action logs, and control-plan administration.
* Performs scheduled health checks of approved reminders, recurring tasks, alerts, dashboards, and integrations.
* Corrects routine configuration or data issues within assigned access; documents automation failures, affected records and administrative impact; and promptly escalates control gaps or system issues.
* Measures whether approved improvements reduce manual effort, duplication, waiting, rework, or data defects and reports results and exceptions to QC leadership.

**3. Compliance & Risk Management:**

* Maintains approved regulatory-source lists and administrative monitoring schedules and routes outputs or potential changes to qualified QC reviewers.
* Maintains search logs, distribution evidence, audit trails and exception records as directed.
* Maintains CAP/POC trackers, evidence links, monitoring dates, responsible owners and status without determining sufficiency or formal closure.
* Keeps abreast of assigned Recovery Innovations policies and procedures as they change or are modified.
* Understands and adheres to Recovery Innovations compliance standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies.
* Does not independently interpret statutes, regulations, accreditation standards, payer requirements or legal obligations.
* Does not own incident reporting, incident management, incident investigations or incident root-cause analyses.

**4. Cross Functional Collaboration:**

* Works collaboratively with Quality & Compliance, Operations, Nursing, Medical Leadership, Human Resources, Learning & Development, Information Technology, the Project Management Office, Revenue Cycle Management, and other support departments to improve workflow reliability and accountability.
* Helps users navigate approved intake and workflow processes and routes substantive questions to the appropriate subject-matter owner.
* Communicates barriers and exceptions early, follows documented escalation pathways and avoids decisions outside assigned authority.

**5. Additional Duties:**

* Performs other related duties assigned that are consistent with the position’s qualifications and administrative scope.

**Your well-being and success are our priority at RI—explore our benefits and discover how we invest in YOU every step of the way!** As an innovative leader in behavioral health care, we are committed to supporting our teams through a comprehensive benefits package. This includes competitive health, dental, and vision insurance, as well as access to mental health resources and wellness programs. We offer a strong retirement plan with company matching and generous paid time off to support work-life balance. In addition, we provide ongoing opportunities for professional development and training to help you advance in your career. We value the contributions of our team members and are dedicated to fostering a supportive, inclusive environment where you can thrive both personally and professionally.

  

**Job Requirements:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed must be representative of the knowledge, skills, minimum education, training, licensure, experience, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

**1. Education/Licenses:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, information systems, quality, compliance or related field preferred.

**2. Experience:**

* Minimum of two years of administrative coordination, data management, project support, workflow administration, process improvement, healthcare operations, quality/compliance support, or closely related experience.
* Three or more years of relevant experience and experience in behavioral health, healthcare compliance, audits, policy management, licensing, safety tracking, corrective-action workflows, automation, or regulated operations strongly preferred.
* Experience partnering with IT/PMO, supporting enterprise systems, workflow automation, data-quality controls, regulated documentation, or audit-ready evidence preferred.
* Experience in a multi-state or matrixed organization preferred.

**3. Skills:**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint or comparable tools.
* Demonstrated proficiency with workflow, automation, reporting, or document-control platforms, including ClickUp, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Lists, Microsoft Forms, SharePoint, dashboards, or ticketing systems. Equivalent transferable experience will be considered.
* Ability to facilitate basic process-mapping sessions, identify waste and duplication, translate user needs into documented workflow requirements, and collaborate effectively with IT, PMO, and business owners.
* Ability to support structured process improvement using Lean Six Sigma/DMAIC concepts, including baseline measures, root-cause analysis support, testing, control plans, and benefit tracking.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to produce accurate, auditable data entry, record maintenance, status reporting, and exception tracking.
* Ability to identify control failures, document impact, conduct structured troubleshooting, and escalate exceptions without exceeding assigned authority.
* Strong organizational, written, verbal, customer-service, facilitation, and follow-up skills.

**4. Driving Requirements:**

* If driving is required for this position, must meet all requirements outlined in Recovery Innovations’ driving policy.
* If not qualified to drive per policy, a Non-Driver Attestation form must be signed.

**5. Miscellaneous Requirement(s):**

* Must be at least 18 years old unless residing in a state where funder or government regulations set a different minimum age requirement.
* Travel may be required for planned audits, surveys, implementations, training, meetings or facility support. HR must specify anticipated frequency and whether driving is an essential function in the final posting.
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality, including HIPAA and 42 C.F.R. Part 2 requirements where applicable, and professionalism.
* Must be able to complete and meet applicable credentialing, background, education verification, fingerprinting, substance-abuse testing, tuberculosis testing and motor-vehicle requirements as determined by HR, funders, law and organizational policy.
* Recovery Innovations is a Second-Chance Employer.
* Must complete department onboarding, systems/access training and applicable competency validation.
* Final work location, geographic differential, travel requirement and remote/hybrid expectations must be confirmed by HR.

**Physical Demands:**

May include work close to the eyes and substantial motions of the wrist, hands, and/or fingers. Frequent sitting, standing, walking, handling and finger dexterity; eye-hand coordination; use of corrected vision; color vision; and use of auditory senses. May be required to lift up to twenty (20) pounds. HR should confirm the final physical-demand statement based on the approved duties and work location.

**Work Environment:**

May work remotely, in an office environment or in a behavioral health facility. Work may involve access to sensitive clinical, personnel, audit and regulatory information and periodic presence in active behavioral health settings. Travel and schedule flexibility may be required for planned audits, implementations, training, surveys or facility support; HR should specify the anticipated frequency and approved work location in the posting.

  

**Recovery Innovations** is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. Our hiring practices are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of any characteristic protected by law. We strive to create a workplace where every employee feels valued and respected.

Recovery Innovations is a second chance employer and evaluates all qualified applicants fairly, including those with criminal histories, in accordance with legal and funder requirements. Applicants needing reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process may submit a request through the organization’s accommodation process. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature and classification of employment.

The compensation for this role is a proposed salary range of $55,000 to $70,000 annually. Compensation decisions consider skill set, experience, training, education, licensure, certifications, internal equity, geographic differential and organizational needs. Final compensation depends on the facts and circumstances of each case and requires applicable HR, Finance and executive approval. The posting should identify the approved work location(s) and disclose any location-specific range or geographic differential required by applicable law.

986dd2c4a2ee4a753f8a.title: Human Resources Payroll Coordinator
986dd2c4a2ee4a753f8a.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Human Resources Payroll Coordinator, you’ll keep payroll and personnel processes accurate, organized, and compliant. You’ll coordinate payroll processing, maintain employee records, and support benefits administration and day-to-day human resources management. Your work will connect reliable data and responsive employee support with effective workforce operations.

**Duties**

* Process payroll and review data for accuracy; use Excel data analysis to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain HRIS (human resources information system) records, handle confidential information, and support personnel administration and regulatory compliance management.
* Respond to employee questions and assist with employee relations, benefits administration, workers’ compensation, and Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) processes.
* Support recruiting, talent acquisition, HR sourcing, interviewing, employee orientation, and employee evaluation.
* Coordinate HR projects and contribute to change management, workforce management, performance management, training and development, strategic planning, organization design, affirmative action planning, and succession planning.

Your impact: Accurate payroll and timely HR support help employees understand their records and help the organization maintain dependable, compliant operations.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in payroll processing, human resources, HR department operations, or administrative work; knowledge of employment and labor law, HR legal compliance, and employment law in talent management.
* Strong communication, data entry, data collection, conflict management, and project management skills; able to handle contracts and confidential information responsibly.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and HR systems; experience with HRIS, ATS (applicant tracking systems), and payroll platforms is useful.
* Experience with systems such as Workday, ADP, Paychex, Dayforce, Kronos, UltiPro, Paylocity, Ceridian, PeopleSoft, Oracle HCM, or SAP SuccessFactors is preferred. Familiarity with Lever, Taleo, iCIMS, Kenexa BrassRing, Salesforce, social media management, or OSHA requirements is also helpful.

Pay: $29.98 - $36.11 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

cd3e4ee66a573d6c3918.description:
Oak View Group:

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director of Parking & Mobility, the **Event Administration Coordinator** will assist all aspects of OVG Parking's Special Event Operations. This position will primarily support one-time and non-traditional events that typically take place outside of a standing venue, including music festivals, golf events, fairs, community events, and other large-scale special events. The Event Adminstration Coordinator will assist with coordinating event team payroll, staffing, scheduling, logistics, and communication.

This role pays an hourly rate of $27.50.

**Benefits for Part-Time roles: 401(k) Savings Plan and 401(k) matching.**

**This position will remain open until February 19, 2027.**

Responsibilities:

* Provide administrative and operational support to OVG Parking's Special Event Operations team, assisting with the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of events nationwide.
* Coordinate employee scheduling and staffing assignments for special events, ensuring appropriate staffing levels based on operational requirements and event needs.
* Use employee scheduling platforms to create shifts, update assignments, track availability, and communicate schedule changes.
* Assist with payroll administration, including reviewing employee timecards, verifying hours worked, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring accurate and timely payroll submissions.
* Coordinate with internal management teams, staffing agencies, and third-party labor providers to fulfill event staffing requirements.
* Maintain accurate employee records, staffing rosters, contact lists, attendance reports, and other event-related documentation.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for event employees, providing information regarding scheduling, reporting locations, uniforms, event expectations, and other logistical details.
* Assist with employee onboarding, including collecting required documentation, coordinating training, and ensuring employees are properly prepared for event assignments.
* Support event logistics, including coordinating staff travel, accommodations, transportation, credentials, uniforms, equipment, and other operational needs.
* Prepare and distribute event-specific communications, including employee instructions, schedules, operational updates, and post-event information.
* Assist with tracking event labor expenses, staffing costs, payroll budgets, and other operational expenditures.
* Support the preparation of event staffing plans, operational documents, deployment schedules, and administrative reports.
* Coordinate with OVG Parking leadership and event management teams to identify staffing challenges, resolve administrative issues, and support efficient event operations.
* Maintain organized records of event expenses, vendor invoices, purchase orders, and other financial documentation.
* Assist with post-event reconciliation, including final payroll reviews, staffing reports, expense tracking, and operational closeout documentation.
* Support compliance with company policies, payroll procedures, labor regulations, and established operational standards.
* Provide remote administrative support to onsite event management teams during event setup, operations, and breakdown.
* Assist with onsite event operations and administrative functions as needed, including occasional travel to special event locations.
* Maintain flexibility to support events occurring during evenings, weekends, and holidays based on operational needs.
* Perform additional administrative and operational duties as assigned by the Director of Parking & Mobility.

Qualifications:

* 1-2+ years of experience in administrative support, event operations, staffing coordination, or a related field is preferred.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate's or bachelor's degree is preferred.
* Previous experience in parking operations, event management, hospitality, or large-scale special events is preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Experience with employee scheduling, timekeeping, payroll administration, and workforce management systems is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently, solve problems, and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling employee and company information.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, and travel as needed.

Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference:

At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our **people**, improves our **service**, and raises our **excellence**. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Oak View Group is committed to equal employment opportunity. We will not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis (“protected class”) including, but not limited to veteran status, uniform service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law.

0ce8b150dbcf1fa4b2eb.title: HR/Benefits Coordinator
0ce8b150dbcf1fa4b2eb.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

* **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Title:** HR/Benefits Coordinator

**Position Location:** Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

**JOB SUMMARY**

The HR/Benefits Coordinator supports day-to-day HR operations, employee benefits administration, onboarding, compliance tracking, employee records, and general employee support. This role is a key point of contact for employees and managers, helping ensure HR and Talent processes are accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-friendly.

The HR/Benefits Coordinator is organized, responsive, discreet, and comfortable working with employee data, talent acquisition, HR systems, and benefits-related processes.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Serve as the point of contact for new hires after they accept their offers through Talent Acquisition through their onboarding date; onboarding facilitation backup
* Coordinate, follow-up and enter employee onboarding, offboarding, and employment changes in HR systems
* Maintain accurate employee records, I-9 verifications, E-Verify, I-9 processing, benefits documentation, and HR compliance materials
* Support benefits administration, including enrollments, qualifying life events, employee questions, carrier coordination, and open enrollment preparation
* Assist employees with benefits-related questions and escalate complex issues to HR leadership, brokers, carriers, or vendors as needed
* Track required documentation, acknowledgments, policy forms, and compliance-related employee submissions; enter employee data into background check platforms
* Support leave administration, reports, workers’ compensation coordination, and accommodation request tracking as directed
* Help prepare HR reports related to headcount, benefits participation, onboarding, compliance, and employee data changes
* Coordinate HR communications (HR Tickets, HR Inbox), reminders, and employee-facing materials
* Partner with payroll to ensure benefit deductions, employment changes, and employee data updates are processed accurately
* Support HR audits by gathering records, reconciling data, and identifying missing or inconsistent information
* Coordinate and communicate company equipment, shipping/packaging logistics
* Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information with discretion
* Assist with HR projects, process improvements, employee engagement efforts, and policy updates (HR Employee Hub)

**Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time with strong attention to detail**

*Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned*

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS (INTERMEDIATE LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)**

* Prior experience in HR, benefits administration, payroll support, office administration, or employee operations preferred; Rippling HRIS experience a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Comfortable handling confidential employee information.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Familiarity with HRIS, payroll, benefits, or document management systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of employee benefits, onboarding, compliance documentation, and HR processes is a plus.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, email, and standard business software.
* Accuracy and follow-through
* Benefits administration support
* Confidentiality and sound judgment
* Process coordination
* Vendor and carrier communication
* Data entry and recordkeeping
* HR compliance awareness
* Employee-service mindset
* Problem-solving and escalation judgment

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

* Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
* Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
* Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
* Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
* On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
* On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

**TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Up to 5%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
* Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position
* Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need
* Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* One to three years of HR, benefits, payroll, or administrative experience preferred

**BENEFITS**

*Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include*

* Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)

* Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!
