e8eac363718f14583ac7.title: Administrative Coordinator, Mission Operations
e8eac363718f14583ac7.description:
The preferred candidate location is within the Central or Mountain Time Zone.

  

**WHO WE ARE!**

  

Susan G. Komen is a force united by a promise to end breast cancer forever. For over 40 years, we've led the way funding groundbreaking research, community health initiatives and advocacy programs in local communities across the U.S. Susan G. Komen is the ONLY organization that addresses breast cancer on multiple fronts such as research, community health, global outreach, and public policy initiatives to make the biggest impact against this disease.

  

Komen strives to have a culture of passionate, growth-minded professionals who thrive in a team environment and work collaboratively to inspire greatness in others! We take an ongoing approach to ensure open communication from all levels throughout the organization. It’s encouraged to give and receive feedback to ensure two-way accountability with a focus on continual improvement both personally and professionally!

  

**What you will be doing in the role of an Admin Coordinator, Mission Operations**

  

The primary role of the Administrative Coordinator, Mission Operations is to provide day to day administrative support focused on financial tasks that keep the Mission Operations team running smoothly. The coordinator provides direct assistance to leadership by tracking deadlines, anticipating challenges, and handling the "heavy lifting" of data entry, document preparation, and auditing, ensuring that departmental processes stay on track and organized.

  

**What you will bring to the table**

  

* Support annual budgeting process and quarterly budget forecasting across more than 10 departmental budgets, working closely with Manager, Mission Operations and Sr. Manager, Mission Operations ensuring deadlines are met and best practices are followed to submit budgets.
* Assist Mission Operations leadership with preparation and management of cross-departmental mission program budgets that may include restricted funding.
* Project and activity codes Coordinate across departments to track and report on Mission interdepartmental budgets and costs using accurate project and activity codes,
* Assist Mission Operations leadership with mission restricted revenue tracking and releasing of funds.
* Utilize expert level Excel skills for creation of dynamic reporting.
* Serve as main point of contact for the Mission Help Desk and the MyKomenHealth Website Support Desk providing excellent customer service with a high degree of professionalism while interacting with internal and external individuals to resolve problems, answer questions, and provide general information on multiple communication platforms in a timely manner.
* Organizing, maintaining and archiving files/records on a SharePoint platform.
* Enter and maintain data into various databases, spreadsheets and other data-collection and file management systems including but not limited to SharePoint, Asana, Jira, and MS-Teams.
* Support project management efforts by tracking resources, monitoring deadlines, and escalating matters as appropriate.
* Assist mission teams with accounting duties as needed invoices, expense reports, travel authorizations, etc.
* Coordinate periodic mission processes including, but not limited to, contract renewals with the legal department; software licensing; time and effort coordination; updates to shared travel and event calendars; etc.
* Utilize critical thinking to identify problems, challenges and opportunities to close process gaps, proactively identify day-to-day workflow bottlenecks and suggest practical solutions to leadership.
* Additional duties as assigned.

  

**We know you will have and be able to**

  

* High school diploma or equivalent and 3-4 years of experience in providing administrative support to a project management team, accounting/financial office or IT department.
* Strong Excel skills including ability to create and manage pivot tables, run complex formulas, and create data-visualization aids like charts, graphs, and other graphics
* Detail-oriented, and professional attitude with strong administrative, organizational and time management skills.
* Problem-solving skills.
* Ability to navigate complex, urgent, and confidential situations with poise.
* Strong customer service skills and ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing with a variety of internal and external people.
* Ability to recognize unnecessary workflow steps and improve productivity.
* Openness to and capability of learning new processes, technology platforms and systems to support the needs of the mission department.
* Ability to apply solutions to a multitude of situations.

  

**So, what’s in it for you?**

  

Komen believes in the importance of taking care of our employees so that in turn they can be committed to supporting our critical mission to support those impacted by breast cancer and to help find cures. This is what Komen provides away from the computer:

  

* Competitive rate of $21.03 - $26.67/hourly; exact compensation ranges are based on a range of factors including but not limited to the labor market, job level, internal equity, and budget. Offers given will take into consideration the candidate's skills, education, experience, geographic location, and other necessary credentials.
* Health, dental, vision and a retirement plan with a 6% employer match
* Unlimited Paid Time Off Plan
* Flexible work arrangement in a fully remote working environment
* Bi-weekly work from home stipend
* Parental leave
* Tuition Reimbursement
* A culture of learning and development, and so much more!

  

Komen provides a remote and/or home-based working environment for all active employees. Komen defines remote as the ability to work from any physical location within the U.S. where an employee can perform specified work duties without disruption or distraction. Komen defines home-based roles as positions that are required to reside in a specific market. Work schedules for both remote and home based are determined by the organizational needs of each department.

  

**Susan G. Komen is fair and equal in all its employment practices for people without regard to age, race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation. Additionally, we embrace diverse teams & perspective, and we find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.**

  

SORRY, NO AGENCIES

#LI-REMOTE

  

The physical location for the candidate selected must remain within the contiguous United States. In the event a move is expected to occur by the candidate selected, it must be approved by Komen's HR team prior to the move.

5cb2f51c2cff58a3da6d.title: Food Security and Livelihoods (FSL) Coordinator
5cb2f51c2cff58a3da6d.description:
18 Nov 2026

23 Nov 2026 - 20:59 UTC

Worldwide

Programme Operations

  

ROLE PURPOSE: Save the Children is seeking a technically competent and results-oriented Food Security and Livelihoods Coordinator to lead the initial four-month implementation phase of a fisheries value chain development initiative in Lokipetot, Turkana County. The initiative aims to strengthen the livelihoods, resilience, and economic opportunities of fishing households, women, and youth by addressing critical constraints across the local fisheries value chain. The coordinator will provide day-to-day technical leadership and oversee field implementation, working closely with fishing communities, community-based organisations, relevant county and national government departments, private sector actors, and other key stakeholders. During the initial phase, the coordinator will focus on facilitating access to productive fishing assets, establishing a digital landing-site and catch-monitoring system, supporting women-led enterprises engaged in fish production and trade, and leading the collection, analysis, and use of production, market, and livelihood data. Evidence generated during this phase will inform the design, prioritisation, and investment decisions for a subsequent phase of the programme, including potential investments in fish aggregation, preservation, cold storage, and market infrastructure. The coordinator will ensure that all proposed investments are informed by verified production volumes, demonstrated market demand, operational feasibility, community priorities, and long-term sustainability considerations. This is a time-bound position, with performance assessed against clearly defined four-month deliverables and implementation milestones.
  
**PROGRAMME CONTEXT:**
  
Fishing households in Lokipetot face a range of interconnected constraints that limit the productivity, profitability, and resilience of the local fisheries value chain. These challenges include inadequate access to appropriate fishing equipment and productive assets, weak catch recording and landing-site data systems, limited aggregation and marketing structures, inadequate fish handling and preservation facilities, high post-harvest losses, insufficient market information, and limited access to finance. In addition, women engaged in fisheries-related economic activities require strengthened enterprise development support, improved access to markets, and greater participation in higher-value segments of the value chain.The initiative will adopt a phased market systems development approach. During the initial four-month phase, the focus will be on establishing and testing the core productive, information, and enterprise foundations necessary for sustainable fisheries value chain growth. Key investments will target increased production capacity, improved data collection and management systems, strengthened women-led enterprises, and enhanced market linkages.Any subsequent investment in fish aggregation, preservation, cold-chain, or market infrastructure will be informed by verified production data, demonstrated market demand, operational feasibility, and community priorities, rather than assumptions regarding future growth. This evidence-based approach will ensure that future investments are technically sound, commercially viable, and responsive to local needs and opportunities.SCOPE OF ROLE: The Food Security and Livelihoods Coordinator will provide overall technical and operational leadership for the implementation of the Lokipetot Fisheries Initiative. The role will be responsible for coordinating day-to-day project activities, ensuring timely delivery of outputs, and maintaining effective collaboration among all key stakeholders. **KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:** Fisheries Value Chain Coordination and Work Planning - Project Coordination and Stakeholder Engagement:

* Develop, maintain, and regularly update a practical four-month implementation plan, detailed activity schedule, and deliverables tracker, ensuring clear sequencing of activities, defined responsibilities, realistic timelines, and effective management of interdependencies.
* Coordinate the implementation of project activities across fisheries production, catch monitoring, women-led enterprise development, and market engagement, ensuring alignment with project objectives and agreed milestones.
* Conduct and maintain a comprehensive mapping of fisheries value chain actors, including fishers, boat owners, traders, processors, transporters, buyers, service providers, community-based organisations, financial service providers, and relevant government departments.
* Facilitate regular coordination and technical engagement with the **Turkana County Department of Fisheries**, other relevant government agencies, community leadership structures, and private sector actors to promote alignment, technical oversight, collaboration, and local ownership.
* Monitor implementation progress and identify operational, technical, and stakeholder-related bottlenecks at an early stage, proposing practical and timely corrective actions to the Project Team Lead to support effective project delivery.

**Productive Assets and Fisheries Production:**

* Coordinate transparent community engagement, beneficiary identification, and verification processes for the provision of productive assets, including fishing boats and appropriate fishing equipment, in accordance with approved project criteria, procurement procedures, and accountability standards.
* Collaborate with fisheries officers, community representatives, and relevant stakeholders to ensure that all assets are appropriate, safe, fit for purpose, and allocated to eligible beneficiaries through transparent and equitable processes.
* Support the development and implementation of asset handover, utilisation, maintenance, ownership, and accountability arrangements, including clearly defined responsibilities for operation, care, and sustainability.
* Promote responsible and sustainable fishing practices and ensure that all supported activities comply with applicable fisheries regulations, environmental requirements, and safeguarding standards.
* Establish and maintain a practical asset-tracking system to monitor distribution, utilisation, functionality, maintenance status, and contribution to fisheries production and household livelihoods.

**Digital Landing-Site and Catch Monitoring:**

* Lead the design, testing, and operationalisation of a simple, user-friendly digital catch and landing-site monitoring system in collaboration with the MEAL team, fisheries officers, and relevant stakeholders.
* Define and maintain a minimum dataset covering, as appropriate, landing date and location, fisher or group identifier, species caught, quantity or weight, fishing effort, sale price, buyer details, and destination markets.
* Establish and oversee data collection tools, enumerator roles and responsibilities, verification procedures, data quality controls, and reporting protocols to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Train community-based data collectors, fisheries actors, and relevant stakeholders on the accurate, timely, and ethical collection and reporting of catch and landing-site information.
* Produce regular analytical summaries and dashboards on catch volumes, species composition, landing trends, market prices, and other agreed performance indicators to support programme learning and decision-making.
* Ensure responsible data management, informed participation, confidentiality, and full compliance with Save the Children policies and data protection requirements.

**Women's Enterprise Development and Inclusive Livelihoods:**

* Identify, assess, and profile women-led and women-participating enterprises engaged in fish production, processing, handling, aggregation, transportation, trading, and related support services.
* Support selected enterprises to develop practical business improvement plans, including basic financial management, costing, pricing, cash-flow forecasting, market analysis, and growth planning.
* Facilitate business and market linkages between women's enterprises, fishers, traders, buyers, suppliers, financial service providers, and relevant business development organisations.
* Assess barriers limiting women's participation in the fisheries value chain, including constraints related to productive assets, finance, information, mobility, decision-making, and market access, and recommend feasible and context-appropriate solutions.
* Promote meaningful participation of women and youth in fisheries governance structures, producer groups, and value chain decision-making processes while ensuring the application of safeguarding, gender, and social inclusion standards.

**MEAL, Reporting, Learning, and Adaptive Management:**

* Work closely with the MEAL team to develop and operationalise a practical results framework, baseline measures, output tracking tools, performance indicators, and data quality assurance mechanisms for the four-month implementation phase.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of beneficiaries reached, assets distributed, asset utilisation, catch-monitoring coverage, fisheries production data, supported enterprises, and market actors engaged.
* Conduct routine field monitoring visits and document implementation progress, emerging risks, community feedback, lessons learned, and corrective actions to support adaptive programme management.
* Prepare concise monthly progress reports and a comprehensive end-of-phase implementation report detailing achievements against targets, key results, expenditure status, implementation challenges, lessons learned, and recommendations for scale-up.
* Consolidate and analyse verified production, business, and market data into an evidence package to inform subsequent programme design and investment decisions, including recommendations related to aggregation, preservation, cold-chain systems, and market infrastructure.
* Ensure that community feedback, complaints, and concerns are received, documented, referred, and addressed through established Save the Children accountability and feedback mechanisms

**Partnership Management, Safeguarding, and Compliance:**

* Build and maintain effective working relationships with community structures, local organisations, county government departments, fisheries authorities, private sector actors, and other strategic stakeholders.
* Support the capacity strengthening of partners, community groups, and relevant stakeholders on agreed technical, operational, accountability, and safeguarding standards.
* Ensure full compliance with Save the Children policies and procedures relating to child safeguarding, Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), the Code of Conduct, fraud prevention, health and safety, procurement, and financial accountability.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate safeguarding concerns, environmental and social risks, conflict sensitivities, operational incidents, and compliance issues through appropriate reporting and management channels.
* Promote accountability to affected populations through transparent beneficiary targeting and selection processes, meaningful community participation, accessible feedback mechanisms, and inclusive programme implementation.

Skills and Behaviours (Our Values in Practice):

* **Accountability:** Demonstrates personal responsibility for delivering high-quality results within agreed timelines; manages resources, assets, and information transparently and responsibly; follows through on commitments; and ensures accurate reporting, documentation, and compliance with project requirements.
* **Collaboration:** Builds and maintains effective working relationships with fishing communities, women's groups, youth representatives, government departments, implementing partners, and private sector actors; values diverse perspectives; and works effectively across multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared objectives.
* **Integrity:** Acts with honesty, fairness, and professionalism in all interactions; exercises sound judgement and discretion; promotes transparency in beneficiary selection, procurement, data management, and stakeholder engagement; and consistently upholds Save the Children's policies and ethical standards.
* **Creativity:** Applies innovative and practical thinking to address operational, technical, and market system challenges; uses evidence, local knowledge, and stakeholder feedback to identify solutions that are feasible, sustainable, and contextually relevant.
* **Ambition:** Maintains a strong focus on achieving results and delivering impact; sets high standards for performance; takes initiative to overcome challenges; and seeks continuous improvements in livelihoods, fisheries productivity, market access, and value chain performance.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in **Fisheries and Aquaculture, Aquatic Sciences, Agriculture, Agribusiness, Food Security and Livelihoods, Natural Resource Management, Economics, Development Studies**, or a related field. A relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
* Minimum of **Seven (7) years' progressive professional experience** in food security and livelihoods programming, fisheries development, aquaculture, market systems development, enterprise development, resilience programming, or community-based economic empowerment initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience working with **small-scale fishing communities** and a strong understanding of fisheries value chains, including fish production, handling, processing, post-harvest loss reduction, aggregation, marketing, and market access.
* Proven experience supporting **women-led and youth-led enterprises**, producer groups, cooperatives, savings groups, community-based organisations, or other livelihood-focused community structures.
* Practical experience in designing, establishing, or managing field-level monitoring and information management systems, including the use of digital data collection platforms such as **KoboToolbox, ODK, CommCare**, or similar tools. Experience with digital catch-monitoring systems is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate field implementation, manage short-term implementation plans, oversee multiple workstreams, engage effectively with government institutions, community stakeholders, and private sector actors, and deliver results within demanding timelines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret production, business, and market data and translate findings into practical recommendations and programme decisions.
* Excellent report-writing, documentation, facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience working in **ASAL (Arid and Semi-Arid Lands)** contexts, resilience programming, or humanitarian-development nexus initiatives will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of **Turkana County**, including local livelihoods systems, fishing communities, community structures, county government processes, and fisheries institutions, is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated commitment to safeguarding, gender equality, social inclusion, accountability to affected populations, and ethical programme implementation.
* Fluency in written and spoken **English** is required. Working knowledge of **Kiswahili** and relevant local languages spoken in Turkana County will be an added advantage.

**Desirable Competencies:**

* Understanding of fisheries governance, co-management approaches, and community-based natural resource management.
* Experience working with county government departments, particularly fisheries, trade, cooperatives, and livelihoods sectors.
* Familiarity with market systems development (MSD) and value chain strengthening approaches.
* Ability to work independently in remote locations while maintaining high standards of coordination, professionalism, and stakeholder engagement.
* Experience generating evidence and analysis to inform investment decisions, business cases, and programme scale-up.
* Strong project coordination and implementation skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.
* Demonstrated understanding of market systems development, value chain strengthening, and livelihood programming.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and partnership management skills.
* Excellent analytical, planning, monitoring, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to interpret and use production, market, and livelihood data to inform decision-making.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including report writing and presentation of findings.
* Commitment to safeguarding, gender equality, inclusion, accountability to affected populations, and ethical programme delivery.
* Ability to work independently in remote and challenging field environments while maintaining high standards of professionalism and teamwork.

**THE ORGANIZATION**
  
We employ approximately 25,000 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard.
  
We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030:

* No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday.
* All children learn from a quality basic education and that,
* Violence against children is no longer tolerated.
  

**Save the Children is an equal opportunity employer and seeks to employ and assign the best-qualified talent.**
  
**Female Candidates are encouraged to apply**.

We do not use recruiting persons or agencies to help us identify candidates for employment. If you’re contacted by a person promising you recruitment or placement at SCI for a charge, do not accept, and please get in touch with us at** **SCIFraud@savethechildren.org****.**
  
  
**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**

**Our Mission**
---------------

As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers.

This role sits within Glassdoor, where professionals go to find their fit. We’re reinventing the job search to replace endless scrolling and mass applying with smarter, tailored matches. Known for our real employee reviews, we pair our deep knowledge of companies with each job seeker’s goals and Indeed’s job listings — so great jobs find them.

Join us as we make worklife better, together.

(\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026)

**Day to Day**
--------------

The Glassdoor Business Unit of Indeed has a unique mission to make worklife better for everyone. We are looking for an experienced Director of B2B Marketing to lead Glassdoor’s marketing strategy for employers in close partnership with GTM and product teams.

This role resides within Glassdoor’s Product Marketing team and plays a crucial role in driving growth within our Enterprise client segment. We are looking for a marketing leader grounded in marketing fundamentals with a passion for and track record of advocating for customer needs and driving business results. This is a key leadership role on the marketing team managing a functional team of three including two PMMs and leading a cross-functional marketing workstream team focused on driving Enterprise value for Indeed through the Glassdoor brand.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Marketing and monetization strategy: Set marketing strategy for the integration of Glassdoor’s products into Indeed’s marketing and sales efforts. Identify opportunities for Glassdoor products, through product development and marketing.
* Messaging and positioning: Own differentiated messaging and storytelling for the Employer audience. Set the messaging architecture, proof points, claims, and positioning that set our solutions apart in the market, and make it the standard that Product, Marketing, and Sales all work from.
* Develop market strategy in collaboration with Business Operations, UX Research and Insights and Indeed Sales teams. Partner closely with sales and marketing teams across Indeed to set clear goals and measure success.
* Cross-functional partnership and influence: Partner with Product from roadmap through launch to shape employer-centric solutions for the target Employer audience. Own the Sales and Enablement relationship — turning positioning into the narratives, objection handling, and deal support sellers actually use, and building the feedback loop that tells you what's working in the field. Lead, and grow the B2B product marketing team.

**Skills/Competencies**
-----------------------

* Requires a minimum of 17 years of related experience; or a minimum of 15 years with a Bachelor’s degree; or 12 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 8 years experience.
* Experience in Marketing or Product Marketing roles, including B2B SaaS, with experience leading and developing product marketers
* Proven ability to influence Go To Market strategy and product roadmap decisions through a deep understanding of audience needs, market insights, and user behavior — grounded in research, data, and strong product intuition
* Demonstrated expertise in crafting narratives, messaging, and positioning that resonate with target audiences, translate product value, and drive adoption and engagement across a portfolio
* Demonstrated track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies, shaping pricing and packaging, and building enablement that sellers adopt — delivering measurable commercial outcomes
* Solid analytical skills and fluency with commercial metrics, pinpoint the insight that matters, and turn those into actionable recommendations
* Demonstrated relationship building across functions and levels, determining key partners' point of view and developing the storytelling to meet it, including bringing complex trade-offs to leadership for decision

90f66023a8fab0ef7669.description:
Are you an experienced, passionate program / project manager with a focus on technology driven transformations - a problem solver, solutions builder, a roll-up-your-sleeves program manager - a solutions builder who wants a daily collaborative environment, think-tank feel and share new ideas with your colleagues in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities?  
  
If so, consider an opportunity with our Human Capital Major Programs & Project Management (MPPM) team. We deliver proven solutions to help drive transformation, improve productivity, and streamline business operations in all areas of project and program management.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/4/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
As a Manager, Project and Program Management on the Human Capital Major Programs & Project Management (MPPM) team, you will be responsible for leading complex transformation initiatives, directing project delivery across agile and traditional environments, and driving execution for large-scale client programs.  

* Manage day-to-day interactions with executive clients, stakeholders, and sponsors.
* Lead engagement planning, budgeting, staffing, and delivery team mobilization across complex projects.
* Define project approach, deliverable structure, and work plans; facilitate leadership alignment on proposed solutions.
* Oversee project scope, schedule, costs, risks, assumptions, and constraints, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Lead proposal support, coach team members, and provide guidance on staffing, development, and project management practices.

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
The Human Capital practice helps organizations improve business performance through their people, supporting issues that matter across the C-suite and enterprise.Within that practice, the Human Capital Major Programs & Project Management (MPPM) team helps clients manage large-scale transformation efforts with structured delivery, operational rigor, and sustained support.  
  
The team also works with clients to maintain and extend the value of Human Capital technology investments through integrated services and ongoing portfolio evolution.  
  
**Qualifications**  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree
* 5+ years of management consulting or industry experience
* 5+ years planning and managing project initiatives in a Project Management Office or similar team environment
* 5+ years of experience using project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or Jira
* 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager managing large, complex projects with multi-functional teams
* At least 1 year of hands-on experience applying enterprise project/program management platforms and generative AI tools in portfolio, program, or project management. Must have used at least one enterprise PM platform with native AI capabilities (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, or Asana) and one enterprise GenAI model or assistant (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Gemini) in a real-world workflow
* Ability to travel 0-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:  

* Master's degree
* 5+ years of experience supporting program and project management activities and project oversight
* 5+ years of experience in Human Capital software development life cycle environments using agile and traditional project management methods
* Experience managing onshore, offshore, and remote teams
* Experience with system development life cycle methodologies in the Human Capital space
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. 4026d3d138fd3ae98a3c.title: Warranty Specialist
4026d3d138fd3ae98a3c.description:
At USA Wood Door, we don't just manufacture doors; we create pathways to possibilities. We empower our employees to shape the future of our industry. Join a team where craftsmanship meets cutting-edge technology, and where your ideas can open new doors. Together, we build not just products, but a culture of excellence and collaboration.

Primary Function:

The Warranty Specialist serves as the primary owner of warranty case management and customer issue resolution, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional handling of claims, discrepancies, and service needs. This role acts as a key liaison between Sales Leadership, Production, and Quality to resolve complex warranty concerns, research delivery and invoicing issues, coordinate claim activities, and maintain strong customer relationships. The Specialist contributes to process improvement, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction while upholding USA Wood Door’s commitment to speed, service, and quality. The position reports to the Inside Sales Supervisor at the assigned plant location.

The Key Accountabilities of the Warranty Specialist are as follows.

Key Accountabilities:

**Warranty Claims, Production Alignment & Cross Functional Communication (85%)**

* Lead investigation and resolution of complex warranty issues using established procedures.
* Research delivery, manufacturing, and invoicing discrepancies
* Issues credits, returns and RGA’s based on company’s level of authority matrix.
* Coordinate all work required to resolve claims, including scheduling service or repair appointments.
* Produce weekly and monthly warranty and claim reporting, ensuring leadership has visibility into trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Administer the claims system by assigning claims, balancing workloads, and generating reports.
* Read hardware templates and understand construction principles of internal and outsourced door and frame products.
* Maintain accurate, detailed, and organized records of all warranty interactions, claim histories, supporting documentation, and resolutions.
* Understand production flow, lead times, and capacity constraints to set realistic customer expectations.
* Collaborate with production teams to align delivery schedules and prioritize escalated or high visibility projects.
* Serve as a liaison between sales leadership and manufacturing teams, ensuring consistent communication and issue resolution.
* Identify pricing irregularities and partners with Inside Sales Leadership to resolve issues.
* Work with sales channels regarding key account management, including pricing, warranty concerns, account openings/closings, and large project needs.
* Follow established escalation protocols to ensure efficient and consistent resolution of procedural and customer issues.
* Maintain professional communication through phone and email with customers and internal partners.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Inside Sales Supervisor to ensure positive customer experience.

**Process Improvement & Customer Experience Enhancement (15%)**

* Evaluate warranty claims and communication processes to identify areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with sales, production, and quality teams to strengthen workflows and ensure more robust systems.
* Use initiative and independent judgment within established guidelines to enhance customer satisfaction.
* Promote a collaborative, team-oriented, solution-driven environment.
* Actively identify and communicate opportunities for organizational growth, process improvement, and enhanced customer engagement, contributing to the long-term success of the company.

Job Requirements:

**Educati****on & Certifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree preferred, or a combination of relevant experience in door/frame construction, building supplies, or manufacturing flows.

**Technical Knowledge, Skills, and Experience**

* ***Prefer*** minimum of 5 years of experience in Customer Service, Door/Frame Installations, Order Writing, and/or Warranty; door industry.
* ***Must*** have strong product knowledge related to the Building Materials and/or Door Industry, preferably door specific.
* ***Must*** have Strong decision-making and analytical skills with the ability to handle high complexity.
* ***Must*** be assertive, factual, and accurate in daily work; able to work with minimal direction.
* ***Must*** demonstrate the ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* ***Must*** have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* ***Must*** have the ability to remain calm and professional in stressful situations and when handling difficult customers.
* ***Must*** have strong organizational and multitasking abilities with high attention to detail.
* ***Must*** be able to work independently and collaboratively while meeting daily benchmarks.
* ***Must*** have proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel).
* ***Must*** have strong foundational math skills, including decimals, fractions, discounting, and accurate measurement interpretation.
* **Must** possess excellent proficiency in the English language in reading, writing, speaking, and comprehending.
* **Ability** to visually inspect, read, and verify detailed data, documents, or equipment outputs on a screen or paper.
* **Ability** to perceive and comprehend auditory information or verbal instructions during meetings and phone calls.
* **Ability** to document, compose, and convey clear information and accurate notes in written formats.
* **Must** be able to lift up to 20 pounds independently.
* **Must** be able to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time for an 8–10-hour period.

**Hours, Travel, and Location:**

* Salary non-exempt position with flexibility to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.
* Normal business hours are Monday-Friday between 7 AM and 5 PM, with scheduled shift within that range.
* This position is 100% in-office, located in Thorofare, NJ, Arlington, TX, or Howell, MI. No hybrid. No remote.
* Occasional travel may be required to support customers or company initiatives.

5bc4b69b0b651ecbe23b.title: Senior Director, Field Service
5bc4b69b0b651ecbe23b.description:
EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions helping industrial, infrastructure and defense customers address critical power and operational needs. The company delivers integrated solutions that combine energy storage technologies, power electronics, software-enabled intelligence, technical expertise and comprehensive global customer support. EnerSys supports customers across communications networks, data centers, energy infrastructure, material handling, transportation, aerospace and defense — including applications where power continuity is essential. Serving customers in more than 100 countries, EnerSys helps organizations manage energy more reliably, efficiently and intelligently in complex operating environments where uptime, safety and resilience matter.

**What We’re Offering**

* Paid time off plus paid holidays
* Medical/dental/vision insurance plan
* Life insurance, short/long term disability, tuition reimbursement, flex spending, and employee stock purchase plan
* 401K plan
* Culture: We value and strive for excellence in all that we do through innovative technology by creating long lasting relationships with our stakeholders, co-workers, and customers. We continually strive to foster teamwork, engagement and enhance our employee’s skills and competence by providing appropriate training.

**Compensation Range:** 145,100-181,500 plus sales bonus

Compensation may vary based on applicant's work experience, education level, skill set, and/or location.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

EnerSys seeks a proven operations leader with a documented record of growing and improving a large, geographically dispersed service business. The Senior Director owns operating performance and P&L results for assigned field service operations across the United States and Canada, translating the Board strategy into accountable regional execution.

The role leads EFI operations serving telecom, data center, industrial and broadband customers and coordinates field delivery with the Projects organization. Success requires measurable operating improvements, leadership through transformation, and demonstrated experience launching new products and establishing profitable maintenance programs for emerging technologies.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Revenue Growth**  
Deliver 10.6% year-over-year revenue growth from a base of $150M through FY2031. Translate this objective into regional operating plans supported by bookings, backlog conversion, customer retention, and delivery capacity.

**Profitability**  
Meet approved P&L and cash objectives and deliver approved growth, margin, cash, and customer retention targets.

**Recurring Services**  
Assist with growing maintenance revenue across telecom, broadband, industrial, and data center accounts through new programs for emerging technologies and expanded Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSAs). Track maintenance attachment rates, renewals, and recurring revenue growth.

**Launch Execution**  
Establish field readiness for new product introductions and maintenance programs, with defined launch milestones, trained technicians, validated procedures, parts support, and customer service commitments.

**Service Scale and Customer Confidence**  
Build national coverage with local response through four regional teams and qualified partners. EnerSys employs more than 200 field service technicians. Restore bookings by delivering consistent service, strong customer scorecards, and reliable execution of the new operating model.

**Operations Leadership and Accountability**  
Lead regional directors and managers as one service organization with common standards, clear decision rights, and shared capacity. Set expectations, coach leaders, address underperformance, and build succession plans. Own execution of the operating plan and corrective actions across assigned regions.

**P&L and Financial Management**  
Own budgets, revenue and margin delivery, labor and subcontractor costs, working capital, and forecast accuracy. Review bookings, backlog, staffing, and project estimates with Finance, Sales, and regional leaders. Make resource commitments based on credible demand and operational readiness.

**Operating Governance and Tools**  
Run weekly performance reviews and a monthly operating cadence using consistent KPIs, named owners, and dated corrective actions. Enforce Procore and field service system adoption, accurate reporting, and standard workflows. Monitor utilization, schedule performance, rework, safety, job closure, and customer outcomes.

**Customer Growth and Retention**  
Partner with Sales and Service Solutions leaders to restore bookings, expand national accounts, and convert installed equipment into recurring service contracts. Validate scope, pricing assumptions, staffing, and service levels before commitments. Own operational escalations and customer recovery plans.

**New Product Launches**  
Lead service readiness with Product Management, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain from pilot through commercial launch. Validate installation, commissioning, diagnostics, tooling, technician certification, spare parts, warranty support, and escalation paths. Use formal readiness reviews and field feedback before expanding deployment.

**Workforce and Partner Capacity**  
Build regional capacity plans and a qualified subcontractor network aligned to demand. Advance the training center and apprenticeship program, military and trade recruiting, technical certifications, and leadership development. Hold partners to the same safety, quality, and customer standards as internal teams.

**Project Delivery and Risk Management**  
Coordinate with the Projects organization and PMO on staffing, schedules, change control, closeout, and transition to maintenance. Ensure repeatable field execution and timely escalation of delivery, financial, and contractual risks. Maintain clear ownership between field operations and project management.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**This position requires supervisory experience**

* **Proven operations leadership.** At least 10 years of progressively responsible field service or technical service operations leadership, with demonstrated success leading regional managers and geographically dispersed teams. Candidates must provide measurable examples of revenue growth, margin improvement and sustained operating performance.
* **P&L ownership at scale.** Demonstrated responsibility for a service P&L of $200 million or more in annual revenue across multiple regions or lines of business, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management and working capital accountability.
* **Transformation and execution.** A record of implementing standard operating processes, KPI governance and management accountability across a large service organization. Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, correct underperformance and sustain adoption of new tools and operating practices.
* **New product launch experience.** Direct experience leading service readiness for new product introductions, including pilot execution, technical training, launch criteria, field deployment and post-launch performance improvement.
* **Technical service expertise.** Strong knowledge of critical power, telecom, data center, broadband or industrial service operations, with the ability to lead technical specialists and apply OEM requirements, electrical safety principles and relevant codes to field execution.
* **Commercial and analytical judgment.** Ability to connect customer demand and bookings to workforce capacity, revenue, profitability and cash. Strong executive communication, customer escalation management and cross-functional leadership skills.
* **Systems and education.** Proficiency with field service platforms, financial reporting and project management systems such as Procore. Bachelor’s degree in operations, business, engineering, field service management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* **Culture:** Build a high-performance culture through workforce planning, leadership development, succession planning, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion initiatives, and retention strategies

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

Experience in OEM service, critical power, UPS or DC power systems; national account service delivery across the United States and Canada; and development of training or apprenticeship programs. PMP, Lean/Six Sigma or a relevant operations credential, and a master’s degree or advanced professional education, are desirable.

**Work Environment**
====================

Remote role with travel up to 30% to customer locations, field operations and EnerSys facilities. The Senior Director works closely with regional leadership and cross-functional teams and participates in critical customer and operational escalations.

**General Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* This position will work in an office setting, expect minimal physical demands.

EnerSys provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

a6c2d2ff6d6a918e8d36.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

*LifeStance Health Values*

* Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.
* Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.
* Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.
* One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

*Benefits*  
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

**Job Summary:**

The Medical Services Coordinator is responsible for serving as a point of contact to coordinate medical care, providing support to patients and psychiatric clinicians, ensuring quality customer service to in- person and remote patients and clinicians.

**Compensation:** $21.75/hourly, plus quarterly bonus/incentive potential

**Location:** 100 West 9th Ave Suite B, King of Prussia, PA

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Operational Excellence:**

* Create a positive work environment; be a culture carrier and support in-office clinician and staff engagement activities to promote LFST culture, engagement, and connection.
* Provide strong customer service, responding quickly and appropriately to patient needs, and being prepared to manage potentially difficult or emotional situations.
* Communicate with peers, clinicians, and patients in ways that support patient care and clinician satisfaction.

**Patient Support:**

* Assist psychiatric clinicians with necessary aspects of patient care including prior authorizations, lab orders, letters for patients, records requests, coordination of needed patient forms/paperwork (i.e. FLMA)
* Facilitate communication as needed between the patient, medical staff and the patient’s pharmacy
* Manage phone systems: Answer incoming calls to medical services line and provide patient support with medication related questions, refill requests, release requests, appointment reschedules, miscellaneous inquires, etc.
* Ensure accuracy of patient pharmacy information in the medical record
* Scan all hard copy correspondence into patient’s EHR record
* Assist patients with telehealth access, Patient Portal issues, and other troubleshooting as needed.
* Immediately handle any urgent requests; triage patient issues and resolution, i.e., direct to correct departments or escalate for assistance.
* Assist in coordination of external referrals for patient care

**Clinician Support:**

* Provide general clinician support – assist clinicians with administrative questions and/or duties such as sending letters, faxes, etc.
* Coordinate with clinicians pertaining to any additional patient questions.
* Aid psychiatric clinicians in termination process for patients as needed (i.e. termination letter, external referral, AMD status, etc.)

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to multitask and prioritize duties to support delivery of high-quality patient experience.
* Ability to work independently and as a team member.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient in using Computer Software Applications (Microsoft Office & EMRs)
* Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential Information (HIPAA)

**Education and Experience:**

* High School or equivalent required, associates/bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 1+ years of experience in healthcare operations, customer service, or similar role or setting preferred.

**Professionalism and Decision-making Responsibilities:**

* Behave Ethically: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and align with the values of the company.
* Build Relationships: Establish and maintain positive working relationships with others internally and externally to achieve the organization's goals. Work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals, resolve problems, and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness.
* Growth Mindset: Actively look for ways to improve processes/performance. Assess problem situations to identify causes, gather and process relevant information, generate workable solutions, and make recommendations and/or resolve the problem.
* Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to be flexible in responsibilities and easily adapt to the company's needs.
* Organization & Attention to Detail: Set priorities, develop a work schedule, and monitor progress towards goals, and track details, data, information. Understand the need for accurate information in data entry and communication with patients/clients and staff.
* Conflict Resolution: Work cooperatively and effectively with others to resolve problems and express disagreements in a way that does not attack/disparage others or impact patient care.

**Physical Requirements:**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Full medical, dental, vision coverage  
Paid time off  
12 Paid Holidays  
Tuition remission - eligible employees and their dependents can obtain a degree TUITION FREE  
A generous retirement plan and so much more!

A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.

**Position Summary**

fa7360c7f8003dfbe8b1.title: Distribution Center Returns and Damages Coordinator
fa7360c7f8003dfbe8b1.description:
**Position Overview**
=====================

The Returns and Damages Coordinator collaborates with the DC Merchandise Disposition Supervisor, DC Operations, Buyers, and Vendors to research, problem solve, and process merchandise by physical handling and inspection and performing systematic DC inventory adjustments required for all RTV (Return to Vendor), recall, inbound and in-house damages, and non-Burlington product. In addition, this role assists with various special projects as needed in support of the business needs and objectives such as donation, sample sales, quality inspections, etc.  
  
Shift: Monday - Thursday 5:30am - 4:30pm

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

* Processes inbound and in-house damages by following Burlington inspection criteria and SOP requirements to inspect and sort merchandise, determine final disposition of merchandise, prepare merchandise for return to stock, sample sale or donation, calculate, enter and communicate cost of goods chargebacks and freight claims, and perform timely inventory adjustments.
* Initiate and drive the RTV process by validating merchandise assigned to the RTV department, completing appropriate RTV documentation and data entry, and providing excellent internal and external customer service through communication and follow up with Buyers, Vendors, and Vendor Operations to promote the timely disposition of merchandise, acquisition of Return Authorization, contact information and pick up confirmation, preparation of physical merchandise for return to the vendor, calculation and entry of cost of goods chargebacks/debits and communication of financial adjustments to Inventory Control and DC Finance.
* Tasks include physical handling and movement of cartons and product, opening and closing cartons, stacking cartons on pallets, flagging cartons, cleaning and repackaging product, re-ticketing, re-packaging, case labeling, disposal of trash and damaged merchandise, using a RF Scanner and computer to make inventory adjustments including split/moves, etc.
* Utilize multiple computer information management systems to conduct research, manage inventory and chargebacks, problem solve, and initiate and determine action steps.
* Engage the appropriate level of management to assist with the escalation of items needing immediate attention and keeps the supervisor informed of all pertinent information.
* Provide training as needed to associates in support roles within operations regarding processes and SOP requirements including temp labor performing this function.
* Assists with various special projects as needed in support of the business needs and objectives including, but not limited to receiving, inspecting, sorting, inventorying, and packing product for donation, sample sales, etc.
* Ensure safe and clean work area through adherence to strict safety standards and following established policies and procedures.
* Contribute as a cross-functional team member utilizing proficiency in all DC departments across multiple shifts and buildings to problem solve and complete a variety of tasks in support of the business needs and objectives within the Merchandise Disposition Department as needed. Other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.
* Provide month end physical inventory of product in the RTV locations to support the monthly financial accrual, shipping damage adjustments and other reporting as required.

**You'll Come With**
====================

**Education:** High School Diploma or GED

**Licenses/Certification/Registration:** N/A

**Experience:**

* General distribution center/warehouse knowledge is a plus.
* Experience with RF Scanners is a plus
* Proven record of excellent attendance and punctuality to work is a must.

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Fluent in English – verbal and written
* Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel
* Proven problem-solving abilities and analytical/deductive reasoning skills to determine and initiate required action steps
* Effective organizational and interpersonal skills
* Strong attention to detail and follow-thorough skills
* Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
* Ability to work both independently and as a team.
* Ability to remain flexible to shifting priorities.
* Ability to compose professional vendor and buyer facing email communications.
* Ability to work overtime as needed.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to be mobile for long periods of time.
* Ability to stand/walk and work at a computer for extended periods of time.
* Ability to climb, balance, bend, lift, kneel, squat, and reach repeatedly.
* Ability to regularly lift and/or move cartons up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to work in non-temperature-controlled Distribution Center (hot in the summer, cold in the winter).
* Ability to transpose numbers and information with accuracy.

**#LI-CG1**

**Come join our team.** **You’re** **going to like it here!**
=============================================================

*You will enjoy competitive wages, flexible hours, and an associate discount. Burlington’s benefits package includes medical, dental and vision coverage including life and disability insurance. Full-time associates are also eligible for paid time off, paid holidays and a 401(k) plan.*

*We are a rapidly growing brand and provide a variety of training and development opportunities so our associates can grow with us. Our teams work hard and have fun together! Burlington associates make a difference in the lives of customers, colleagues, and the communities where we live and work every day. Burlington Stores, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to workplace diversity*

Individual pay decisions will be based on a variety of factors, such as but not limited to, qualifications, education, job-related skills, relevant experience, and geographic location.

Compensation Range: $18.00 - $21.60

**Job Title:** Facilities Support Services

**Work Location:** Remote

**Labor Category:** Exempt

**Clearance Level:** Secret

**Travel:** Up to 50%

**Pay Rate:** $75,000

**About the Role**

The Operations & Facilities Support Specialist provides high-level administrative and operational support to the Director of Operations and Senior Vice President of Operations. This position coordinates contract deliverables, reporting timelines, transition activities, leadership action items, and cross-functional operational requirements. The role supports multiple facilities management projects and works closely with Operations, Contracts, Finance, Human Resources, Quality Control, Security, and project teams to ensure assignments are completed accurately and on schedule.

* Develop and maintain trackers for contract deliverables, deadlines, milestones, and leadership action items.
* Coordinate with project teams to collect, review, organize, and submit required reports and deliverables.
* Provide administrative support during contract phase-in, phase-out, mobilization, and transition activities.
* Track transition requirements, including staffing, onboarding, training, security access, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and executive-level reports, presentations, dashboards, and status updates.
* Support Program Management Reviews, customer meetings, operational reviews, and special projects.
* Maintain SharePoint sites, document libraries, continuity files, and operational records.
* Assist with procurement requests, vendor coordination, invoice documentation, and facilities-related administrative requirements.
* Coordinate across Operations, Contracts, Finance, HR, Quality Control, Security, and project management teams.
* Track risks, corrective actions, open issues, and other leadership-directed assignments through completion.
* Support audit preparation, records management, and contract compliance documentation.
* Handle confidential and sensitive business information with appropriate discretion.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Three to five years of experience in administrative support, operations coordination, project coordination, facilities support, or a related role.
* Experience supporting senior leadership and managing competing priorities.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Experience managing deliverables, timelines, action-item trackers, reports, and document-control systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and time-management abilities.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple departments, projects, and geographically dispersed work locations.

* Must possess and maintain a valid state driver's license and a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy, to operate vehicles or equipment as required for the position.

$110,000 – $120,000 base, plus annual bonus

Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with flexibility as the role requires

**About the Company**
---------------------

We are a national telehealth company that helps employers improve care for workplace injuries through remote injury care, physician access, imaging coordination, care navigation and on-site services.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Product Support & Compliance Specialist supports users of the Company’s proprietary electronic medical record (EMR) platform and helps run the Company’s information-security and compliance program, including annual SOC 2 compliance. The role combines two areas: product support (investigating user issues, reproducing defects, writing development-ready tickets and coordinating fixes) and governance, risk and compliance (administering Secureframe, maintaining SOC 2 readiness and preparing for audits).

Supporting a healthcare technology product requires exceptional care with sensitive information. The person in this role turns compliance requirements into practical, repeatable tasks and brings strong troubleshooting, written communication and follow-through.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis

* EMR and healthcare workflow knowledge

* GRC and SOC 2 program administration

* Secureframe platform administration

* Bug reproduction and issue triage

* Development-ticket writing and documentation

* Customer communication and empathy

* Risk assessment and remediation tracking

* HIPAA, GDPR, privacy and security awareness

* Attention to detail and quality assurance

* Cross-functional collaboration

* Remote-work accountability and adaptability

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Product Support & Issue Resolution**

Serve as a primary support contact for users of the Company’s EMR platform by email, support portal, phone, chat and scheduled video calls.

Receive, acknowledge, categorize, prioritize and manage incoming support requests in line with established service expectations.

Investigate reported issues by gathering complete information: user role, affected workflow, patient or account context as permitted, browser and device details, timestamps, screenshots, error messages and steps to reproduce.

Determine whether an issue is a software defect, outage, integration problem, data issue, configuration or permissions issue, training need or enhancement request.

Resolve routine product, workflow, user-access, configuration and navigation issues, and give users clear guidance and appropriate workarounds.

Provide professional, accurate and empathetic status updates to users and internal stakeholders throughout the ticket lifecycle.

Escalate time-sensitive, high-impact, patient-care, privacy or security issues and potential production incidents promptly, following established escalation procedures.

**Defect Triage & Engineering Collaboration**

Reproduce software issues in a controlled test or staging environment when possible.

Create complete, development-ready bug tickets in Jira that include an issue summary and business impact, expected versus actual behavior, step-by-step reproduction instructions, affected users and environments, supporting evidence (screenshots, errors, logs), and a severity recommendation.

Partner with product, engineering, QA, implementation, customer success and operations teams to triage, prioritize, test and close reported issues.

Validate fixes in the appropriate environment and confirm resolution before communicating closure to the requester.

Participate in product releases by reviewing release notes, testing support workflows, preparing user communications and monitoring for post-release issues.

**Compliance & SOC 2 Program Administration**

Serve as day-to-day administrator of the Company’s Secureframe platform, including user access, integrations, control monitoring, evidence-collection workflows, task assignments, exceptions and compliance-calendar milestones.

Maintain SOC 2 readiness and the ongoing compliance program, covering the Security category and any additional Trust Services Criteria in the Company’s scope.

Coordinate control owners and evidence collection, track remediation work, and support risk assessments, vendor reviews, policy administration and security awareness activities.

Prepare for audits and serve as an organized point of contact for the Company’s external SOC 2 auditor.

Support responses to customer security questionnaires, due-diligence requests, SOC 2 report requests and related compliance inquiries, subject to Company review and approval.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

Create and maintain support documentation, troubleshooting guides, release notes, known-issue communications and internal knowledge-base articles.

Identify recurring support themes, usability gaps, documentation gaps and training opportunities, and recommend product, process and knowledge-base improvements.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

2+ years of experience in SaaS product support, healthcare technology support, information-security compliance, GRC, audit coordination, IT operations or a comparable combination.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including turning an unclear user report into a clear problem statement and a repeatable test case.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical findings to both nontechnical users and software developers.

Experience with a ticketing or work-management platform such as Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Linear, Azure DevOps or ServiceNow.

Ability to manage multiple open issues, prioritize effectively, document thoroughly and follow each case through to resolution.

Working knowledge of core SOC 2 concepts: Trust Services Criteria, controls, evidence, risk assessments, control testing, exceptions, remediation tracking, access reviews, change management, vendor risk and audit support.

High attention to detail, sound judgment, reliability and a strong sense of ownership.

Comfort working independently in a fully remote environment while staying responsive and well organized.

Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information responsibly.

Authorization to work in the United States.

**Preferred**

Experience supporting an EMR/EHR, practice-management, revenue-cycle, patient-engagement or other healthcare technology product.

Familiarity with clinical, administrative or operational workflows in physician practices, behavioral health, specialty care, ambulatory care or other healthcare settings.

Working knowledge of HIPAA and GDPR privacy and security principles, including minimum-necessary access to PHI.

Experience with vendor security reviews, security questionnaires, policy administration, access reviews, vulnerability-management evidence, business-continuity or disaster-recovery testing, and incident-response exercises.

Experience troubleshooting browser-based applications, role-based access, account provisioning, data imports and exports, document workflows or third-party integrations.

Experience reading application logs, reviewing API requests and responses, using browser developer tools or writing basic SQL queries.

Familiarity with healthcare data standards and interoperability, such as HL7, FHIR, CCD/C-CDA, e-prescribing, lab interfaces, claims, clearinghouses or SSO.

Knowledge of Python, React or AWS.

Experience working with engineering and QA teams in an Agile or similar development environment.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

**First 90 Days**
-----------------

Within the first 90 days, a successful Product Support & Compliance Specialist will:

Learn the core EMR workflows, primary user types, support processes, privacy and security procedures, and internal escalation paths.

Document cases consistently, with enough detail for another team member to pick up the investigation.

Resolve common user, configuration, access and workflow questions accurately and efficiently.

Produce development tickets that engineering and QA can reproduce, estimate and act on without repeated requests for basic information.

Build trusted working relationships with customers, internal stakeholders, product, engineering and QA.

Identify at least one recurring issue, documentation gap, workflow improvement or support-process opportunity.

**Privacy, Security and Work Environment**
------------------------------------------

Safeguard confidential information and follow all Company privacy, security, access-control and remote-work policies.

Access protected health information (PHI) only when required for assigned duties, and only in accordance with Company policy and applicable law, including the HIPAA Security Rule.

Use Company-approved devices and communication systems, multifactor authentication and secure workspace practices.

Complete HIPAA and security awareness training at onboarding and annually.

Work fully remotely from a private, professional workspace with a reliable high-speed internet connection; the role involves extended periods of computer and phone work.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

Base salary range of $110,000 – $120,000 per year. The salary offered will be based on the candidate’s experience, skills and qualifications.

Annual bonus target of up to 15% of base salary, based on Company and individual performance.

Medical, dental and vision insurance.

401(k) plan with a Company match.

Paid vacation and Company holidays.

A fully remote role on a growing healthcare technology team.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Applications will be accepted through the next few weeks. Submit your application through this site.

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities upon request.

* Support process improvements and adherence to company procedures.

* 1+ years’ experience using document management, or similar business applications.

**Other Qualifications**

* Experience working with contracts, agreements, or legal document processes.
* Experience utilizing Salesforce or other CRM systems.
* Familiarity with fiber network deployment, telecommunications construction, or Right of Entry (ROE) processes.
* Ability to effectively communicate with customers, property owners, and business partners.

Associates scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week have access to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan, education assistance, and paid time off benefits such as vacation (15 days accrued per year for full-time; pro-rated for associates working between 20-39 hours), sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full-time and pro-rated for all other associates), seven paid national holidays and one floating holiday, paid parental leave (6 weeks after 12 months of employment), among others. TDS Telecom provides high-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide. Our Customer Care team is supported and empowered to be the best people, to people. . That’s life at Capital One.

**Here’s what we’re looking for in you:**

It’s important for our associates to have the necessary skills and know-how to succeed in their roles and provide exceptional servicing experiences to our customers. We invest heavily in both formal and informal learning and development opportunities. Through our formal training programs and on-the-job work experience, successful associates at Capital One will:

* Demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn
* Possess a strong attention to detail, a positive attitude and have the ability to be flexible and embrace change
* Demonstrate a strong customer focus that is rooted in empathy
* Communicate effectively with peers, management and customers, using appropriate methods of communication for role
* Exercise good judgment and independent decision-making skills
* Ability to problem solve individual issues, guide co-workers in problem solving and solutions when needed, and identify trends in customer needs
* Demonstrate exceptional listening, questioning, call control and de-escalation techniques
* Be proactive, have effective time management and organizational skills

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

Senior Customer Service Coordinators at Capital One are tasked with providing the best of the best customer service. This is your opportunity to shine through your ability to listen and understand the customer’s needs, problem solve and deliver a “wow” customer experience to deepen relationships and loyalty to our brand. **The Benefits:**

At Capital One, you join a complete benefits program. Our unique benefits and enrollment programs are designed to help you be your happiest, healthiest self. If you are experiencing consistent issues with internet stability Capital One reserves the right to ask the agent to upgrade internet service to ensure a good customer experience.
