78806e95ac04bb00d8b3.title: Talent Experience Coordinator
78806e95ac04bb00d8b3.description:
**About the company**

ECN Capital is a financial services company that partners with leading North American financial institutions. We're a growing team that values initiative, collaboration and great work.

**About the role**

This is a launchpad into a career in Talent Acquisition and People Operations. You'll be the engine behind our hiring process, keeping candidates moving, hiring managers informed and every new hire set up for a great first day.

You'll work side by side with our Recruiter, learn the full recruitment life cycle from posting to onboarding, and take on more ownership as you grow. We're looking for someone with strong admin skills and an outgoing, people-first personality who wants a full-time role they can build a long-term career on. No HR experience required: you bring the energy, organization and drive, we'll teach you the rest.

**What you'll do**

Sourcing and pipeline management

* Post approved roles to job boards and keep listings current
* Manage incoming applications in our applicant tracking system (ADP) and keep candidate files organized
* Partner with the Recruiter on shortlists and keep every role moving through the pipeline

**Interview coordination and candidate experience**

* Be the first voice candidates hear from, reaching out to shortlisted applicants by email and phone
* Schedule screening interviews, and coordinate directly with candidates
* Check in with stakeholders regularly to confirm availability and book manager interviews
* Call successful candidates to share good news
* Make sure every candidate hears back from us within the window we promised
* Maintain the recruitment tracker so everyone knows exactly where each role stands

**Pre-boarding**

* Coordinate background checks before offers are finalized
* Coordinate start dates
* Open onboarding tickets and track delivery
* Other administrative tasks as required by the Talent Director & Head of Employee Experience

**Your growth path**

This role is designed as the first step in a recruiting career, not a dead end. As you master the fundamentals, you'll take on more ownership.

Along the way, you'll build skills that carry you anywhere in HR and business:

* Running a full recruitment life cycle, from job posting to a new hire's first day
* Candidate screening and assessment
* Working with leaders across the business
* Applicant tracking systems, scheduling tools and HR technology
* Creating a standout candidate and new hire experience

**Who you are**

* A true people person: outgoing, approachable and easy to connect with
* Highly organized, with sharp attention to detail and strong follow-through
* Smart, driven and competitive, you set a high bar for yourself and enjoy hitting it
* Hard-working and proactive; you spot what needs doing before anyone asks
* Brings upbeat, positive energy, even on busy days
* A clear, confident communicator by phone, email and in person
* Comfortable juggling multiple roles, candidates and deadlines at once
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams) and quick to learn new tools

**Backgrounds we love**

You don't need HR experience to thrive here. Experience in any of these is a great fit:

* Administrative, office or reception roles
* Hospitality, or restaurant service
* Education
* Retail, customer service or client-facing sales

If you’ve kept a busy bar running smoothly, turned a frustrated customer into a loyal regular, or been the go-to person for organization, you already have the skills that make a great Talent Coordinator. We’d love to help you bring them to a vibrant, growing organization.

Why Join Us:

* A full-time, permanent role with a clear path into recruiting and HR
* Hands-on training and mentorship from an experienced Recruiter
* Exposure to leaders and teams across the business from day one
* A collaborative team that values energy, initiative and a good sense of humour

**How to apply**

Send us your resume and a few lines about why you'd be great at this. Tell us about a time you made someone's day or kept things running when it got busy. We'd love to hear from you.

2cd551cd6c38d70b188a.title: Emergency Management Liaison Officer
2cd551cd6c38d70b188a.description:
**Company Description**

A best-in-class city that attracts best-in-class talent, Philadelphia is an incredible place to build a career. From our thriving arts scene and rich history to our culture of passion and grit, there are countless reasons to love living and working here. With a workforce of over 30,000 people, and more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia offers boundless opportunities to make an impact.

As an employer, the City of Philadelphia values inclusion, integrity, innovation, empowerment, and hard work above all else. We offer a vibrant work environment, comprehensive health care and benefits, and the experience you need to grow and excel. If you’re interested in working with a passionate team of people who care about the future of Philadelphia, start here.

***What we offer***

* **Impact** - The work you do here matters to millions.
* **Growth** - Philadelphia is growing, why not grow with it?
* **Diversity & Inclusion** - Find a career in a place where everyone belongs.
* **Benefits** - We care about your well-being.

***Agency Description***

The Office of Emergency Management (OEM) works to mitigate, plan, and prepare for emergencies; educate the public about preparedness; coordinate emergency response and recovery efforts; and develop tools and identify resources to support the overall preparedness of the City of Philadelphia.

 **Job Description**

Job Description

The OEM mission in a 24/7/365 commitment. Mitigating, Preparing, Responding, and Recovering for planned and unplanned events requires around-the-clock dedication. The Emergency Management Liaison Officer’s (EMLO) role is to fill the OEM mission on behalf of OEM subject matter experts and to ensure that OEM is meeting the enduring needs of our partners. Specifically, the candidate will work with many different entities from governmental and non-governmental organizations. The lines of effort will focus on six main areas:

* Provide essential staffing to the Regional Integration Center to maintain staffing minimums and support 24/7 emergency management activities in a remote capacity.
* Provide on-scene and remote response to emergency incidents and planned events, representing OEM and coordinating response agencies
* Conduct short-term recovery activities including coordination of critical lifeline restoration, and individual and public assistance activities after disasters
* Assist in OEM’s Logistics mission, including support of OEM vehicle maintenance, transport of equipment to events, and assistance at OEM’s warehouse
* Conduct preparedness activities including leading public engagement events, conducting planning efforts, and performing readiness activities such as trainings and exercises
* Fulfill administrative functions of the Operational Coordination program, including the RIC, EMLO, and Public Alert & Warning, as well as providing support to all of OEM.

Candidates should possess a strong desire to work in a team-oriented, fast paced, flexible, professional public safety environment, and a willingness to serve the public in the sixth largest city in the nation. The ideal candidate has exceptionally strong leadership and negotiation skills, is self-motivated, inquisitive, adept at working with diverse groups in stressful situations, and has a proven track record of effectively operating under emergency circumstances. Work will require a rotating schedule to include nights, weekends, and holidays and will, at times, be conducted in the field as the sole OEM representative or in a group setting.

Essential Functions

Under the administrative direction of the Operational Coordination Program Manager, Operational Coordination Group Leaders, and the Response Executive, the Emergency Management Liaison Officer is responsible for a range of activities including the following:

* Perform functions of the Regional Integration Center Coordinator to maintain staffing levels and support operations within the Regional Integration Center.
* Perform functionality checks and supply replenishment to ensure readiness of facilities, vehicles, and equipment
* Perform field observation duties for various planned events, emergencies, and disasters gathering situational awareness and informing OEM response actions
* Coordinate emergency response and resource support at incident command posts and the emergency operations center (EOC) before a full on-call team deployment
* Deliver public education and engagement opportunities to increase the readiness of all Philadelphians
* Support of public information officer duties, including collection of photos and video
* Conduct planning functions for short-fused incidents including interagency meetings, written or verbal incident action plans, and other planning products
* Serve displaced residents in reception centers and shelters
* Coordinate short-term recovery activities at incidents including infrastructure restoration, financial and human service recovery, and public information
* Assist in development of OEM plans, including data analysis, content review, and links to OEM operations and logistics functions.
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders through regular visits at various stations, offices, or other worksites
* Conduct neighborhood familiarity tours, increasing awareness of neighborhood hazards, conditions, and assets
* Operate equipment including technology and communications, vehicles and trailers of various sizes, and other mechanical items all in a safe and approved manner
* Participate in trainings and exercises
* Support the EMLO program with scheduling, training, quality assurance, procedure writing and implementation, technology and data management, and other project management
* Maintain proficiency in agency equipment and technology systems for situational awareness, incident management, data visualization, and alert and warning
* In the absence of immediate or direct guidance from OEM Executive staff, be prepared to carry out and lead others through approved procedures

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

COMPETENCIES

* Strong interpersonal skills
* Effective oral and written communication skills
* Strong leadership and negotiation skills
* Confidence in front of groups
* Proven ability to operate and lead during emergencies
* Sound judgement and ethical decision making
* Professional conduct and accountability
* Proven time-management skills

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES

* Ability to problem solve and work with others under pressure
* Ability to multitask effectively
* Ability to maintain effective working relationships and develop partnerships
* Ability to coordinate diverse groups toward a common goal
* Ability to complete tasks and projects in a timely manner
* Ability to contribute and coordinate work in a team
* Ability to remain calm and operate effectively in volatile, uncertain, complex, and ambiguous environments symptomatic of emergency incidents
* Ability to work with little direct oversight or supervision
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office software (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Access, Outlook) and ability to operate other web-based platforms for situational awareness, information management, and mass notification

 **Qualifications**

* Completion of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.
* At least three (3) or more years’ experience working within an emergency management or other public safety organization.
* Three (3) or more years’ experience supervising personnel is preferred, especially in completion of objectives under difficult circumstances or potentially hazardous situations
* Familiarity with the City of Philadelphia is preferred
* Experience working in outdoor environments for prolonged periods is preferred
* Experiencing training or teaching audiences of different ages
* An equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field will be considered with approval by MDO-OEM and the Office of Human Resources.

Licenses, Registrations, and Certification

* Possession of a valid proper class motor vehicle operator’s license issued by the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania within six months of hire; commercial driver’s license to be pursued after employment
* Successful completion of FEMA Independent Study courses (IS 100.a, 200.a, 700.a, and 800.b) within first month of appointment.
* Candidate will have access to secure public safety information. All selected applicants must undergo and successfully complete a background investigation as a condition of placement in this position.

Other requirements

* OEM personnel are essential, working during states of emergency or other city closures.
* All OEM personnel are “emergency managers first.” During times of disaster, work assignments and schedules may be altered to meet the incident objectives.
* Full-time residency within the City of Philadelphia geographic boundaries required within six months of hire. There are no exceptions to this policy.
* Ability to physically perform the duties during and outside of normal business hours, to include driving and working outside.
* Nature of work inherently has risks, certain functions will require the use of various personal protective equipment (PPE) in hazardous situations.

 **Additional Information**

**TO APPLY:** **Interested candidates must submit a cover letter resume and writing sample.**

Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

**Discover the Perks of Being a City of Philadelphia Employee:**

* **Transportation**: City employees get unlimited **FREE** public transportation all year long through SEPTA’s Key Advantage program. Employees can ride on SEPTA buses, subways, trolleys, and regional rail for their daily commute and more.
* Parental Benefits: The City offers its employees 8 weeks of paid parental leave.
* We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
* Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan
* Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
* Generous retirement savings options are available
* **Pay off your student loans faster** - As a qualifying employer, City of Philadelphia employees are eligible to participate in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. Join the ranks of hundreds of employees who have already benefited from this program and achieved student loan forgiveness.
* **Unlock Tuition Discounts and Scholarships** - The City of Philadelphia has forged partnerships with over a dozen esteemed colleges and universities in the area, ensuring that our employees have access to a wide range of tuition discounts and scholarships. Experience savings of 10% to 40% on your educational expenses, extending not only to City employees but in some cases, spouse and dependents too!

Join the City of Philadelphia team today and seize these incredible benefits designed to enhance your financial well-being and personal growth!

* ***The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire***

Effective May 22, 2023, vaccinations are **no longer required** for new employees that work in non-medical, non-emergency or patient facing positions with the City of Philadelphia. As a result, only employees in positions providing services that are patient-facing medical care (ex: Nurses, doctors, emergency medical personnel), must be fully vaccinated.

The City of Philadelphia is an Equal Opportunity employer and does not permit discrimination based on race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, source of income, familial status, genetic information or domestic or sexual violence victim status. If you believe you were discriminated against, call the Philadelphia Commission on Human Relations at 215-686-4670 or send an email to faqpchr@phila.gov.

For more information, go to: Human Relations Website: http://www.phila.gov/humanrelations/Pages/default.aspx

Supports coordination of medical services including care management intake and provider requests to promote effective utilization of healthcare services. Promotes and supports care managers and utilization management team as required.

* Provides support services to team members by answering incoming telephone calls, making outbound calls to members and providers, researching information, collaborating with reviewing UM nurses, documenting and navigating care management systems.

* Advanced technical skills for use of hardware and software with a high degree of accuracy.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills for representation of clear and concise results.

* May require travel dependent on company needs.

c00af81296058c575a57.description:
**Work With The Best**
----------------------

We are building the premier outdoor living company in the country by creating a “family of family companies” across the nation. Now you can build your landscaping career with the best, working in one of our many company locations nationwide. Learn from the top experts in the field and work on some of the country’s largest and most complex landscape projects. Take advantage of opportunities to share and exchange best practices across our network. The opportunities are endless.

**Job Summary:** Mariani Premier Group is seeking an experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to join our Talent Acquisition team! The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner leads regional recruiting efforts across multiple branches and works with regional leadership to build a rolling 12-month workforce plan that links growth targets, contract wins, and branch capacity to hiring needs by role and location. You will manage searches from intake to offer, source proactively through networks, referrals, and industry associations, and negotiate offers with in-demand candidates. You will also keep leadership informed through a regional talent dashboard and monthly briefings on pipeline coverage, projected gaps, and recruiting metrics.

**This is a fully remote position open only to residents of states where Mariani Premier Group operates.**

**Key responsibilities**

**Regional workforce planning**

* Partner with regional leadership to a rolling 12-month workforce plan that ties growth targets, contract wins, and branch capacity to hiring needs by role and location.
* Identify critical and hard-to-fill roles (account managers, estimators, designers, certified arborists and horticulturists, branch and operations managers) and start building their pipelines early.
* Use market data on pay, competitors, and local talent supply to advise leaders on compensation, sourcing, and expansion.
* Maintain a regional talent dashboard covering open roles, pipeline coverage, projected gaps, and promotion paths, and brief leadership monthly.

**Talent acquisition**

* Consult with hiring leaders on role design, and selection process, and manage searches from intake to offer for skilled, specialist, supervisory, and management roles.
* Source proactively through professional networks, referrals, industry associations, and social channels, and build talent pools before roles open.
* Negotiate offers and manage the candidate experience for competitive, in-demand candidates.
* Keep ATS data accurate and report on time to fill, source of hire, quality of hire, and funnel conversion.

**Partnerships and employer brand**

* Build relationships with horticulture, turf, and landscape architecture programs, community colleges, trade schools, workforce boards, and veteran and apprenticeship programs.
* Shape the company's employer brand and tell the career-path story, from entry roles to field leadership and management, through local marketing, social content, and referral programs.
* Mentor other recruiters and coordinators and share best practices across regions.

**Seasonal hiring event setup for seasonal ramp-up**

* Own the regional events strategy: choose the job fairs, career days, and industry events worth attending, and set budgets by expected return.
* Set up each event, from booking and logistics to materials and signage, and brief the on-site HR or Operations representative who will attend and speak with candidates.
* Measure each event on cost per hire, qualified candidates, and conversion into the pipeline, and adjust the calendar based on results.
* Pair events with year-round outreach so candidates are nurtured before and after each one.

**Required qualifications**

* 6-8 years of progressive recruiting experience, including recruiting against workforce plans for skilled, technical, and leadership roles across multiple locations.
* Demonstrated experience turning workforce plans and headcount forecasts into recruiting plans with business leaders and influencing decisions with data.
* Experience planning and coordinating recruiting events or job fairs, including budget, logistics, and ROI tracking.
* Track record filling hard-to-find technical, supervisory, and management roles, with strong sourcing and offer-negotiation skills.
* Working knowledge of employment law and hiring compliance (EEO, I-9, wage and hour basics).
* Proficiency with an ATS and recruiting analytics; comfortable presenting metrics to senior leaders. Workday is highly preferred
* Consultative, relationship-driven style with operations leaders and community partners.
* Ability to travel locally and regionally, but minimally.
* Bachelor's degree in HR, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in landscaping, construction, agriculture, field services, or another multi-branch, seasonal industry.
* Experience with seasonal workforce programs such as H-2B.
* Fluency in Spanish, spoken and written.
* HR or recruiting certification (SHRM-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR, AIRS, CIR).
* Experience with workforce planning tools or HR analytics platforms

**The Perks**

* 401(k) plan with company match
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* FSA/HSA
* PerkSpot
* Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance
* Paid time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement (after one year of service)

0772975c41edca8ff46c.description:
WSP is seeking a Project Coordinator for our Power Delivery Project Management Team. Be involved in projects with our Project Management Team and join WSP’s growing Power & Energy organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.

This position is based out of Washington DC or remotely from any mutually acceptable location in VA, NC, SC or MD.

**This Opportunity**

Provides world-class administrative and logistical support to WSP Power Delivery project teams by executing project coordination tasks to deliver operational efficiency and excellence. Oversees complex assignments requiring the ability to interpret project plans, manage information workflows, and ensure timely execution of critical tasks. Works independently with minimal supervision to resolve issues, implement process improvements, and contribute to successful project delivery. Serves as a key liaison between Project Managers and engineering, finance, and procurement teams to facilitate seamless project coordination and reporting.

**Your Impact**

* Master WSP’s enterprise resource planning, document control, and other systems, as well as WSP project management policies and procedures, and client-specific systems, policies, and procedures.
* Lead or assist the Project Manager with project setup, including data entry and quality control to ensure all information is entered correctly, and that required workflows are initiated and completed in a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain detailed project logs, schedules, financial reports and status reports for internal teams and clients.
* Coordinate the creation, formatting, and finalization of client deliverables, ensuring consistency and adherence to established standards.
* Lead the creation, administration and distribution of critical documentation including contracts, change orders, financial reports, submittals, and RFIs.
* Track project milestones and proactively follow up with team members to ensure completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Manage internal documentation systems and repositories, applying version control and audit protocols and ensuring logical and complete filing of documents; maintain a document register for each project as required.
* Serve as a point of contact for project-related inquiries, supporting internal and external communication flows.
* Collaborate with WSP Finance teams to monitor project budgets, coordinate invoice approvals, and ensure timely payments.
* Collaborate with WSP Procurement teams to request requisitions and purchase orders.
* Collaborate with WSP Legal to initiate contract reviews.
* Assist with data entry and verification for cost reports, timesheets, and vendor submissions.
* Facilitate project meetings by preparing agendas, recording notes, tracking action items, and distributing follow-up materials.
* Support onboarding of project staff by coordinating required access, credentials, and documentation.
* Assist in the resolution of administrative and logistical challenges by identifying root causes and recommending improvements.
* Coordinate updates to project dashboards and reporting tools, including cross-checking input from multiple contributors.
* Provide support in audit and compliance reviews by compiling required documentation and maintaining detailed records.
* Ensure documentation related to safety plans, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements are drafted, maintained and distributed appropriately.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of templates, procedures, and project coordination workflows.
* Monitor the use of shared project resources such as drives, software platforms, and communication tools to ensure team-wide alignment.
* Lead or co-lead administrative segments of large projects or task orders requiring coordination between multiple offices.
* Serve as a resource and provide guidance to more junior staff on project coordination practices.
* Anticipate risks related to schedule, documentation, or compliance, and escalate appropriately with recommendations.
* Track deliverable production cycles and assist in developing timelines and quality check protocols.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.  

**Who You Are**

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 7 years of relevant post-education experience in related job capacity.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycles, including planning, execution, and close-out phases.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project tracking tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, or Excel-based trackers.
* Experience with documentation management platforms such as SharePoint, ProjectWise, or similar systems.
* Knowledge of administrative controls related to contracts, invoicing, and procurement activities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining data accuracy and integrity.
* Ability to interpret and implement project coordination policies, procedures, and standards.
* Professional communication skills for drafting correspondence, managing inquiries, and presenting project updates.
* Experience compiling data and generating reports tailored to diverse audiences and stakeholders.
* Capacity to identify process inefficiencies and suggest or implement enhancements.
* Comfort navigating cross-functional relationships between technical, administrative, and financial teams.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve non-standard challenges using sound judgment.
* Skilled in time management and able to monitor and coordinate across multiple task owners and deadlines.
* Ability to work independently with minimal direction and to prioritize tasks based on changing project needs.
* Experience managing documentation associated with subconsultants, contracts, and permits.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive materials appropriately.
* Track record of contributing to successful team coordination on medium to large-scale projects.
* Ability to lead documentation audits or coordinate data gathering during internal or external reviews.
* Willingness to support the development of junior staff in coordination-related tasks.
* Demonstrated reliability, initiative, and accountability in supporting project teams.
Ability to meet attendance schedule with dependability and consistency.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associate's Degree.
* Experience supporting multi-office or multidisciplinary project teams within a consulting engineering firm.
* Familiarity with Oracle ERPs.
* Familiarity with electric distribution design processes and timelines.
* Exposure to AEC or PMI project documentation standards, including QA/QC practices.
* Knowledge of regulatory and contractual documentation requirements in Power Delivery or Electric Utility projects.
Professional training or coursework in project coordination, document control, or construction administration.  

**WSP Benefits:**

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

**Compensation:**

Expected Salary (all locations): $65,000 - $90,000

**About WSP**

WSP is one of the world’s leading engineering, science and infrastructure solutions firms, uniting its multidisciplinary expertise to shape communities to advance humanity. From local beginnings to a globe-spanning presence today, WSP operates in over 50 countries and employs approximately 83,000 professionals, known as Visioneers. Together, they pioneer solutions and deliver innovative projects in the transportation, infrastructure, environment, building, energy, water, mining, and metals sectors. **About WSP**

www.wsp.com

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

740399368018c82dd496.title: Patient Intake Specialist and Care Coordinator
740399368018c82dd496.description:
The Intake Specialist and Care Coordinator plays an integral role in our patients' healthcare journey. They are the first point of contact for our patients and help set the tone for their care experience. They work seamlessly with our physicians to make sure that every patient has access to the highest quality of care, regardless of location, socioeconomic status, or technological literacy.

### **About MD Ally**

MD Ally is a 9-1-1 Telehealth solution that enables greater connectivity between public health & safety and the broader healthcare ecosystem. Our solutions allow dispatchers and first responders to transfer non-emergency callers from 911 to virtual care instead of dispatching valuable, emergency resources.

### **Description**

Looking for a role where you can be instrumental in changing healthcare and deliver best-in-class patient care and outcomes? A company that believes you are part of the solution and values your input when solving complex problems? A place where you are recognized and rewarded for your work? Then look no further - MD Ally is YOUR company.

Our mission at MD Ally is to revolutionize emergency healthcare by seamlessly integrating creative telehealth solutions into the 911 response system and creating a healthcare landscape where telehealth interventions become an integral part of emergency response to reduce the cost of care and improve overall outcomes.

The Intake Specialist and Care Coordinator plays an integral role in our patient’s healthcare journey. They are the first point of contact for our patients and help set the tone for their care experience. They work seamlessly with our physicians to make sure that every patient has access to the highest quality of care, regardless of location, socioeconomic status, or technological literacy.

How you contribute to our mission

* What you bring to the team:
* Bring an unrelenting desire to deliver excellent customer service with every patient interaction.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain the onboarding process and ensure patients are successfully connected to our telehealth platform.
* Accurately collect and input patient demographic information, insurance details, and other relevant data into electronic health records (EHR) systems.
* Verify and update patient information to maintain the accuracy and completeness of the patient’s medical records.
* Collaborate with healthcare providers and administrative staff to complete onboarding workflows and address any patient concerns or special requirements.
* Educate patients on how to access our patient portal and other technology tools to enhance their MD Ally experience.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and maintain the confidentiality and security of patient information.
* Communicate effectively with patients and/or their family members to enable them to successfully navigate in-network and community resources identified within their after-visit summary (AVS) care plans.
* Recognize and escalate complex issues to the appropriate personnel for resolution when necessary.
* Required 3-5 years experience as a medical receptionist, healthcare call center representative, 911 dispatcher or similar
* Additional certificate or degree in healthcare administration preferred.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a healthcare team and collaborate with other administrative and clinical staff.
* Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
* Excellent customer service skills to create a positive experience for patients and their families.
* Ability to handle inquiries, complaints, and difficult situations with professionalism and empathy.
* Proficiency in using computer systems and electronic health record (EHR) software.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to navigate, collect and input patient information accurately into various software applications.
* Familiarity with basic medical and insurance terminology to understand and accurately document patient information.
* Sensitivity to diverse patient populations and the ability to interact respectfully with individuals from various backgrounds.
* Highly motivated self-starter with a strong attention to detail and innate drive to achieve or surpass organizational KPIs and goals.
* Willingness and ability to adapt to changes in process, technology, or responsibilities within the startup landscape.

#### **Salary**

$19 - $22 per hour

Upper Gwynedd, PA

63ef4981ca309347fe9a.title: PK-3 Program Coordinator and Full-Time Faculty
63ef4981ca309347fe9a.description:
**Timebase/Service Allocation**: Full time, 100%, 12 months (year-round)

**Location**: Remote. EDvance operates on a Pacific Time schedule during regular business hours, with adjustments for evening teaching and periodic in-person travel to partner districts and sites in California

**Appointment** Type: Exempt

**Level of Position**: Faculty / Program Coordinator

**Reports To**: Chief Academic, Innovation, and Student Success Officer

**Supervises**: Will supervise PK-3 pathway faculty (full-time and adjunct) as the program grows

**ABOUT EDVANCE COLLEGE**
-------------------------

EDvance College is a WSCUC-accredited nonprofit that offers debt-free, earn-and-learn bachelor's degrees in Early Childhood Studies to working adult educators across California. Our students keep their jobs in classrooms and programs while they earn their degree, and they bring that daily practice into every course.

Our earner/learners are predominantly women of color, first-generation college students, and multilingual educators, with an average age of about 40. They are already doing the work of caring for and teaching young children. EDvance exists to give them the degree, the credentials, and the career mobility that work deserves.

EDvance began in 2009 as a program at San Francisco State University and grew into an independent accredited institution. We are now building the next step: a pathway that lets our students earn a California PK-3 teaching credential alongside their bachelor's degree, without leaving the workforce.

**ROLE SUMMARY**
----------------

This new role will build and lead EDvance's integrated PK-3 credential pathway: a program that lets working educators earn a California PK-3 Early Childhood Education Specialist Instruction Credential inside their Early Childhood Studies BA, while working full time and studying full time.

California's expansion of Transitional Kindergarten has created urgent demand for credentialed PK-3 teachers. The educators best positioned to fill those classrooms are already working in early learning programs, but traditional credential programs ask them to stop working, take on debt, or add years to their path. EDvance is designing a different model, one where the job is part of the preparation and district partnerships make the clinical experience real.

The PK-3 Program CoordinatorFaculty is the person who turns that design into a working program. This is a leadership and building role. You will shape the credential from its structure through its first graduating cohorts, and you will be accountable for whether our candidates are ready to teach and pass the Teaching Performance Assessment.

**What success will look like**
-------------------------------

The desired outcome of this role is that EDvance credential candidates are ready to lead a PK-3 classroom on day one, and that we have evidence to prove it.

In the first 12 months, the PK-3 Coordinator will have:

* Completed a program design, in collaboration with EDvance faculty and leadership, that maps PK-3 credential coursework and clinical experience into the ECS BA, with every Teaching Performance Expectation (TPE) aligned to a specific course, assignment, and assessment.
* Contributed to the program narrative, standards alignment, and evidence needed for CTC review of the credential program.
* Established an intern and placement model, including supervision structure, mentor teacher expectations, and site requirements.
* Secured signed district or LEA partnership agreements for intern placements and hiring pipelines. The number of agreements will be determined in collaboration with EDvance leadership.
* Built the TPA support system: preparation embedded in coursework, practice cycles, and a plan for candidates who do not pass on the first attempt.
* Recruited and onboarded the first PK-3 pathway faculty, and implemented a shared faculty development model.

Within three years, the program will have:

* Graduated its first credentialed cohorts, with TPA first-attempt pass rates at or above an identified target (to be set collaboratively with EDvance leadership)
* Sustained existing and added new district partnerships that hire EDvance graduates into TK-3 roles
* Implemented documented assessment and continuous improvement cycle that uses candidate performance data to improve courses and the program every term
* Cultivated a faculty team that can deliver and improve the pathway

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

Lead credential program design and CTC accreditation

* Lead, in partnership with EDvance leadership, the design of an integrated PK-3 credential pathway within the Early Childhood Studies BA
* Map coursework, clinical experience, and assessments to CTC program standards and the PK-3 Teaching Performance Expectations
* Design and revise credential coursework, with particular attention to TK and the PK-3 continuum
* Prepare program documentation, standards alignment, and evidence for CTC accreditation review, and serve as a primary program contact during review
* Keep the program current with CTC requirements and California PK-3 and TK policy
* Effectively and positively collaborate across the institution to ensure high-quality communications, coordination with other essential departments, implementation and operationalization plans, and compliance with CTC requirements and reporting.

Lead clinical practice, intern placements, and district partnerships

* Build the structure for intern placements and clinical experience that fits working educators, including supervision, mentor teacher roles, and site agreements
* Develop, cultivate, and maintain partnerships with school districts, county offices of education, and early learning agencies
* Align the pathway with apprenticeship and intern models so candidates can earn while they learn
* Monitor placement quality and candidate progress, and resolve issues with partner sites

Lead assessment and candidate performance

* Lead the assessment system that shows that candidates demonstrate program learning outcomes and meet the Teaching Performance Expectations
* Own TPA preparation, support, and outcomes, including pass-rate tracking and a plan for candidates who need a second attempt
* Use candidate performance data to drive course and program improvement each term
* Partner with Institutional Effectiveness on program data reporting for CTC and WSCUC

Faculty recruitment, hiring, and development

* Recruit, hire, and onboard PK-3 pathway faculty, adjuncts, and clinical supervisors
* Design and deliver training that prepares faculty to teach adult learners in the EDvance model and to assess candidates consistently
* Lead and coach pathway faculty and hold shared expectations for quality

Teaching

* Teach one to two courses per semester in the PK-3 pathway or ECS program, to be determined in collaboration with EDvance leadership.
* Model The EDvance Way: active, relevant, rigorous instruction designed for working adults

Service

* Participate in faculty participatory governance
* Participate in accreditation, strategic planning, and institutional meetings
* Positively contribute to relevant cross-departmental implementation or working teams, such as Workforce Alignment Team, Strategic Enrollment Management Team.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

### **Required Qualifications:**

* Master's degree or higher in Early Childhood Education, Education, or a related field
* Valid U.S. teaching credential (California credential and PK-3 authorization preferred)
* Minimum of four years post-secondary teaching experience. Partial credit counted for professional coaching in ECE (0.5 credit per year).
* Experience working with adult working multilingual learner populations, such as that EDvance serves.
* Minimum of five years of experience teaching or leading in PK-3 settings
* Demonstrated experience designing curriculum and aligning it to standards, learning outcomes, and assessments
* Experience with program evaluation and candidate or student assessment, including the use of data to improve instruction
* Direct experience with CTC accreditation, program standards, or credential program review
* Working knowledge of California school districts and early learning systems, including how districts hire, place, and support new teachers
* Experience teaching, coaching, or mentoring adult learners
* Evidence of building something new: a program, pathway, partnership, or initiative taken from idea to implementation

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Transitional Kindergarten teaching or TK program leadership experience
* Experience with Credit for Prior Learning and Prior Learning Assessment
* Doctorate in education or a related field
* Experience supporting candidates through a Teaching Performance Assessment, or scoring a TPA
* Experience with teacher intern programs, registered apprenticeships, or grow-your-own pathways
* Experience building formal partnerships with districts, county offices of education, or Head Start and state preschool agencies
* Experience in higher education faculty roles, including hiring and supervising faculty
* Bilingual in Spanish and English, or experience serving multilingual educators and dual language learners
* Proficiency with Canvas, Zoom, GoReact, and Google Workspace

The person who thrives here has an innovative spirit and a builder's patience. You are energized by designing something that does not exist yet, and disciplined enough to document it so others can run it. You believe working adult educators are an asset to the profession, not a problem to be solved.

**THE EDVANCE CULTURE**
-----------------------

At EDvance College, our culture reflects who we are as an institution and how we show up for the early education workforce.

We are a mission-driven, educator-centered college committed to expanding access to higher education, removing barriers, and creating strong outcomes for students, children, and communities.

As we grow, our work requires both clarity and adaptability. We are building, refining, and scaling at the same time. This means our culture is grounded in ownership, continuous improvement, and a shared commitment to impact.

What this looks like in practice:

* **We center educators and students** - every system we build starts with the people it serves.
* **We build for belonging** - students and colleagues should feel seen, respected, and known.
* **We focus on outcomes that matter** - completion, mobility, and impact in the field.
* **We take ownership and lead change** - we name what isn't working and fix it.
* **We work as one team** - we share the wins and the hard parts.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

Salary range: $106,000 - $123,000 annually

Compensation is commensurate with experience and education.

Positions hired at 75% time or higher are eligible for EDvance College's comprehensive benefits package (i.e., medical/dental/vision, 401k and additional peripheral benefits including but not limited to flexible spending accounts, life insurance, etc.).

Eligibility for medical/dental/vision benefits begins the first day of the month following the date of hire. Eligibility for 401k plan participation begins the first of the month 60 days following the date of hire.

**Who We Are**

Located in Houston, Texas, Teachers of Tomorrow is the leading national alternative certification program (ACP) provider with plans of continued growth in 2027! Through quality instruction and unparalleled support – Teachers of Tomorrow provides the most effective preparation for educators to make a meaningful difference in the lives of their students. To find out more, visit https://www.teachersoftomorrow.org

**About the Role**

Teachers of Tomorrow is looking for a highly organized and candidate-focused Talent Acquisition Coordinator to manage the day-to-day recruiting process across our organization.

In this role, you will support hiring from the moment a position is posted through the candidate’s offer and transition to onboarding. You will partner closely with hiring managers and the People & Culture team to keep searches moving, maintain strong candidate pipelines, and create a timely, welcoming experience for every applicant.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career recruiting or HR professional who enjoys connecting with people, managing multiple priorities, and improving processes. The position supports approximately 55 to 60 hires annually, including high-volume positions such as Enrollment Advisor and Program Advisor roles.

**What You'll Do**

*Sourcing and Screening*

* Post and manage open positions in our applicant tracking system and on external job boards
* Source qualified candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, employee referrals, and community partnerships
* Review applications and conduct initial phone screens based on criteria established with hiring managers
* Build and maintain candidate pipelines for recurring and high-volume positions

*Interview and Candidate Coordination*

* Schedule interviews and coordinate interview panels
* Communicate with candidates throughout each stage of the hiring process
* Provide candidates with clear, timely updates and next steps
* Collect interview feedback and help hiring managers stay on schedule
* Deliver an organized, professional, and positive candidate experience

*Offers and Pre-Employment*

* Prepare offer letters within approved compensation ranges and under the direction of the Senior Manager, People & Culture
* Initiate background checks and other required pre-employment steps
* Maintain accurate documentation and protect confidential candidate information
* Coordinate the handoff of new hires to the People & Culture Generalist for onboarding

*Reporting and Hiring Manager Partnership*

* Lead intake meetings with hiring managers to clarify role requirements and candidate qualifications
* Maintain accurate candidate, requisition, and hiring information in the applicant tracking system
* Provide weekly updates on open positions, candidate pipelines, and time-to-fill
* Identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes and the overall candidate experience

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* One to two years of experience in recruiting coordination, human resources, talent acquisition, or high-volume hiring
* Experience using an applicant tracking system is preferred
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several open positions at the same time
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through
* A commitment to providing a positive and timely candidate experience
* The ability to handle confidential information with discretion
* Comfort working with systems, reports, and recruiting data
* A proactive, reliable, collaborative, and responsive work style

**What We Offer**

We understand that our people are the most important factor in our success. As a result, we value and invest in our people through:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Employer paid STD and Basic Life/AD&D
* Voluntary buy up LTD, Life Insurance, Critical Illness, Accident, and additional wellness options
* 401k Plan with Company Safe Harbor Matching
* Competitive PTO & Sick Plan
* 12 paid holidays annually
* Personal and Professional Development

**Why Join Us**

At Teachers of Tomorrow, you will help build the team that supports aspiring educators on their path to the classroom. If you are energized by connecting people with opportunities, keeping complex processes organized, and creating a candidate experience that reflects our values, we encourage you to apply.

**Work Environment**

This is a remote position that involves working primarily at a computer and communicating by phone or video for extended periods. Occasional extended hours may be required during peak periods, including open enrollment or high-volume hiring cycles.

66718dc7f08049ba8899.description:
OnTrac is hiring a Senior Director, Driver Capacity Planning / Network Strategy!
  
  
Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!
  
  
Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.
  
  
**Location:** Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.
  
**Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $200,000 - $250,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $200,000 - $300,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.
  
This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan of up to a 30% Bonus Target.
  
  
**Employment Logistics:**  
The Senior Director, Driver Capacity Planning & Network Strategy leads the strategy, governance, and execution of driver and fleet capacity planning across OnTrac’s Last Mile network. This role ensures driver, Regional Service Provider (RSP), vehicle, and territory capacity align with forecasted demand, growth objectives, service requirements, and network economics. The Senior Director establishes the methodologies and operating mechanisms that translate volume forecasts into actionable resource strategies across markets and territories, advises senior leadership on capacity risks and investment priorities, and leads a multi-level capacity planning organization through subordinate leaders and team members.
  
  
**Unpacking the Benefits:**  
Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
* Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
* Two (2) floating holidays per year
* Paid sick leave\*
* Six (6) paid company holidays
* Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
* Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.
  
  
**The Must-Haves:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 15+ years of relevant experience in capacity planning, transportation, logistics, supply chain, network operations, workforce planning, or a related discipline, including experience leading a function through subordinate leaders
* Advanced knowledge of capacity planning, forecasting, workforce and resource planning, network strategy, and resource optimization methodologies
* Comprehensive understanding of Last Mile, transportation, logistics, or similarly complex distributed networks, including driver, fleet, territory, and delivery-partner capacity
* Advanced analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to translate complex forecasts and operational data into enterprise strategy, investment priorities, and executive-level recommendations
* Demonstrated experience leading leaders, building high-performing teams, and developing organizational capabilities and succession pipelines
* Ability to travel up to 15%
* ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

**Your Mission in Motion:**  
A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.
  

* Lead capacity strategy and governance: Define short-, medium-, and long-range driver and fleet capacity strategies, methodologies, operating mechanisms, thresholds, and escalation triggers that support forecasted growth and service commitments.
* Translate demand into capacity requirements: Convert volume forecasts, territory demand, and growth projections into driver, vehicle, RSP, fleet-mix, and market-level capacity plans based on route density, service requirements, and volume characteristics.
* Direct RSP and network capacity decisions: Establish frameworks for evaluating RSP readiness, utilization, driver availability, and fleet capacity, including when existing partners should scale or additional RSP capacity is required.
* Manage capacity across the network: Set guardrails for balancing capacity and moving volume across territories, markets, and delivery partners during demand fluctuations, volume surges, network shifts, launches, and expansions.
* Evaluate network scenarios and trade-offs: Assess capacity, service, utilization, and cost considerations to recommend territory expansion, consolidation, capacity redistribution, fleet deployment, and network design decisions.
* Align plans and guide executive decisions: Partner with Operations, Transportation, Finance, Product, and Business Development to align forecasts, investments, and operating plans, and present scenarios, risks, and business cases to senior leadership.
* Measure and improve capacity performance: Establish reporting for forecast accuracy, capacity health, network utilization, RSP readiness, and emerging risks while improving planning processes, analytics, and network scalability.
* Lead the function and its resources: Manage the function’s budget and lead a multi-level capacity planning organization by establishing priorities, strengthening accountability, developing leaders, and building succession pipelines.

**Paving your way to your success:**  

* You develop scenario models and evaluate capacity, service, utilization, and cost trade-offs across markets, territories, and operating partners.
* You establish scalable planning governance, performance measures, and operating mechanisms within a complex, matrixed environment.
* You anticipate disruptions, identify emerging capacity risks, and develop adaptive responses that protect network performance and service commitments.
* You communicate with influence, aligning senior and executive stakeholders across the enterprise as well as external delivery partners.
* You evaluate fundamental business issues by analyzing complex variables, operational interdependencies, and their broader financial and network implications.

**Posting Timeline:**  
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 15 days from the date of posting
  
  
**Disclosures:**  

* Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.

The salary range above represents the national range for this position. The salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at OnTrac, and the actual base salary offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to: Geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, job-related skills and competencies, market alignment, and financial considerations.
  
  
Compensation decisions are made based on the specific circumstances of each hire to ensure fair and competitive pay.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. If you require reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other employment benefits, please contact Human Resources.
  
  
If you are excited to be part of our team and grow with our OnTrac family, we invite you to apply!

3f0f3cb2e69e8fa2444d.title: Capital Projects Senior Consultant - Data Centers
3f0f3cb2e69e8fa2444d.description:
Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey-before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.  
  
Do you want to help clients identify key business issues to drive meaningful change? Join our team of Infrastructure & Capital Projects professionals who bring industry experience, innovation, and specialized knowledge to help our clients make the best decision for their business. Are you interested in helping clients answer critical, mission-based questions such as 'how do we complete major infrastructure projects on-time and within budget?' and 'how do we make use of new technologies to improve the construction process?' If you are seeking a role that offers you the opportunity to create value and minimize risk for our clients, while allowing you to develop personally and professionally, consider a career at Deloitte!  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Senior Consultant on the Capital Projects team, you will be responsible for:  

* Advising clients on data center capital projects across the project lifecycle, including feasibility and site assessments, utility coordination, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
* Leading workstreams for data center development, expansion, and upgrade programs, helping clients manage delivery, cost, schedule, risk, and project governance.
* Assessing project plans, controls, schedules, and risks, including dependencies on utility power and long-lead equipment such as substations, switchgear, UPS, generators, chillers, and cooling systems.
* Reviewing and analyzing project schedules, construction documents, and design information to identify constructability, coordination, sequencing, and delivery risks; partnering with technical design authorities as needed.
* Supporting project cost and schedule assurance, risk analysis, procurement planning, change management, data analytics, and actionable performance reporting.
* Supporting commissioning and operational readiness by reviewing plans, test documentation, integrated systems testing, and turnover processes.
* Working with client stakeholders, design teams, contractors, equipment vendors, utility providers, and operations teams to resolve issues and advance project outcomes.
* Leading teams and workstreams; providing coaching, oversight, and support to delivery teams and staff.
Supporting proposal development, client relationship development, business development, and practice recruiting and staffing efforts.  

  
  
**A successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  

  
  
**The team**  
  
Deloitte's Infrastructure and Real Estate team are trusted advisors to clients in managing physical assets throughout their lifecycle. We help them unlock value from their real estate portfolios and functions by developing strategies, optimizing operating models and organizational design, and leveraging technology enablement.  
  
**Qualifications required**  

* Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering or construction management, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience supporting capital projects, construction, or project delivery, including data center, mission-critical facilities, or similarly complex infrastructure or building projects
* Experience with project controls and schedule development or analysis using Primavera P6
* Experience working on major construction projects, including reviewing and analyzing construction documents
* Experience assessing cost, schedule, risk, procurement, or project governance processes
* Familiarity with data center project interfaces across electrical power, mechanical cooling, controls, and building systems
* Experience in business development, strategic planning, and managing client relationships
* Experience supervising, training, and developing junior staff on client requirements as well as assessing staff performance
* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools and digital technologies to improve efficiency, support analysis, and enhance the quality of work products
* You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodation
* You can expect to co-locate on average 1-2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited sponsorship may be available  

  
  
**Preferred:**  

* MBA or a Master's degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, or project management
* Direct experience with data center or other mission-critical facility projects, including hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, or campus environments
* Experience with commissioning, integrated systems testing, operational readiness, or facility turnover
* Familiarity with data center power and cooling redundancy concepts, such as N+1 or 2N, and efficiency measures such as Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE)
* Professional certifications such as PE, ASA, PMP, CFA, CFE, CCE, or CPA
* Experience using Project Management tools, including Oracle Unifier, Procore, Hexagon Ecosys, Kahua, Primavera P6, and Power BI
* Experience in a professional services firm
* International project or client engagement experience
Multi-lingual  

  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

4f8d25aa130e2b9aeb8a.title: Senior Safety Coordinator
4f8d25aa130e2b9aeb8a.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Senior Safety Coordinator supports the Division Safety Program by enforcing and coordinating safety procedures to ensure compliance with company, federal, state, and local safety regulations. This role partners closely with field operations and leadership to promote a proactive safety culture, conduct safety inspections, support employee training, and drive continuous safety improvement across construction projects.

**Position Details**
--------------------

* Conduct safety inspections of job sites ranging from small projects to large, complex construction projects.
* Monitor compliance with company policies and OSHA regulations.
* Report safety concerns and assist leadership in implementing corrective actions.
* Coordinate and support safety programs and initiatives aligned with the company's safety management system.
* Document safety observations, identify hazards, and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor resolution of non-compliance issues and ensure timely corrective action.
* Maintain safety records including accident reports, inspection documentation, and training logs.
* Review job hazard analyses and implement follow-up actions as necessary.
* Provide emergency response support as needed.
* Assist with accident and injury investigations and regulatory reporting activities.
* Develop and facilitate employee safety training programs.
* Train and mentor less-experienced safety professionals.
* Exercise independent judgment while collaborating with leadership on significant safety decisions.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Health or Environmental Applied Sciences or related discipline, or equivalent education, training and/or experience.
* 3+ years of relevant experience, including employee training experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* CPR and First Aid certification; CPR and First Aid instructor preferred.
* OSHA 10hr, OSHA 30hr, OSHA 40hr training.
* OSHA 500, Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST), or Associate Safety Professional (ASP) certification.
* Experience using Microsoft Office.
* Experience mentoring safety professionals.
* Excellent working knowledge of health and safety management systems; OSHA CFR 1926 standards or the state construction safety regulations.
* Sound knowledge of safety operating processes and procedures.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service, organizational, and relationship-building skills.

**Pay**
-------

This is a consolidated salary range reflecting the anticipated pay range across the U.S. geographic locations where this position may be based. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s primary work location, experience, qualifications, skills, and other job-related factors, consistent with applicable law.

Salary Range: $84,886 - $127,722 annually, plus annual incentive, benefits, and retirement programs as outlined below.

**Physical and Travel Requirements**
------------------------------------

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to sit 1/3rd of the time; use hands to finger 2/3rds of the time; walk 2/3rds of the time; stand 2/3rds of the time; reach with hands and arms 2/3rds of the time; stoop, kneel, crouch 1/3rd of the time; talk or hear 2/3rds of the time. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Travels more than 50% of time.

**Safety Sensitive Role**
-------------------------

This position has been designated as safety-sensitive under Washington law (RCW 49.44.240). Applicants selected for this position will be subject to applicable pre-employment drug screening requirements, consistent with applicable law and company policy.

**Benefits**

As a 100% employee-owned company, we offer a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family:

* 401(k) plan with **50% company match (no cap)** and immediate 100% vesting
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance **(100% paid for employee)**
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, achievement, and company profitability
* Term life, AD&D insurance, and voluntary life insurance
* Disability income protection insurance
* Pre-tax flexible spending plans (health and dependent care)
* **Paid parental leave**
* Paid holidays, vacation, and personal time
* Training/professional development opportunities and company-paid memberships for professional associations and licenses
* Wellness benefits

**About Southland Industries**

As one of the nation’s largest MEP companies, Southland Industries is built on the foundation of great people. Since 1949, we have put our people first, enabling growth, professional achievement, and innovation. If you want to join a fast-paced environment where you’re engaged, challenged, and valued, apply now to join our dynamic team. To learn more about careers at Southland, explore our career opportunities, follow us on LinkedIn, and check out our website.

**Reasonable Accommodation**

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application or participate in the hiring process, please contact Southland recruiting at recruiting@southlandind.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Southland Industries and all its subsidiaries are an **Equal Opportunity Employer** and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing our employees with a safe work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Southland Industries are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, family care or medical leave status, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Southland Industries will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

**Contingent Employment**

All employment offers are contingent upon successful drug tests, background checks, and professional reference checks. Roles that include driving as an essential job duty will be required to have a successful Motor Vehicle Record check (MVR). We are not able to offer sponsorship of employment at this time.

**External Agency Announcement**

**Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.**

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

**Summary of Position**

In this role you can shine on the front lines as a trusted advisor for our clients. Acting in a multi-faceted role as coach, analyst, strategic advisor, project manager, and product expert, you’ll focus on helping our clients improve the benefits they reap from working with Teladoc Health products and platforms. You’ll manage your own strategic portfolio of Teladoc Health’s small to medium-sized clients, ensuring they are continually driving value for their business in the form of increased member enrollments, participation, and renewals. Ultimately your efforts will lead to better health for your clients’ members.

As you manage your own client portfolio, you’ll also support the team’s Client Managers with more complex client accounts, and thus gain the experience you need to grow into a management or leadership role in the department. This is your chance for both growth opportunity and personal gratification, as you support a mission that measurably improves people’s lives.

  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of Teladoc Health clients, which may include enterprise employers, health plans and providers
* Work with clients to define and execute a Teladoc Health program strategy, integrated with their broader benefit offerings
* Work with Teladoc Health Client Executives and clients to define and execute a Teladoc Health program strategy, integrated with their broader benefit offerings
* Manage client issues and escalations, collaborating with partner teams such as Client Strategy/Launch, Member Support, Operations, Analytics, R&D, and Sales, as required
* Lead team projects to develop processes, new tools, and intellectual capital that will better support team efforts
* Support senior team members in cross-functional project efforts and ad hoc reporting
* Support senior team members in development of client or meeting materials
* Develop metrics for success/ROI based on each client’s goals and review progress on a regular basis
* Ensure clients and their members are utilizing key product features to maximize success
Identify client challenges and risk areas, develop solutions, and execute proactively to avoid churn

* 3+ years of experience working in a customer-facing role at a digital health, healthcare, wellness, benefits or SaaS company
* Strong interpersonal, relationship-building and listening skills, with a natural, effective consultative style
* A sincere interest in your clients and co-workers
* The flexibility and agility to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment
* A strong focus on results, with a passion for finding smarter, better ways to achieve goals
* Strong problem-solving skills and keen attention to detail
High level of productivity, reliability, responsibility, attendance, dependability, organization and accuracy/thoroughness
