**Mass Channel** **Operations & Customer Support Analyst**

The Mass Channel Operations & Customer Support Analyst supports the Mass Channel business, including Mass Channel field teams, vendors, and internal and external customers. This role combines day-to-day operational and customer support (resolving field and customer issues, maintaining order and project information, and coordinating across departments) with the data analysis and reporting that help leadership track Mass Channel performance, execute Mass Channel field projects, and improve processes. The Mass Channel Operations & Customer Support Analyst works closely with Director, Retail Operations and serves as a key point of coordination for the Mass Channel business between multiple internal departments and external stakeholders.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Serve as a point of contact for field employees and customers, resolving operational and customer issues via phone, email, and digital channels

* Ensure a timely and professional response to all incoming calls and inquiries, escalating issues when additional support is needed

* Communicate and advise on company information, policies, and procedures related to field operations

* Coordinate with several departments, including but not limited to Buying, Customer Service, Distribution Centers, Customer Development, and internal field teams, on various projects and initiatives

* Create, maintain, and communicate schedules and milestones for field projects; track progress and follow up to ensure goals and deadlines are met

* Liaise with project stakeholders on project details, status, and deliverables

* Collect, analyze, and interpret operational, field, and customer service data to prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and documents for RSM leadership on the Mass Channel business

* Identify trends, gaps, and recurring issues in field execution and customer support, and recommend process improvements that increase team and field efficiency

* Enter, maintain, and audit order and project information in company systems and databases to ensure accuracy and completeness

* Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents

* Support the training of new or less experienced team members on systems, reports, and processes as needed

* Administrative tasks – data entry, database maintenance, electronic filing

* Effectively maneuver through multiple system screens, utilize available departmental tools/information, and request assistance as needed

* Understand and demonstrate safe work practices at all times to ensure a safe work environment

* Comply with all company policies and procedures

* Complete special projects and other duties as assigned by your supervisor

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with an ability to work with all levels of staff and management, including Sr. leadership

* Service-oriented with a history of building excellent customer relationships

* Self-motivated and proactive, with critical attention to detail, work accuracy, and deadlines

* Ability to handle multiple projects and tasks, and prioritize with exceptional organizational skills

* Excellent interpersonal skills

* Ability to work in a team environment as well as independently

* High technical aptitude for systems and data – high proficiency with Excel and other data analytic systems/software

**Experience and Credentials**

* High School Diploma required; an associate's or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field preferred

* Minimum 2 years of experience in customer service, operations support, administrative support, or a data/reporting role

* Experience working within retail, retail service merchandising, hardlines, or consumer products-related industries (retail, wholesale, and/or grocery channels preferred)

dfd9afa699cd1464c7c1.description:
**APPLY**
---------

  

**Metadata and Data Analyst**

  
  
  

**The Opportunity**
  
The Metadata and Data Analyst supports Cornell University Press’s marketing and sales operations by maintaining accurate, timely, and effective metadata. This position also analyzes internal and external data to strengthen marketing and sales strategies, improve book discoverability, and support informed operational decision-making.

  
  

**About** **the Cornell University Press**

Cornell University Press publishes influential, lasting scholarship that encourages broad and sustained inquiry. Its Marketing and Sales team promotes the Press’s brand, imprints, authors, books, and initiatives through creative and innovative marketing strategies.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee metadata and data workflows supporting the Marketing and Sales team, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and adherence to industry best practices.

* Manage and monitor the Press’s ONIX metadata feed through Allbooks and CoreSource to ensure accurate and effective distribution to external partners and marketplaces.

* Review, maintain, and enhance metadata for frontlist and backlist titles to improve book representation, visibility, and discoverability across digital platforms and sales channels.

* Analyze internal and external marketing and sales data, including sales reports, Google Analytics, and social media analytics, to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

* Develop and prepare regular reports and data analyses for the Director of Marketing and Sales, senior leadership, and other stakeholders to support strategic planning and decision-making.

* Translate complex data and analytical findings into actionable insights to support marketing strategies, sales performance, and operational improvements.

* Coordinate metadata and data workflows across departments, collaborating with acquisitions, editorial, production, finance, and Marketing and Sales colleagues to maintain quality and consistency.
  

  

**What We Need**

**For further consideration, please submit a resume and cover letter.**

* Bachelor’s degree in publishing, marketing, business, information science, data analytics, communications, or a related field, and at least two years of relevant professional experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* In-depth knowledge of ONIX and book metadata standards and best practices.

* Experience managing metadata workflows and maintaining data quality to support book discoverability, sales, and external distribution.

* Knowledge of data analysis, data modeling, database management, and website and social media analytics.

* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot metadata and system-related issues, identify solutions, and improve workflows.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with internal departments, external vendors, digital partners, and other stakeholders.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex information and present findings clearly to varied audiences.

* Broad understanding of the book publishing industry, including the role of metadata and data in publishing, distribution, marketing, and sales.
  

  

**If you have all those things, great! We have a few more things that we would prefer you to have, but it’s ok if you don’t.**

* Bachelor's degree with five or more years of relevant professional experience.

* Familiarity with digital distribution, retail, and publishing platforms, such as Amazon Vendor Central, Firebrand, JSTOR, and Project MUSE.

* Experience coordinating metadata delivery and system-related workflows with customer service and order fulfillment partners.

* Knowledge of metadata distribution systems, including Firebrand and external metadata recipient platforms.

* Familiarity with Google Analytics and social media analytics to support marketing and sales analysis.

* Understanding of artificial intelligence and its potential applications in metadata management, marketing, sales, and data workflows.

* Experience improving cross-departmental workflows and developing documentation related to data and metadata management.
  

  
  

**This is a full-time (40 hours/week), fully remote position based in Ithaca, NY. Core hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. The final schedule will be established in collaboration with the supervisor.**

  
  
  

**Rewards and Benefits**

* This position is based in Ithaca, New York, however, the successful applicant may perform this role remotely anywhere within the United States. Employees who work remotely may receive multiple W-2 Forms depending on their work location.
* The New York Convenience of employer guidelines require New York State individual tax reporting and withholding for this position. Additional individual state income tax filings may also be required if working temporarily outside of New York State.
* Cornell receives national recognition as an award-winning workplace for our health, wellbeing, and sustainability.
  

  

* Our benefits programs include comprehensive health care options, generous retirement contributions, access to wellness programs, and employee discounts with local and national retail brands. We invite you to follow this link to get more information about our benefits: Understand Your Benefits | Working at Cornell.
  

  

* Our leave provisions include health and personal leave, three weeks of vacation and 13 holidays: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, and an end of the year winter break from December 25-January 1. To offer greater flexibility for observing faiths and traditions we also offer two additional floating holidays. Learn more about our generous leave provisions: Holiday and Accrued Time Off | Working at Cornell
  

  

* Cornell's impressive educational benefits include tuition-free Extramural Study and Employee Degree Program, tuition aid for external education, and Cornell Children's Tuition Assistance Program. Learn more about our extensive educational benefits: Education Benefits | Working at Cornell

**Job Summary:** ICS is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Account Services Coordinator to join our growing team. This is a client-facing role responsible for maintaining consistent communication with customers, managing project details, and coordinating with internal departments to ensure the successful execution of direct mail projects from start to finish.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who can build strong client relationships, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and provide timely updates throughout the production process. This individual must thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, and be committed to delivering an outstanding client experience.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients, maintaining consistent communication through email, phone calls, and video conferences.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing timely responses, proactive updates, and exceptional customer service.

* Demonstrated ability to communicate professionally and effectively with clients through email, phone, and video conferencing.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects, managing competing priorities, and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments and levels of the organization.

560f422c906ad9372426.description:
**Xplor Technologies** powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

We unite popular brands such as **foreUP**, **myFitApp**, **Vermont Systems**, **Momence**, **Exerp**, **Mariana Tek**, **Resamania**, **FieldEdge**, **CampBrain** and many more.

Join our Golf & Club vertical as a Senior Manager, Customer Support to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.

The Senior Manager, Customer Support provides strategic and operational leadership for the Customer Support organization. This role leads both individual contributors and people leaders, including the Level 1 Supervisor, and is accountable for building a scalable support model that delivers timely, accurate, and consistent service to clients.

The Senior Manager establishes the support strategy, operating framework, performance expectations, and development approach for the team. The position coaches leaders, strengthens onboarding and continued education, oversees workforce planning and service-level performance, and ensures employees have the tools, knowledge, processes, and escalation support required to succeed. This role also serves as a senior escalation point for complex client issues and partners closely with Sales, Product Management, Development, Education, and other business leaders to improve the customer experience and address recurring product or process issues.

The ideal candidate is a knowledgeable SaaS support leader who can balance strategy with hands-on execution, develop other leaders, use data to drive decisions, and translate business priorities into clear goals for multiple levels of the organization.

**Some of the things you'll do:**

* Lead a multi-layer support organization, including the Level 1 Supervisor, owning team performance, engagement, and development, and coach leaders to manage people and daily operations independently.
* Lead hiring, onboarding, ongoing education, succession planning, career paths, and development plans in partnership with Human Resources, Education, and other internal partners.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, talent reviews, performance evaluations, and calibration discussions; address performance concerns promptly and fairly.
* Build a collaborative, inclusive, and client-focused culture across teams and locations within the United States.
* Develop and execute the support strategy, service model, and annual priorities in line with company goals, translating them into measurable objectives, staffing plans, workflows, roles, and decision rights.
* Oversee daily and long-range operations across chat, ticket, and phone channels, owning workforce planning, scheduling, coverage, and business continuity to meet client service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Develop and enforce support best practices, SOPs, quality controls, escalation procedures, and knowledge resources, adapting the operating model as products, clients, and business needs evolve.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for high-impact or complex client escalations, directing resolution, documentation, and client follow-up.
* Partner with Sales, Product Management, Development, and Education to resolve customer issues, share support insights, and improve the end-to-end client experience and retention.
* Collaborate with other support leaders to establish consistent practices, escalation standards, and shared accountability across teams and product lines.
* Define and monitor KPIs for service levels, quality, productivity, backlog, escalations, and customer satisfaction; report results to senior leadership and lead corrective action when targets are missed.
* Analyze support data, trends, and employee feedback to identify root causes, client pain points, knowledge gaps, and automation opportunities, and drive practical improvements to workflows and staffing.
* Demonstrate effective change leadership by clearly communicating business rationale, anticipating team impacts, and supporting adoption of new processes, tools, and expectations.
* Perform other duties and lead additional initiatives as assigned by the leadership team.

**Working arrangements:**

  

* Fully Remote in United States**:** You can work remotely in this position, provided you reside in **United States**,have full working rights and do not require sponsorship.

**Qualifications**

**What would make me a good candidate?**

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

**You'll need:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in customer support, technical support, customer operations, or a related field with people-leadership experience, including experience leading or developing supervisors, managers, or other people leaders.
* Demonstrated experience managing a multi-layer support organization with accountability for both leaders and individual contributors.
* Strong knowledge of customer support best practices, case-management systems, omnichannel support operations, workforce planning, quality programs, and service-level management.
* Experience using support data and operational metrics to diagnose issues, set priorities, and improve team and customer outcomes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees, clients, executives, and cross-functional partners, both verbally and in writing.
* Excellent leadership, coaching, collaboration, organizational, time-management, customer-service, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, make sound decisions during escalations, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions.
* Strong client-relationship and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to navigate sensitive or high-impact situations.
* Experience in software-as-a-service (SaaS) environments required; experience supporting multiple product lines is strongly preferred.
* Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple locations within the United States.
* Demonstrated ability to develop supervisors and managers to lead independently, consistently, and with accountability.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business priorities into practical operating plans, measurable goals, and team expectations.

*At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you don't tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.*  
  
**Values and Life at Xplor**

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

* Find a better way
* Do the right thing
* Say it straight
* Win together
* Own the outcome

If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

**Ready to apply?**

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can.

**Orchardline Systems**

*Making useful products easier to understand and adopt.*

Orchardline Systems develops workflow software for service businesses and distributed teams. Our product marketing group connects customer needs, product capabilities, sales conversations, and clear messaging so the market understands the value of what we build.

**Product Marketing Specialist**

**Location:** United States  
**Work arrangement:** Fully remote  
**Employment:** Full-time, salaried  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 40 hours per week; occasional additional time during major product launches  
**Base salary:** $82,000–$108,000 per year, depending on relevant experience and qualifications  
**Annual bonus:** 7.5% target bonus based on company and individual performance  
**Reports to:** Head of Product Marketing

Role overview

The Product Marketing Specialist helps position products, prepare launches, and give customer-facing teams the materials they need to communicate value clearly. You will work with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing without needing to write software.

What you’ll do

* Develop product messaging, positioning, value propositions, and audience-specific talking points.
* Support product launches from planning through customer and market communication.
* Create sales presentations, one-pagers, FAQs, email copy, website content, and training materials.
* Interview customers and internal teams to understand needs, objections, and use cases.
* Research competitors, pricing, market trends, and customer segments.
* Prepare launch briefs and coordinate deadlines across Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Maintain product information, messaging libraries, and internal enablement resources.
* Support webinars, customer announcements, product demos, and partner materials.
* Track campaign and launch performance and recommend improvements.
* Ensure product communications are accurate, consistent, and easy to understand.

What we’re looking for

* Two or more years of experience in product marketing, marketing, content, sales enablement, customer success, or market research.
* Strong writing, editing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate complex product information into clear customer benefits.
* Comfortable working with customer feedback, market data, and competitive research.
* Organized approach to launches, approvals, and cross-functional deadlines.
* Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Asana, or similar.

A bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience with B2B products or SaaS is helpful; coding experience is not required.

Benefits

* 401(k) with a company match of up to 4%.
* 20 days of paid time off, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
* Paid parental leave, life insurance, and short-term disability coverage.
* $1,500 annual learning budget for marketing, research, or communications courses.
* Company laptop, monitor, secure home-office equipment, and internet stipend.
* Employee assistance program and wellness resources.

Hiring process

* A 30-minute introductory call with a People Operations recruiter.
* A 45-minute interview with the Head of Product Marketing.
* A short product-positioning and messaging exercise.
* A panel conversation with Product, Sales, and Customer Success representatives.
* Final reference and employment-verification checks, followed by a conditional written offer.

Pay: $82,000.00 - $108,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

520c6dd360d9deed7b60.description:
**About Sparkfund**
-------------------

Sparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid. Through its Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) model, Sparkfund enables utilities, energy majors, and large-load customers to deploy front-of-the-meter batteries and gensets as distribution infrastructure. By adding targeted capacity exactly where and when the grid needs it most, DCP helps meet demand, support reliability, and put downward pressure on rates. Sparkfund supports program design, grid value assessment, asset host engagement, and value chain management to ensure on-time, on-budget deployment with maximum system value and lowest cost.

With more than 3,200 projects deployed across 43 states and more than 300MW of energized assets constructed, Sparkfund is transforming customer-sited assets into a valuable portfolio resource for the benefit of our society. To learn more about Sparkfund, visit sparkfund.com.

**Senior Analyst, Program Operations**
--------------------------------------

**Remote – United States (Preference for Fort Collins, CO or Twin Cities, MN area)**

**About the Role**
------------------

Sparkfund is looking for a Senior Analyst, Program Operations to build, manage, and improve the operational tools, reporting systems, and data infrastructure supporting our Capacity\*Connect Program, our flagship distributed capacity program. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building practical solutions, working across systems, and turning complex operational information into reliable tools that help teams make decisions and deliver results. Rather than simply maintaining existing reports or processes, you'll help design and build the infrastructure that supports a growing program.

Working closely with the Director, Program Operations, you'll translate program priorities and identified operational needs into dashboards, trackers, KPI reporting, workflows, and system automations. You'll determine how these tools should be structured and built within approved platforms, including Smartsheet, Salesforce, Procore, and connected systems.You'll also be responsible for maintaining data accuracy, investigating discrepancies, monitoring program activity, and ensuring leadership and utility partners have reliable information about program performance.

During your first six months, you'll focus on establishing and improving the core reporting and operational toolset for Capacity\*Connect. As the program and Sparkfund's broader DCP product evolve, you'll help expand these tools and processes to support additional programs.

This is a hands-on individual contributor position reporting to the Director, Program Operations. The role requires independent execution, strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to identify and implement improvements while knowing when broader input or alignment is needed.

**How We Work at Sparkfund**
----------------------------

Our values shape how we work, make decisions, and show up for our customers and each other. They are also part of how we evaluate success at Sparkfund.

**Excellence**

We hold ourselves to high standards and continuously look for ways to improve.

In this role, Excellence means building accurate, reliable reporting and operational tools that teams can trust. It means taking the time to understand data discrepancies, delivering high-quality work, and continuously improving dashboards, workflows, and processes to make program operations more effective.

**Stewardship**

We take ownership, follow through on our commitments, and make thoughtful decisions with the long term in mind.

For this role, Stewardship means taking responsibility for the accuracy of program data, maintaining dependable systems, and recognizing how reporting and operational decisions affect program delivery, leadership decisions, and utility partner commitments. It also means building scalable solutions rather than short-term fixes and using company resources thoughtfully.

**Positivity**

We approach challenges constructively, assume positive intent, support one another, and bring solutions.

For this role, Positivity means approaching operational challenges with curiosity and a solutions-oriented mindset. It means working collaboratively across teams to resolve data issues, communicating concerns clearly and respectfully, and helping others adopt tools and processes that make their work easier and more effective.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Build & Scale Program Operations Tools**

* Design and build dashboards, trackers, KPI and SLA reporting, and operational workflows based on priorities established by the Director, Program Operations.
* Determine practical data structures, reporting formats, and build approaches within approved platforms.
* Configure, maintain, and improve tools in Smartsheet and other program management systems.
* Develop automations and system connections using tools such as Zapier, Salesforce, Slack, Procore, and other connected platforms.
* Structure reporting and dashboards around the information different audiences need to evaluate program performance and make decisions.
* Develop reusable templates, workflows, and reporting structures that can be adapted for additional Sparkfund programs.
* Document tools, processes, automations, and system configurations to support consistency, version control, and future scalability.

**Maintain Data Integrity & Program Reporting**

* Monitor and maintain the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of program data across Smartsheet, Salesforce, Procore, and other connected systems.
* Track program milestones, action items, ownership, due dates, project statuses, KPIs, and other operational indicators.
* Identify and investigate missing information, inconsistent data, reporting discrepancies, and stalled activities.
* Work with internal stakeholders to resolve data issues and escalate risks before they affect program delivery or reporting.
* Validate program performance metrics and reporting to ensure leadership and utility partners receive accurate, timely information.
* Prepare data tracking and draft programmatic reports required under Capacity\*Connect reporting requirements for Director review and subsequent leadership approval.
* Provide targeted analysis and reporting to support program decisions, leadership requests, and operational planning.

**Improve Processes & System Efficiency**

* Identify recurring bottlenecks, manual processes, reporting gaps, and data quality issues that affect program operations.
* Translate identified problems into practical improvements through the program's intake, triage, and continuous improvement process.
* Evaluate opportunities to simplify workflows, standardize processes, and reduce repetitive administrative work through automation.
* Determine whether operational issues require individual corrections or broader changes to systems, workflows, or data structures.
* Implement approved improvements and monitor their effectiveness.
* Help establish repeatable processes and scalable operational infrastructure as Capacity\*Connect and additional Sparkfund programs develop.

**Collaborate Across Teams**

* Partner with Program Management, Project Delivery, Commercialization, and other internal stakeholders to understand reporting and operational needs.
* Translate operational requirements into practical dashboards, workflows, and system solutions.
* Communicate data discrepancies, reporting concerns, and proposed improvements clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support consistent use of program tools and processes by providing documentation, guidance, and troubleshooting.
* Proactively communicate progress, risks, and recommendations to the Director, Program Operations.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, operations, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of professional experience in operations analysis, reporting, data analytics, program coordination, business operations, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience building dashboards, reporting tools, trackers, or operational workflows from the ground up.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and experience organizing, analyzing, and validating data from multiple sources.
* Experience identifying data discrepancies, investigating root causes, and resolving or appropriately escalating issues.
* Track record of producing accurate, reliable reporting and maintaining data integrity across operational systems.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently within established priorities, make practical implementation decisions, and follow through on assignments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data, operational issues, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to travel approximately 5% for occasional company meetings and gatherings.

This role requires hands-on experience building and maintaining reporting, data, or operational tools. Experience limited to administrative coordination or preparing routine reports without responsibility for data quality, tool development, or process improvement does not fully meet the requirements of this position.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience configuring and maintaining Smartsheet dashboards, workflows, and reporting tools.
* Experience with Salesforce, Procore, or similar operational systems.
* Experience developing integrations or automations using Zapier or comparable platforms.
* Familiarity with data connectors, system integrations, and methods for maintaining consistency across multiple systems.
* Experience in energy, utilities, infrastructure, construction, or other complex, multi-stakeholder program environments.
* Experience supporting executive, client-facing, or external partner reporting.
* Experience building reporting infrastructure or operational systems in an organization where processes and tools are still evolving.
* Familiarity with KPI and SLA tracking, program performance reporting, and continuous improvement methodologies.

**What Will Help You Succeed**
------------------------------

**Data Accuracy & Reporting**

You understand the importance of reliable data and how inaccurate information can affect program decisions and delivery. You're comfortable working across multiple systems, identifying inconsistencies, investigating their source, and developing reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of program performance.

**Systems & Automation**

You enjoy working with technology and finding better ways to get things done. You can build practical dashboards, trackers, workflows, and automations that reduce manual effort and improve consistency. You think about how different systems connect and how information should move between them.

**Independent Ownership**

You take responsibility for your work, manage priorities effectively, and follow through without needing constant direction. You're comfortable making decisions about how to structure and build tools within established priorities and know when an issue requires additional input or escalation.

**Continuous Improvement & Scalability**

You look beyond immediate problems to understand what can be improved across the broader operating model. Rather than repeatedly correcting the same issue, you identify opportunities to standardize processes, automate workflows, and build solutions that can support future growth.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

You work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, understand their operational needs, and translate those needs into practical solutions. You communicate clearly, raise issues early, and help teams understand and use the tools that support their work.

**Problem-Solving & Judgment**

You can navigate incomplete information, changing requirements, and competing operational priorities. You know when to investigate independently, when to recommend a change, and when to bring a decision forward for broader discussion. You balance attention to detail with an understanding of the larger program objectives.

**Compensation**
----------------

The approved salary range for this position is **$90,000–$120,000**, based on experience, qualifications, and location.

Where applicable, this position may also be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Any such compensation is separate from base salary and is not guaranteed. Eligibility, amounts, and payment are subject to applicable plan terms, company performance, individual performance, and other business considerations.

**Benefits**
------------

Sparkfund offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
* 401(k) plan with a 2% employer match
* Flexible vacation policy
* Paid federal holidays
* Flexible Fridays (half-day Fridays every week)
* 12 weeks of gender-neutral paid caregiver leave
* One-time work-from-home stipend for eligible remote roles
* Monthly phone and internet allowance

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This position is remote within the United States, with a preference for candidates located in or near Minneapolis, MN or Fort Collins, CO. Occasional travel of approximately 5% may be required for company meetings and gatherings. Relocation assistance is not available. The role is primarily performed in a remote office environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
--------------------------------

Sparkfund is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Sparkfund also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, in all phases of the hiring process and throughout employment. If you need an accommodation, please let us know.

**Disclaimer**
--------------

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties, responsibilities, and requirements may change at any time based on business needs. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply — even if you do not meet every listed qualification — as skills and competencies can develop in different ways.

50b299decc4ffe9d44d9.title: Client Specialist - eCommerce Business & Sales Operations
50b299decc4ffe9d44d9.description:
**About HigherRing:**  
HigherRing is the ethical outsourcing partner for socially responsible companies. We harness business as a force for good and partner with impact organizations to lighten their load and further their purpose. We create remote, impact employment where our team members and clients are valued and supported in their efforts to advance us all toward a more sustainable world. HigherRing is a B Corp and a 1% for the Planet member.

**About the Role:**  
Client Specialist - eCommerce Business & Sales Operations. Wage Information - $25.00-$27.00/hr. Part-time, remote W-2 position with full benefits. The schedule is a four-hour morning shift starting at 8 or 9 a.m. PT. The role starts in early December 2026.  
  
This role will support a growing eCommerce/CPG brand, working directly with the company's President and its fractional VP of Sales. This role will run sales administration and back-office projects so that leadership can stay focused on growing the business.  
  
This role is still taking shape. You will spend your first weeks learning the work and documenting it as you go. Clear, lasting documentation is a core part of the job from day one.  
  
We are looking for someone experienced to work directly with company leadership without needing work handed to them in small pieces. You enjoy creating order out of chaos and are comfortable when the path is not fully mapped.  
  
You are also very comfortable with AI. You use AI tools every day to work faster and more accurately, and you help the team find better ways to use them. You also know where AI falls short and always check its output.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Sales administration**  

* Organize trade shows and handle logistics, including booth, samples, collateral, travel, and follow-up lists.
* Set up, maintain, and report from the CRM (currently HubSpot, with a possible move to a newer wholesale CRM)
* Research accounts and prospects
* Support sales reporting

  
**Back-office operations**  

* Load recipes and other content to the company website in Shopify
* Keep the sales manual current
* Take on projects that would otherwise fall to the President

  
**Documentation**  

* Document all work as you learn it, so procedures are clear and usable by others
* Keep documentation current as the role and systems change

  
**Supporting leadership**  

* Work directly with the President and the fractional VP of Sales, who directs the sales work day to day
* Come to check-ins ready to discuss priorities, project status, and open questions
* Work alongside the company's local team member, who handles in-person events and customer visits.
* Perform other duties as requested

**Further Details:**

* This role requires close communication and collaboration with the Client company management. The Client Specialist - eCommerce Business & Sales Operations will meet daily with the Client CEO to talk through challenges and sales opportunities. The Client Specialist - eCommerce Business & Sales Operations will prepare for these meetings by being ready to discuss pertinent topics such as:
  + Deliverables
  + Project statuses
  + Client issues
  + Business development opportunities
  + Preparation for internal meetings
* The Client Specialist - eCommerce Business & Sales Operations will likely help the Client CEO specifically in the following ways:
  + CRM sales pipeline maintenance
  + Sending out sales emails
  + Following a sales process
  + Preparation for internal team meetings
  + Client development work as requested
* The Client Specialist - eCommerce Business & Sales Operations will document their work so that we have good operating procedures around the work based on the training provided.
* Perform other duties as requested.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**  

* Experience supporting company leadership in a sales operations, marketing operations, or business operations role.
* Real hands-on CRM experience (HubSpot strongly preferred), with the judgment to tell a reporting problem from a data problem.
* Trade show coordination and logistics experience.
* Comfortable loading pages and content in Shopify without a developer.
* Strong writer who can turn what you learn into clear procedures.
* Comfortable in an undefined role, learning and documenting at the same time.
* Proactive self-starter with excellent judgment.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong organization skills.
* Strong tech skills, including working across browsers, tabs, and tools, and hands-on daily use of AI tools (such

as ChatGPT, Claude, or AI features in business software), with examples you can share of how you use them.  

* Fluent in spoken and written English. A second language is a plus.
* Available for a four-hour morning shift starting at 8 or 9 a.m. Pacific, beginning in early December 2026.
* Reliable home workspace: quiet, distraction-free, with a door that closes.
* Hard-wired Ethernet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload speeds.

To ensure the security of client data, team members may NOT use satellite or public network connections. Depending on the team, VPN may not be allowed.

HigherRing is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status, in any of its activities or operations.

Further, we are looking for people who want to use their power for good. We believe in a woman's right to choose, that everyone deserves to be able to easily vote, that guns should be regulated with at least the same laws applicable to car ownership (licensing and insurance), that we should be vaccinated and wear masks during a pandemic, that white supremacy is a past and growing problem, that humans are responsible for climate change and that it presents a clear and present danger to life on this earth. If those concepts don't align with your worldview, we may not be the employer for you.

OUR BENEFITS PACKAGE INCLUDES:

* Employee (not contractor) status at an exciting, socially-minded company
* Option to participate in medical, dental, and vision insurance programs
* 401(k) plan with a 2% match contribution
* Paid vacation after your first year
* Paid sick leave
* A financial wellness and coaching program - 0% loans to help pay down debt
* Opportunity for everyone to be an owner in the company. Our Employee Stock Incentive Plan is offered to all employees.
* A fast-paced work environment where Team Member input is valued, and where mutual respect and camaraderie are a significant part of our culture.

NOTE:

Currently, we are able to hire in the following states only. Please only apply if you live in and would be working from one of these states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Mississippi, Nevada, North Carolina, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia and Wisconsin.

READY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEPS?

Visit our Careers page at HigherRing Careers to take the first steps!

Please be sure to (1) fully answer all the application questions, (2) add your resume/CV, and (3) include a cover letter! (We can’t consider you without all three submissions.)

489aa068f8f1d97404dc.title: Case Manager / Coordinator of Community Services (CCS)
489aa068f8f1d97404dc.description:
**Case Manager / Coordinator of Community Services (CCS)**

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Setting:** Community-Based | Home-Based Administrative Work | Regional Travel Required

**Location**: Salisbury, Princess Anne, or Snow Hill.  
**Salary**: $58,240–$60,320 annually

**When You Speak, We Listen and See You Through.**

At Optimal Case Management, we believe meaningful case management begins with listening. Our Coordinators of Community Services (CCS) partner with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families to understand what matters most to them, navigate services and resources, advocate for their needs, and support progress toward meaningful life goals.

This is rewarding, relationship-centered work that also requires independence, organization, accountability, travel, timely documentation, and consistent follow-through. We want candidates to understand both the purpose and the day-to-day realities of the position before joining our team.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS REALLY LIKE**

**This is a community-based position—not a traditional remote job.**

  

* Administrative work may be completed from a home-based workspace, but regular in-person community work is an essential part of the position.
* You will routinely travel throughout your assigned service region.
* Meetings may occur in individuals' homes, provider locations, workplaces, programs, and other community settings.
* Travel varies according to caseload needs and may occasionally involve driving up to approximately two hours one way.
* Applicants are strongly encouraged to apply for positions within or near your residence.
* You must have reliable transportation and the ability to travel throughout your assigned region.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

As a CCS, you will develop relationships with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families and coordinate services around their needs, preferences, choices, and goals.

Responsibilities include:

* Build trusting, person-centered relationships with individuals and their families or support systems.
* Learn what matters most to each person and help translate their goals into meaningful supports and services.
* Coordinate and monitor services across providers, agencies, community resources, and other support systems.
* Connect individuals and families with appropriate community, healthcare, employment, housing, educational, financial, and social resources.
* Monitor whether services are meeting the individual's identified needs and goals, and advocate for the individual when barriers to services or supports arise.
* Participate in planning meetings and collaborate with individuals, families, providers, State agencies, and community partners.
* Maintain accurate, timely, and person-centered documentation of case management activities in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Manage an assigned caseload while meeting quality, timeliness, productivity, and compliance expectations.
* Participate in supervision, training, quality review, and professional development.
* Maintain confidentiality and protect sensitive information.
* Perform other duties reasonably related to the position.

**Documentation and Productivity Matter**

Case management does not end when the meeting or phone call is over. CCS employees are responsible for documenting the services they provide accurately and within required timelines. Documentation must clearly reflect the activity performed, the person's needs or goals, the connection between activity and the person's goals, and appropriate next steps. This position also includes defined productivity expectations.

Success requires the ability to balance:

* meaningful engagement with individuals and families
* meetings, communication, and community visits
* case coordination and follow-up
* documentation
* travel
* administrative responsibilities

Travel between work locations is part of the workday but is not itself a billable case management service. Thoughtful scheduling and caseload management are therefore important to success in the role.

**You Will Work Independently—but You Will Not Work Alone**

CCS employees spend significant portions of their workday independently managing their caseloads, schedules, documentation, and community visits. At the same time, case management at Optimal is a team effort. You will work closely with supervisors, other Case Managers, Quality Assurance, Training, providers, families, community partners, and organizational leadership.

We expect employees to:

* communicate early when challenges arise
* ask questions when clarification is needed
* accept and apply feedback
* collaborate across teams
* follow through on responsibilities
* take pride in their work.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required Education and Experience**

* Possess a Bachelor’s or graduate degree in social work or another health or human services field.
* Complete a supervised field experience in case management, behavioral health, or vocational rehabilitation as part of the degree or state’s recognition requirements for permitting legally authorized practice, or two (2) years of full-time equivalent experience providing direct clinical care to the consumer

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* Coordinating services for people in Medicaid and/or waiver programs
* Coordinating services for people with intellectual disabilities/developmental disabilities (ID/DD)
* Social Service intake and referral services
* Coordinate services for eligible individuals as outlined in the Coordinator of Community Services COMAR, the DDA Scope of Service
* Monitoring the provision of services to participants
* Allied service delivery systems, including Medicaid, mental health, substance abuse, social services, juvenile justice, vocational rehabilitation, and corrections
* Regulations governing services for participants

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Work is performed in a combination of home-based and community settings.
* Regular travel throughout the assigned counties and service region is required.
* Community work may occur in homes, workplaces, programs, provider locations, and other public or private settings.
* Work environments may occasionally be unfamiliar, uncomfortable, or present potential health or safety concerns.
* Appropriate personal protective equipment may be required depending on the environment.
* Employees are expected to exercise professionalism, situational awareness, sound judgment, and appropriate safety practices while working independently in the community.

**BENEFITS**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Company-paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance
* Company-paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays
* 401(k) Retirement plan with employer match
* Supplemental Benefits Program
* Employee assistance program
* Mileage reimbursement at Federal mileage rate
* Professional development opportunities

**Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity**

Optimal Case Management provides equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees and makes employment decisions based on legitimate job-related qualifications, experience, performance, and organizational needs. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected accommodation needs in accordance with applicable law. Send application accommodation requests to 301-790-4962.

**Background and Pre-Employment Requirements**

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of job-related pre-employment requirements applicable to the position. Any background screening or other pre-employment review will be conducted at the appropriate stage of the hiring process and in accordance with applicable law. Applicants must not be employed by or provide services for more than one Maryland Medicaid provider at the same time.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you want a career where listening matters, relationships matter, and your work helps people navigate services and build lives around what is important to them, we invite you to apply.

Before applying, please consider the community travel, documentation, productivity, independence, and accountability required by this position. We want every person who joins Optimal to enter the role with a clear understanding of both the opportunity and the expectations.

* Apply to the opening serving the county or region closest to where you live whenever possible.
